  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hy
  have hr' : (r : K) = t⁻¹ := congrArg Subtype.val hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℚ[X], aeval t p = r := by
    have : (r : K) ∈ (aeval (R := ℚ) t).range := by
      rw [← Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]; exact r.2
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := this
    exact ⟨p, hp⟩
  apply ht
  refine ⟨X * p - 1, fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 0) h0
    simp at this
  · simp [hp, hr', ht0]

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_coordRing
statement:
theorem mem_coordRing {D : Finset (Place K)} {f : K} :
    f ∈ coordRing D ↔ ∀ P : Place K, P ∉ D → f ∈ P.1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_chartRing_iff_forall
statement:
theorem mem_chartRing_iff_forall {t : K} [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] (f : K) :
    f ∈ chartRing t ↔ ∀ P : Place K, t ∈ P.1 → f ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf P hP => mem_of_mem_chartRing P.1 P.ratCast_mem hP hf, fun hf => ?_⟩
  set s : Set K := Set.range (algebraMap ℚ K) ∪ {t} with hs
  have hmem : f ∈ (⨅ V : {V : ValuationSubring K // s ⊆ V.toSubring}, V.1.toSubring) := by
    rw [Subring.mem_iInf]
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    by_cases htop : V = ⊤
    · subst htop
      exact trivial
    · have hq : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ V := fun q => hV (Or.inl ⟨q, eq_ratCast _ q⟩)
      exact hf ⟨V, htop, hq⟩ (hV (Or.inr rfl))
  rw [iInf_valuationSubring_superset] at hmem
  have hint : IsIntegral (Subring.closure s) f := hmem
  have heq : (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}).toSubring = Subring.closure s := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_eq_ring_closure]
  let e : Subring.closure s →+* Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} :=
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨a.1, by rw [← Subalgebra.mem_toSubring, heq]; exact a.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  exact IsIntegral.map_of_comp_eq e (RingHom.id K) (by ext a; rfl) hint

name: Belyi.CurveField.exists_notMem_iff_mem
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_iff_mem (D : Finset (Place K)) (hD : D.Nonempty) :
    ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ ∀ P : Place K, t ∉ P.1 ↔ P ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := exists_polarDivisor_eq (K := K)
  set A₀ : Divisor K := ∑ P ∈ D, Finsupp.single P 1 with hA₀
  have hA₀P : ∀ P, A₀ P = if P ∈ D then 1 else 0 := by
    intro P
    rw [hA₀, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  have hA₀nonneg : 0 ≤ A₀ := fun P => by rw [hA₀P P]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hdeg₀ : 0 < A₀.deg := by
    obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := hD
    refine deg_pos_of_nonneg_of_ne_zero hA₀nonneg fun h => ?_
    have := congrArg (fun A : Divisor K => A P₀) h
    simp only [hA₀P, hP₀, if_true, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    exact one_ne_zero this
  set n : ℕ := N1.toNat + 1 with hn
  have hdeg : N1 ≤ (n • A₀).deg := by
    rw [deg_nsmul]
    have h1 : (N1 : ℤ) ≤ n := by
      rw [hn]
      push_cast
      have := Int.self_le_toNat N1
      omega
    nlinarith
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ n • A₀ := fun P => by
    simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hA₀nonneg P)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hN1 (n • A₀) hnonneg hdeg
  have hpole : ∀ P : Place K, t ∉ P.1 ↔ P ∈ D := by
    intro P
    rw [← P.ord_neg_iff]
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Divisor K => A P) ht
    simp only [polarDivisor_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hA₀P] at h
    constructor
    · intro hlt
      by_contra hPD
      rw [if_neg hPD, smul_zero] at h
      have := le_max_right 0 (-P.ord t)
      omega
    · intro hPD
      rw [if_pos hPD, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
      have hnpos : (0 : ℤ) < n := by rw [hn]; positivity
      by_contra hge
      push Not at hge
      rw [max_eq_left (by omega)] at h
      omega
  refine ⟨t, fun halg => ?_, hpole⟩
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := hD
  have hmem : t ∈ P₀.1 := P₀.mem_of_isAlgebraic halg
  exact (hpole P₀).mpr hP₀ hmem

name: Belyi.CurveField.coordRing_eq_chartRing
statement:
theorem coordRing_eq_chartRing {D : Finset (Place K)} {t : K} [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)]
    (ht : ∀ P : Place K, t ∉ P.1 ↔ P ∈ D) (f : K) : f ∈ coordRing D ↔ f ∈ chartRing t
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_coordRing, mem_chartRing_iff_forall]
  refine forall_congr' fun P => ?_
  rw [← ht]
  exact ⟨fun h htP => h (not_not.mpr htP), fun h hn => h (not_not.mp hn)⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.exists_finset_adjoin_eq_coordRing
statement:
theorem exists_finset_adjoin_eq_coordRing (D : Finset (Place K)) (hD : D.Nonempty)
    (S : Finset K) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ coordRing D) :
    ∃ G : Finset K, S ⊆ G ∧ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (G : Set K) = coordRing D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, htr, ht⟩ := exists_notMem_iff_mem D hD
  haveI : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨htr⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := (Algebra.FiniteType.out : (⊤ : Subalgebra ℚ (chartRing t)).FG)
  set G₀ : Finset K := s₀.image Subtype.val with hG₀
  refine ⟨S ∪ G₀, Finset.subset_union_left, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro g hg
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hg) with hgS | hgG
    · exact hS g hgS
    · rw [hG₀, Finset.mem_image] at hgG
      obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := hgG
      exact (coordRing_eq_chartRing ht a.1).mpr a.2
  · intro f hf
    have hfc : f ∈ chartRing t := (coordRing_eq_chartRing ht f).mp hf
    have h1 : (⟨f, hfc⟩ : chartRing t) ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (s₀ : Set (chartRing t)) := by
      rw [hs₀]
      exact Algebra.mem_top
    have key : ∀ a : chartRing t, a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (s₀ : Set (chartRing t)) →
        (a : K) ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ ((S ∪ G₀ : Finset K) : Set K) := by
      intro a ha
      induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)))
      | algebraMap q =>
        have : ((algebraMap ℚ (chartRing t) q : chartRing t) : K) = algebraMap ℚ K q := by
          have h := RingHom.ext_rat (((chartRing t).val : chartRing t →+* K).comp
            (algebraMap ℚ (chartRing t))) (algebraMap ℚ K)
          exact congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe h) q
        rw [this]
        exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ q
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hx hy
      | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hx hy
    exact key _ h1

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one {y : K} (hy : w y = 1) : P.ord y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hy
  refine (P.ord_eq_zero_iff hy0).mpr ⟨(hw y).mpr hy.le, (hw _).mpr ?_⟩
  rw [map_inv₀, hy, inv_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_neg_log
statement:
theorem ord_eq_neg_log (hπ : ∃ π, w π = WithZero.exp (-1)) (x : K) :
    P.ord x = -WithZero.log (w x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hπ
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hπ
    exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero hπ.symm
  
  have hm : P.ord π = 1 := by
    have hpos : 0 < P.ord π := by
      have hmem : π ∈ P.1 := (hw π).mpr (by rw [hπ]; decide)
      have hinv : π⁻¹ ∉ P.1 := by
        rw [hw, map_inv₀, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_neg, neg_neg]; decide
      have h0 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem hmem
      rcases h0.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ((P.ord_eq_zero_iff hπ0).mp h.symm).2 hinv
    obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := P.exists_ord_eq_one
    have hϖ0 : ϖ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hϖ
    set k := WithZero.log (w ϖ)
    have hwϖ : w ϖ = WithZero.exp k := (WithZero.exp_log (by simpa using hϖ0)).symm
    have hy : w (ϖ * π ^ k) = 1 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hwϖ, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_zsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add]
      simp
    have := P.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one w hw hy
    rw [P.ord_mul hϖ0 (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0), ord_zpow, hϖ] at this
    have hkm : (-k) * P.ord π = 1 := by linarith
    exact Int.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_left hpos.le hkm
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx0
  · simp
  set n := WithZero.log (w x)
  have hwx : w x = WithZero.exp n := (WithZero.exp_log (by simpa using hx0)).symm
  have hy : w (x * π ^ n) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hwx, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_zsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add]
    simp
  have := P.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one w hw hy
  rw [P.ord_mul hx0 (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0), ord_zpow, hm] at this
  linarith

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_ofChart
statement:
theorem ord_ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) (x : K) :
    (ofChart t v).ord x = -WithZero.log (v.valuation K x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (ofChart t v).ord_eq_neg_log (v.valuation K) (fun y ↦ ?_)
    (HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_exists_uniformizer K v) x
  rw [ofChart_val, HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_ofChart_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ord_ofChart_algebraMap (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) {r : chartRing t}
    (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (ofChart t v).ord (algebraMap (chartRing t) K r) =
      multiplicity v.asIdeal (Ideal.span {r})
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_ofChart, HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_of_algebraMap,
    HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity v hr, WithZero.log_exp, neg_neg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.chartResidue_surjective
statement:
theorem chartResidue_surjective (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    Function.Surjective (chartResidue t v)
proof:
:=
  (ofChart t v).residue_comp_surjective t (self_mem_ofChart t v)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ker_chartResidue
statement:
theorem ker_chartResidue (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    RingHom.ker (chartResidue t v) = v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, chartResidue, RingHom.comp_apply, residue_eq_zero_iff,
    ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  conv_rhs => rw [← toChart_ofChart t v]
  rw [mem_toChart_iff]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finrank_quotient_eq_deg
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_deg (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (chartRing t ⧸ v.asIdeal) = (ofChart t v).deg
proof:
:= by
  let e : (chartRing t ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (ofChart t v).ResidueField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := quotientEquivResidueField t v)
      (fun q ↦ (quotientEquivResidueField t v).toRingHom.map_rat_algebraMap q)
  exact e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algEquiv_X
statement:
private theorem algEquiv_X :
    Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t Fact.out X = tR t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental_apply, aeval_X]; rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.irreducible_tR
statement: private theorem irreducible_tR : Irreducible (tR t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algEquiv_X]
  exact (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff
    (Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t Fact.out).toMulEquiv).mpr Polynomial.irreducible_X

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isMaximal_span_tR
statement: private theorem isMaximal_span_tR : (Ideal.span {tR t}).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  have : IsPrincipalIdealRing (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
    IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective (Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t Fact.out).toRingHom
      (Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t Fact.out).surjective
  exact PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible (irreducible_tR t)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.span_tR_ne_bot
statement: private theorem span_tR_ne_bot : Ideal.span {tR t} ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  exact (irreducible_tR t).ne_zero

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finrank_quotient_span_tR
statement:
private theorem finrank_quotient_span_tR :
    Module.finrank ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := isMaximal_span_tR t
  letI := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span {tR t})
  let e := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t Fact.out
  have he : e X = tR t := algEquiv_X t
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t})) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := e.surjective r
    obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_sub_C (p := q)
    refine ⟨q.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}), Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← AlgEquiv.commutes e, ← map_sub, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      ← neg_sub, map_neg, neg_mem_iff, hq', map_mul, he]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (Algebra.ofId ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t})) :=
    ⟨(algebraMap ℚ _).injective, hsurj⟩
  rw [← (AlgEquiv.ofBijective _ hbij).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.tS_ne_zero
statement: private theorem tS_ne_zero : tS t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ne_zero_of_transcendental (Fact.out : Transcendental ℚ t) (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.map_span_tR
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_primesOver_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_primesOver_iff (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    v.asIdeal ∈ (Ideal.span {tR t}).primesOver (chartRing t) ↔ tS t ∈ v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hlo⟩
    have h1 : tR t ∈ v.asIdeal.under (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) := by
      rw [← hlo.over]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    exact h1
  · intro h
    refine ⟨v.isPrime, ⟨(isMaximal_span_tR t).eq_of_le (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance) ?_⟩⟩
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_asIdeal_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_asIdeal_iff (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    tS t ∈ v.asIdeal ↔ 0 < (ofChart t v).ord t
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_toChart_iff t (ofChart t v) (self_mem_ofChart t v) (r := tS t)
  rw [toChart_ofChart] at h
  rw [ord_pos_iff, h]
  exact ⟨fun h' ↦ ⟨ne_zero_of_transcendental (Fact.out : Transcendental ℚ t), h'⟩, fun h' ↦ h'.2⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.inertiaDeg'_eq_finrank
statement:
private theorem inertiaDeg'_eq_finrank (P : Ideal (chartRing t)) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {tR t})] :
    Ideal.inertiaDeg' (Ideal.span {tR t}) P = Module.finrank ℚ (chartRing t ⧸ P)
proof:
:= by
  have := isMaximal_span_tR t
  letI := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span {tR t})
  have : Module.Free ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t}) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
  have : Module.Free (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t}) (chartRing t ⧸ P) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg'_algebraMap,
    ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} ⧸ Ideal.span {tR t}),
    finrank_quotient_span_tR, one_mul]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.sum_ord_mul_deg_zeros
statement:
theorem sum_ord_mul_deg_zeros (t : K) (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    ∑ P ∈ (finite_setOf_ord_pos t).toFinset, P.ord t * (P.deg : ℤ) =
      Module.finrank ℚ⟮t⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  have hpm := isMaximal_span_tR t
  have hp0 := span_tR_ne_bot t
  have key := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (chartRing t) ℚ⟮t⟯ K hp0
  rw [← key]
  push_cast
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun P hP ↦ ofChart t ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩)
    (fun Q hQ ↦ (Q.toChart t (Q.mem_of_ord_nonneg ?_)).asIdeal) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact ((IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 _).mp hP).1
  · exact Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp0
      ((IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 _).mp hP)
  · exact ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hQ).le
  · intro P hP
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← mem_asIdeal_iff t, ← mem_primesOver_iff t]
    exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 _).mp hP
  · intro Q hQ
    rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 _]
    have hQ' := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hQ
    refine (mem_primesOver_iff t (Q.toChart t (Q.mem_of_ord_nonneg hQ'.le))).mpr ?_
    rw [mem_toChart_iff]
    exact ((Q.ord_pos_iff).mp hQ').2
  · intro P hP
    exact congrArg HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal (toChart_ofChart t _)
  · intro Q hQ
    exact ofChart_toChart t Q (Q.mem_of_ord_nonneg ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hQ).le)
  · intro P hP
    have hmem := (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 _).mp hP
    set v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t) :=
      ⟨P, hmem.1, Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp0 hmem⟩
    have : P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {tR t}) := hmem.2
    have : P.IsPrime := hmem.1
    have hram : Ideal.ramificationIdx' (Ideal.span {tR t}) P = (ofChart t v).ord t := by
      rw [Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_multiplicity _ hmem.1, map_span_tR]
      · exact (ord_ofChart_algebraMap t v (tS_ne_zero t)).symm
      · rw [map_span_tR, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact tS_ne_zero t
    have hin : Ideal.inertiaDeg' (Ideal.span {tR t}) P = (ofChart t v).deg := by
      rw [inertiaDeg'_eq_finrank t P, ← finrank_quotient_eq_deg t v]
    rw [hram, hin]

name: Belyi.CurveField.adjoin_inv_eq
statement: theorem adjoin_inv_eq {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (t : K) : ℚ⟮t⁻¹⟯ = ℚ⟮t⟯
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    exact inv_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ t)
  · rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    simpa using inv_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ t⁻¹)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.sum_ord_mul_deg_poles
statement:
theorem sum_ord_mul_deg_poles (t : K) (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    ∑ P ∈ (finite_setOf_ord_neg t).toFinset, (-P.ord t) * (P.deg : ℤ) =
      Module.finrank ℚ⟮t⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_ord_mul_deg_zeros t⁻¹ (transcendental_inv ht)
  rw [adjoin_inv_eq] at h
  rw [← h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun P _ ↦ by rw [ord_inv]
  ext P
  simp [ord_inv]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_add
statement: theorem deg_add (A B : Divisor K) : (A + B).deg = A.deg + B.deg
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ zero_mul _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_mul _ _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_zero : (0 : Divisor K).deg = 0
proof: := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.degHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degHom_apply (A : Divisor K) : degHom A = A.deg
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_neg (A : Divisor K) : (-A).deg = -A.deg
proof: := map_neg degHom A

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_sub
statement: theorem deg_sub (A B : Divisor K) : (A - B).deg = A.deg - B.deg
proof: := map_sub degHom A B

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_nsmul
statement: theorem deg_nsmul (n : ℕ) (A : Divisor K) : (n • A).deg = n * A.deg
proof:
:= by
  rw [← degHom_apply, map_nsmul, degHom_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_zsmul
statement: theorem deg_zsmul (n : ℤ) (A : Divisor K) : (n • A).deg = n * A.deg
proof:
:= by
  rw [← degHom_apply, map_zsmul, degHom_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_single (P : Place K) (n : ℤ) : deg (Finsupp.single P n) = n * P.deg
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_single_index (h := fun (P : Place K) (n : ℤ) ↦ n * (P.deg : ℤ)) (zero_mul _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset (A : Divisor K) {s : Finset (Place K)}
    (hs : A.support ⊆ s) : A.deg = ∑ P ∈ s, A P * (P.deg : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset A hs _ fun _ _ ↦ zero_mul _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_nonneg
statement: theorem deg_nonneg {A : Divisor K} (hA : 0 ≤ A) : 0 ≤ A.deg
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun P _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hA P) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_mono
statement: theorem deg_mono {A B : Divisor K} (h : A ≤ B) : A.deg ≤ B.deg
proof:
:= by
  have := deg_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h)
  rw [deg_sub] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_pos_of_nonneg_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deg_pos_of_nonneg_of_ne_zero [IsCurveField K] {A : Divisor K} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (h0 : A ≠ 0) : 0 < A.deg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp h0
  have hPpos : 0 < A P := lt_of_le_of_ne (hA P) (Ne.symm hP)
  have hsplit : A = Finsupp.single P (A P) + (A - Finsupp.single P (A P)) := by abel
  have hrest : 0 ≤ A - Finsupp.single P (A P) := by
    classical
    intro Q
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    by_cases h : P = Q
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg h, sub_zero]; exact hA Q
  rw [hsplit, deg_add, deg_single]
  have := deg_nonneg hrest
  have := P.deg_pos
  positivity

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_apply (f : K) (P : Place K) : div f P = P.ord f
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_zero : div (0 : K) = 0
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_one : div (1 : K) = 0
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_mul
statement: theorem div_mul {f g : K} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : div (f * g) = div f + div g
proof:
:= by
  ext P; simp [P.ord_mul hf hg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_inv (f : K) : div f⁻¹ = -div f
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_div
statement: theorem div_div {f g : K} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : div (f / g) = div f - div g
proof:
:= by
  ext P; simp [P.ord_div hf hg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_pow (f : K) (n : ℕ) : div (f ^ n) = n • div f
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_neg (f : K) : div (-f) = div f
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic
statement: theorem div_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic {c : K} (hc : IsAlgebraic ℚ c) : div c = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext P; simp [P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic hc]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.zeroDivisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroDivisor_apply (f : K) (P : Place K) : zeroDivisor f P = max 0 (P.ord f)
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.polarDivisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polarDivisor_apply (f : K) (P : Place K) : polarDivisor f P = max 0 (-P.ord f)
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.zeroDivisor_nonneg
statement: theorem zeroDivisor_nonneg (f : K) : 0 ≤ zeroDivisor f
proof: := fun P ↦ by simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.polarDivisor_nonneg
statement: theorem polarDivisor_nonneg (f : K) : 0 ≤ polarDivisor f
proof: := fun P ↦ by simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.div_eq_zeroDivisor_sub_polarDivisor
statement:
theorem div_eq_zeroDivisor_sub_polarDivisor (f : K) :
    div f = zeroDivisor f - polarDivisor f
proof:
:= by
  ext P; simp only [div_apply, Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, zeroDivisor_apply,
    polarDivisor_apply]; omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.polarDivisor_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polarDivisor_inv (f : K) : polarDivisor f⁻¹ = zeroDivisor f
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.zeroDivisor_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroDivisor_inv (f : K) : zeroDivisor f⁻¹ = polarDivisor f
proof: := by ext P; simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.neg_polarDivisor_le_div
statement: theorem neg_polarDivisor_le_div (f : K) : -polarDivisor f ≤ div f
proof:
:= fun P ↦ by
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_neg, Pi.neg_apply, polarDivisor_apply, div_apply]; omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_zeroDivisor
statement:
theorem deg_zeroDivisor {x : K} (hx : Transcendental ℚ x) :
    (zeroDivisor x).deg = Module.finrank ℚ⟮x⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Place.sum_ord_mul_deg_zeros x hx, deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset (zeroDivisor x)
    (s := (Place.finite_setOf_ord_pos x).toFinset)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P hP ↦ ?_
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hP
    rw [zeroDivisor_apply, max_eq_right hP.le]
  · intro P hP
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, zeroDivisor_apply] at hP
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_polarDivisor
statement:
theorem deg_polarDivisor {x : K} (hx : Transcendental ℚ x) :
    (polarDivisor x).deg = Module.finrank ℚ⟮x⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Place.sum_ord_mul_deg_poles x hx, deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset (polarDivisor x)
    (s := (Place.finite_setOf_ord_neg x).toFinset)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P hP ↦ ?_
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hP
    rw [polarDivisor_apply, max_eq_right (by omega)]
  · intro P hP
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, polarDivisor_apply] at hP
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_div
statement: theorem deg_div (f : K) : (div f).deg = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : IsAlgebraic ℚ f
  · rw [div_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic hf, deg_zero]
  · rw [div_eq_zeroDivisor_sub_polarDivisor, deg_sub, deg_zeroDivisor hf, deg_polarDivisor hf,
      sub_self]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.polarDivisor_ne_zero
statement: theorem polarDivisor_ne_zero {x : K} (hx : Transcendental ℚ x) : polarDivisor x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Place.exists_ord_neg hx
  intro h
  have := congrArg (· P) h
  simp only [polarDivisor_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.comap_ne_top
statement: theorem comap_ne_top (Q : Place L) : Q.1.comap (algebraMap K L) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Q.ne_top
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn Q.1.toSubring L := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn Q.1 L)
  have hle : (integralClosure K L).toSubring ≤ Q.1.toSubring := by
    refine Subring.integralClosure_le_iff.mpr fun r ↦ ?_
    have : r ∈ Q.1.comap (algebraMap K L) := h ▸ ValuationSubring.mem_top r
    exact this
  exact top_unique fun y _ ↦ hle (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := K) y)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.restrict_val
statement: theorem restrict_val : (Q.restrict K).1 = Q.1.comap (algebraMap K L)
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_restrict_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_restrict_iff {x : K} : x ∈ (Q.restrict K).1 ↔ algebraMap K L x ∈ Q.1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_restrict_nonunits_iff
statement:
theorem mem_restrict_nonunits_iff {x : K} :
    x ∈ (Q.restrict K).1.nonunits ↔ algebraMap K L x ∈ Q.1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or,
    mem_restrict_iff, map_inv₀, map_eq_zero]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.coe_restrictHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_restrictHom (a : (Q.restrict K).1) :
    (Q.restrictHom K a : L) = algebraMap K L a
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_uniformizer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_uniformizer (P : Place K) : P.ord P.uniformizer = 1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec P.exists_ord_eq_one

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.uniformizer_ne_zero
statement: theorem uniformizer_ne_zero (P : Place K) : P.uniformizer ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := P.ord_uniformizer
  rw [h, ord_zero] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_restrict_pos_iff
statement:
theorem ord_restrict_pos_iff (x : K) :
    0 < (Q.restrict K).ord x ↔ 0 < Q.ord (algebraMap K L x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_pos_iff, ord_pos_iff, mem_restrict_nonunits_iff, Ne, Ne, map_eq_zero]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_restrict_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem ord_restrict_eq_zero_iff {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (Q.restrict K).ord x = 0 ↔ Q.ord (algebraMap K L x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_zero_iff _ hx, ord_eq_zero_iff _ ((map_ne_zero _).mpr hx), mem_restrict_iff,
    mem_restrict_iff, map_inv₀]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_algebraMap_uniformizer
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_uniformizer :
    Q.ord (algebraMap K L (Q.restrict K).uniformizer) = Q.ramificationIdx K
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramificationIdx, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]
  exact ((Q.ord_restrict_pos_iff _).mp (by rw [ord_uniformizer]; exact one_pos)).le

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx_pos
statement: theorem ramificationIdx_pos : 0 < Q.ramificationIdx K
proof:
:= by
  have := (Q.ord_restrict_pos_iff (Q.restrict K).uniformizer).mp
    (by rw [ord_uniformizer]; exact one_pos)
  rw [ord_algebraMap_uniformizer] at this
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (x : K) :
    Q.ord (algebraMap K L x) = Q.ramificationIdx K * (Q.restrict K).ord x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp
  set P := Q.restrict K
  set π := P.uniformizer
  have hπ : π ≠ 0 := P.uniformizer_ne_zero
  set n := P.ord x
  have hu0 : x * π ^ (-n) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hx (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ)
  have hu : P.ord (x * π ^ (-n)) = 0 := by
    rw [P.ord_mul hx (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ), ord_zpow, ord_uniformizer]; ring
  have hu' := (Q.ord_restrict_eq_zero_iff hu0).mp hu
  have hx' : algebraMap K L x = algebraMap K L (x * π ^ (-n)) * algebraMap K L π ^ n := by
    rw [← map_zpow₀, ← map_mul, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hπ, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, mul_one]
  have hπL : algebraMap K L π ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).mpr hπ
  rw [hx', Q.ord_mul ((map_ne_zero _).mpr hu0) (zpow_ne_zero _ hπL), hu', ord_zpow,
    ord_algebraMap_uniformizer]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.nonunits_subset_of_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem nonunits_subset_of_restrict_eq {P : Place K} (hQ : Q.restrict K = P) {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ P.1.nonunits) : algebraMap K L x ∈ Q.1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  subst hQ; exact (mem_restrict_nonunits_iff Q).mp hx

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finite_setOf_restrict_eq
statement: theorem finite_setOf_restrict_eq (P : Place K) : {Q : Place L | Q.restrict K = P}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_setOf_ord_pos (algebraMap K L P.uniformizer)).subset fun Q hQ ↦ ?_
  have hQ' : Q.restrict K = P := hQ
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← Q.ord_restrict_pos_iff, hQ', ord_uniformizer]
  exact one_pos

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_restrict_eq
statement: theorem exists_restrict_eq (P : Place K) : ∃ Q : Place L, Q.restrict K = P
proof:
:= by
  set π := P.uniformizer
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := P.uniformizer_ne_zero
  have hπP : π ∈ P.1.nonunits := ((P.ord_pos_iff).mp (by rw [ord_uniformizer]; exact one_pos)).2
  have hπmem : π ∈ P.1 := P.1.nonunits_subset hπP
  set A : Subring L := P.1.toSubring.map (algebraMap K L)
  let πA : A := ⟨algebraMap K L π, Subring.mem_map.mpr ⟨π, hπmem, rfl⟩⟩
  have hI : Ideal.span {πA} ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
    rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbu⟩ := Subring.mem_map.mp ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A).2
    have h1 : algebraMap K L (π * b) = 1 := by
      rw [map_mul, hbu]
      have := congrArg Subtype.val u.mul_inv
      rwa [hu] at this
    have h2 : π * b = 1 := (algebraMap K L).injective (by rw [h1, map_one])
    rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or] at hπP
    refine hπP.elim hπ0 fun h ↦ h ?_
    rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h2]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hB⟩ := Ideal.image_subset_nonunits_valuationSubring _ hI
  have hπB : algebraMap K L π ∈ B.nonunits := hB ⟨πA, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _, rfl⟩
  have hBtop : B ≠ ⊤ := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or] at hπB
    exact hπB.elim ((map_ne_zero _).mpr hπ0) fun h ↦ h (ValuationSubring.mem_top _)
  have hPB : ∀ x ∈ P.1, algebraMap K L x ∈ B := fun x hx ↦ hAB (Subring.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨⟨B, hBtop, fun q ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_ratCast (algebraMap K L)]; exact hPB _ (P.ratCast_mem q)
  · have hle : P.1 ≤ (Place.restrict K (⟨B, hBtop, fun q ↦ by
        rw [← map_ratCast (algebraMap K L)]; exact hPB _ (P.ratCast_mem q)⟩ : Place L)).1 :=
      fun x hx ↦ hPB x hx
    exact (Place.ext (ValuationSubring.eq_of_le_of_ne_top _ hle (Place.ne_top _))).symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residueFieldMap_residue
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_residue (a : (Q.restrict K).1) :
    Q.residueFieldMap K ((Q.restrict K).residue a) = Q.residue (Q.restrictHom K a)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue _ a

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_residue
statement:
theorem algebraMap_residue (a : (Q.restrict K).1) :
    letI
proof:
:= Q.residueAlgebra K
    algebraMap (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField ((Q.restrict K).residue a) =
      Q.residue (Q.restrictHom K a) :=
  Q.residueFieldMap_residue a

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul
statement: theorem deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul : Q.deg = Q.inertiaDeg K * (Q.restrict K).deg
proof:
:= by
  letI := Q.residueAlgebra K
  rw [deg, deg, inertiaDeg, mul_comm,
    Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.inertiaDeg_pos
statement: theorem inertiaDeg_pos : 0 < Q.inertiaDeg K
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul (K := K)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Q.inertiaDeg K) with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0, zero_mul] at h; exact absurd h Q.deg_pos.ne'
  · exact h0

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.inertiaDeg_le_finrank
statement: theorem inertiaDeg_le_finrank [FiniteDimensional K L] : Q.inertiaDeg K ≤ finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only [inertiaDeg]
  letI := Q.residueAlgebra K
  have : FiniteDimensional (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℚ _ _
  let b := Module.finBasis (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField
  choose y hy using fun i ↦ Q.residue_surjective (b i)
  have hli : LinearIndependent K (fun i ↦ (y i : L)) := by
    rw [linearIndependent_iff']
    intro s g hg i hi
    by_contra hgi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjmin⟩ := (s.filter (fun i ↦ g i ≠ 0)).exists_min_image
      (fun i ↦ (Q.restrict K).ord (g i)) ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, hgi⟩⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    set c := g j
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := hj.2
    have hmem : ∀ i ∈ s, g i / c ∈ (Q.restrict K).1 := by
      intro i hi
      rcases eq_or_ne (g i) 0 with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0, zero_div]; exact (Q.restrict K).1.zero_mem
      refine (Q.restrict K).mem_of_ord_nonneg ?_
      rw [(Q.restrict K).ord_div h0 hc, sub_nonneg]
      exact hjmin i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, h0⟩)
    let hP : Fin (finrank (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField) → (Q.restrict K).1 := fun i ↦
      if hs : g i / c ∈ (Q.restrict K).1 then ⟨g i / c, hs⟩ else 0
    have hhP : ∀ i ∈ s, (hP i : K) = g i / c := fun i hi ↦ by simp only [hP, dif_pos (hmem i hi)]
    have hsumQ : ∑ i ∈ s, Q.restrictHom K (hP i) * y i = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
      calc ∑ i ∈ s, ((Q.restrictHom K (hP i) * y i : Q.1) : L)
          = ∑ i ∈ s, (algebraMap K L c)⁻¹ * (g i • (y i : L)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ by
              rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_restrictHom, hhP i hi, Algebra.smul_def, map_div₀]
              ring
        _ = (algebraMap K L c)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ s, g i • (y i : L) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hg, mul_zero]
    have hres := congrArg Q.residue hsumQ
    rw [map_sum, map_zero] at hres
    simp only [map_mul, hy, ← algebraMap_residue, ← Algebra.smul_def] at hres
    have := (linearIndependent_iff'.mp b.linearIndependent) s
      (fun i ↦ (Q.restrict K).residue (hP i)) hres j hj.1
    have h1 : hP j = 1 := Subtype.ext (by rw [hhP j hj.1, div_self hc]; rfl)
    rw [h1, map_one] at this
    exact one_ne_zero this
  have := hli.fintype_card_le_finrank
  rwa [Fintype.card_fin] at this

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.restrict_P
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_P : (y.restrict K).P = y.P.restrict K
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_restrict
statement:
theorem eval_restrict (f : K) (hf : f ∈ (y.restrict K).P.1) :
    (y.restrict K).eval f hf = y.eval (algebraMap K L f) hf
proof:
:= by
  change y.σ (y.P.residueFieldMap K ((y.P.restrict K).residue ⟨f, hf⟩)) =
    y.σ (y.P.residue ⟨algebraMap K L f, hf⟩)
  rw [Place.residueFieldMap_residue]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.fieldOf_restrict_le
statement: theorem fieldOf_restrict_le : (y.restrict K).fieldOf ≤ y.fieldOf
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨y.P.residueFieldMap K a, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.exists_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq [FiniteDimensional K L] (x : QbarPoint K) :
    ∃ y : QbarPoint L, y.restrict K = x ∧ y.deg ≤ finrank K L * x.deg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, σ⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := Place.exists_restrict_eq L P
  letI := Q.residueAlgebra K
  letI : Algebra (Q.restrict K).ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := σ.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := ℚ) _
  let τ : Q.ResidueField →ₐ[(Q.restrict K).ResidueField] AlgebraicClosure ℚ :=
    IsAlgClosed.lift
  refine ⟨⟨Q, τ.toRingHom⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [restrict, mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    ext a
    exact τ.commutes a
  · change Module.finrank ℚ _ ≤ _
    rw [(QbarPoint.mk Q τ.toRingHom).residueFieldEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm]
    change Q.deg ≤ _
    rw [Q.deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul (K := K), deg_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Q.inertiaDeg_le_finrank)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ratCast_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime
statement:
theorem ratCast_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) (q : ℚ) :
    (q : L) ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L w
proof:
:= by
  have := algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime (K := L) w (algebraMap ℚ S q)
  rwa [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, eq_ratCast] at this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_mem_ofHeightOne
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_ofHeightOne (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) (s : S) :
    algebraMap S L s ∈ (ofHeightOne L w).1
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime w s

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ofHeightOne_heightOneBelow
statement:
theorem ofHeightOne_heightOneBelow (Q : Place L) (hS : ∀ s : S, algebraMap S L s ∈ Q.1) :
    ofHeightOne L (heightOneBelow Q.1 Q.ne_top hS) = Q
proof:
:=
  Place.ext (valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow _ _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.heightOneBelow_ofHeightOne
statement:
theorem heightOneBelow_ofHeightOne (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) :
    heightOneBelow (ofHeightOne L w).1 (ofHeightOne L w).ne_top
      (algebraMap_mem_ofHeightOne w) = w
proof:
:=
  heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime w

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_mem_nonunits_ofHeightOne_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_nonunits_ofHeightOne_iff (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) (s : S) :
    algebraMap S L s ∈ (ofHeightOne L w).1.nonunits ↔ s ∈ w.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← heightOneBelow_ofHeightOne (L := L) w]
  rw [mem_heightOneBelow]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.heightOneResidue_surjective
statement:
theorem heightOneResidue_surjective (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) :
    Function.Surjective (heightOneResidue (L := L) w)
proof:
:=
  CurveField.residue_comp_surjective _ (ofHeightOne L w).ne_top _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ker_heightOneResidue
statement:
theorem ker_heightOneResidue (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) :
    RingHom.ker (heightOneResidue (L := L) w) = w.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, heightOneResidue, RingHom.comp_apply, residue_eq_zero_iff,
    ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff, ← algebraMap_mem_nonunits_ofHeightOne_iff (L := L)]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_ofHeightOne
statement:
theorem ord_ofHeightOne (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) (x : L) :
    (ofHeightOne L w).ord x = -WithZero.log (w.valuation L x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (ofHeightOne L w).ord_eq_neg_log (w.valuation L) (fun y ↦ ?_)
    (HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_exists_uniformizer L w) x
  change y ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L w ↔ _
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finrank_quotient_eq_deg_ofHeightOne
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_deg_ofHeightOne (w : HeightOneSpectrum S) :
    finrank ℚ (S ⧸ w.asIdeal) = (ofHeightOne L w).deg
proof:
:= by
  let e : (S ⧸ w.asIdeal) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (ofHeightOne L w).ResidueField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := quotientEquivResidueFieldOfHeightOne w)
      (fun q ↦ (quotientEquivResidueFieldOfHeightOne (L := L) w).toRingHom.map_rat_algebraMap q)
  exact e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.intValuation_liesOver'
statement:
theorem intValuation_liesOver' (x : A) :
    v.intValuation x ^ (v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal) =
      w.intValuation (algebraMap A B x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp [Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver w.asIdeal v.ne_bot]
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity v hx,
    HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity w (by simpa),
    ← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span, WithZero.exp_neg, WithZero.exp_neg, inv_pow,
    ← WithZero.exp_nsmul, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, inv_inj, WithZero.exp_inj, ← Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_inj]
  refine multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some ?_ |>.symm
  replace hx : Ideal.span {x} ≠ ⊥ := by simp [hx]
  rw [Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul hx v.irreducible
      w.irreducible w.ne_bot,
    Nat.cast_mul, (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left v.prime hx).emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_liesOver'
statement:
theorem valuation_liesOver' (x : K) :
    v.valuation K x ^ v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal =
      w.valuation L (algebraMap K L x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := A) x
  simp [HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_of_algebraMap, div_pow,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L,
    intValuation_liesOver' v w]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem
statement:
theorem algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem (Q : Place L) (ht : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1)
    (s : chartRingExt K L t) : algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L s ∈ Q.1
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn Q.1.toSubring L := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn Q.1 L)
  have hle : (integralClosure (chartRing t) L).toSubring ≤ Q.1.toSubring :=
    Subring.integralClosure_le_iff.mpr fun r ↦ (Q.restrict K).algebraMap_chartRing_mem t ht r
  exact hle s.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_heightOneBelow_chartRingExt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_heightOneBelow_chartRingExt_iff (Q : Place L) (ht : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1)
    (r : chartRing t) :
    algebraMap (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t) r ∈
        (heightOneBelow Q.1 Q.ne_top (algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q ht)).asIdeal ↔
      algebraMap (chartRing t) K r ∈ (Q.restrict K).1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_heightOneBelow, mem_restrict_nonunits_iff]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.restrict_ofHeightOne
statement:
theorem restrict_ofHeightOne (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t))
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRingExt K L t)) [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] :
    (ofHeightOne L w).restrict K = ofChart t v
proof:
:= by
  set Q' := ofHeightOne L w
  have ht' : t ∈ (Q'.restrict K).1 :=
    algebraMap_mem_ofHeightOne w (algebraMap (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t)
      ⟨t, self_mem_chartRing t⟩)
  rw [← ofChart_toChart t (Q'.restrict K) ht']
  congr 1
  ext r
  rw [mem_toChart_iff, mem_restrict_nonunits_iff]
  change algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L (algebraMap (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t) r) ∈
    Q'.1.nonunits ↔ _
  rw [algebraMap_mem_nonunits_ofHeightOne_iff, Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := w.asIdeal)
    (p := v.asIdeal)]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx'_mul_inertiaDeg'
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_mul_inertiaDeg' (t : K) [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] (P : Place K)
    (htP : t ∈ P.1) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRingExt K L t))
    [hlo : w.asIdeal.LiesOver (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal] :
    Ideal.ramificationIdx' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal *
        Ideal.inertiaDeg' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal =
      (ofHeightOne L w).ramificationIdx K * (ofHeightOne L w).inertiaDeg K
proof:
:= by
  have hPv : ofChart t (P.toChart t htP) = P := ofChart_toChart t P htP
  have hQ' : (ofHeightOne L w).restrict K = P := (restrict_ofHeightOne t _ w).trans hPv
  
  have hram : Ideal.ramificationIdx' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal =
      (ofHeightOne L w).ramificationIdx K := by
    have h1 := valuation_liesOver' L (P.toChart t htP) w P.uniformizer
    have h2 : (ofHeightOne L w).ord (algebraMap K L P.uniformizer) =
        Ideal.ramificationIdx' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal := by
      rw [ord_ofHeightOne, ← h1, WithZero.log_pow, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_neg, ← ord_ofChart, hPv,
        ord_uniformizer, mul_one]
    have h3 := (ofHeightOne L w).ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := K) P.uniformizer
    rw [hQ', ord_uniformizer, mul_one, h2] at h3
    exact_mod_cast h3
  
  have hin : Ideal.inertiaDeg' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal =
      (ofHeightOne L w).inertiaDeg K := by
    have : Module.Free ℚ (chartRing t ⧸ (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal) :=
      Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
    haveI : (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal.IsMaximal := (P.toChart t htP).isMaximal
    letI := Ideal.Quotient.field (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal
    have : Module.Free (chartRing t ⧸ (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal)
        (chartRingExt K L t ⧸ w.asIdeal) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
    have h1 : Ideal.inertiaDeg' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal * P.deg =
        (ofHeightOne L w).deg := by
      have hdegP : P.deg = finrank ℚ (chartRing t ⧸ (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal) := by
        rw [finrank_quotient_eq_deg t (P.toChart t htP), hPv]
      rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg'_algebraMap, hdegP, mul_comm,
        Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (chartRing t ⧸ (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal)]
      exact finrank_quotient_eq_deg_ofHeightOne w
    have h2 := (ofHeightOne L w).deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul (K := K)
    rw [hQ'] at h2
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right P.deg_pos (h1.trans h2)
  rw [hram, hin]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg (P : Place K) :
    ∑ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P).toFinset,
      Q.ramificationIdx K * Q.inertiaDeg K = finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htP⟩ := P.exists_transcendental_mem
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  set v := P.toChart t htP with hv
  have hPv : ofChart t v = P := ofChart_toChart t P htP
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isMaximal
  have key := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (chartRingExt K L t) K L v.ne_bot
  rw [← key]
  symm
  have hfib : ∀ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P).toFinset, Q.restrict K = P :=
    fun Q hQ ↦ by
      have h : Q ∈ {Q : Place L | Q.restrict K = P} := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hQ
      exact h
  have htQ : ∀ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P).toFinset, t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1 :=
    fun Q hQ ↦ by rw [hfib Q hQ]; exact htP
  have hmemP : ∀ P' ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset v.asIdeal (chartRingExt K L t),
      P' ∈ v.asIdeal.primesOver (chartRingExt K L t) :=
    fun P' hP' ↦ (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff v.ne_bot _).mp hP'
  refine Finset.sum_bij'
    (fun P' hP' ↦ ofHeightOne L (⟨P', (hmemP P' hP').1,
      Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver v.ne_bot (hmemP P' hP')⟩ :
        HeightOneSpectrum (chartRingExt K L t)))
    (fun Q hQ ↦ (heightOneBelow Q.1 Q.ne_top
      (algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q (htQ Q hQ))).asIdeal) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro P' hP'
    have : P'.LiesOver v.asIdeal := (hmemP P' hP').2
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← hPv]
    exact restrict_ofHeightOne t v _
  · intro Q hQ
    rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff v.ne_bot]
    refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    ext r
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_heightOneBelow_chartRingExt_iff t Q (htQ Q hQ), hfib Q hQ, hv,
      mem_toChart_iff]
    exact Iff.rfl
  · intro P' hP'
    exact congrArg HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal (heightOneBelow_ofHeightOne (L := L) _)
  · intro Q hQ
    exact ofHeightOne_heightOneBelow Q _
  · intro P' hP'
    have : P'.LiesOver v.asIdeal := (hmemP P' hP').2
    exact ramificationIdx'_mul_inertiaDeg' t P htP ⟨P', (hmemP P' hP').1,
      Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver v.ne_bot (hmemP P' hP')⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.sum_ramificationIdx_mul_deg
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdx_mul_deg (P : Place K) :
    ∑ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P).toFinset, Q.ramificationIdx K * Q.deg =
      finrank K L * P.deg
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg P, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Q hQ ↦ ?_
  have h : Q ∈ {Q : Place L | Q.restrict K = P} := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hQ
  rw [Q.deg_eq_inertiaDeg_mul (K := K), show Q.restrict K = P from h, mul_assoc]

name: Belyi.CurveField.transcendental_algebraMap
statement:
theorem transcendental_algebraMap {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    Transcendental ℚ (algebraMap K L t)
proof:
:=
  (transcendental_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap K L).injective).mpr ht

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Place.residue_algebraMap (Q : Place L) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ (Q.restrict K).1) :
    Q.residue ⟨algebraMap K L x, hx⟩ = Q.residueFieldMap K ((Q.restrict K).residue ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Place.residueFieldMap_residue]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.resMinpoly_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Place.resMinpoly_algebraMap (Q : Place L) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ (Q.restrict K).1) :
    Q.resMinpoly (x := algebraMap K L x) hx = (Q.restrict K).resMinpoly hx
proof:
:= by
  rw [Place.resMinpoly, Place.resMinpoly, Q.residue_algebraMap hx]
  exact minpoly.algHom_eq (Q.residueFieldMap K).toRatAlgHom (Q.residueFieldMap K).injective _

name: Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ramIdx_algebraMap {t : K} (Q : Place L) :
    ramIdx (algebraMap K L t) Q = Q.ramificationIdx K * ramIdx t (Q.restrict K)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : (ramIdx (algebraMap K L t) Q : ℤ) =
      Q.ramificationIdx K * (ramIdx t (Q.restrict K) : ℤ) by exact_mod_cast h
  by_cases h : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1
  · have h' : algebraMap K L t ∈ Q.1 := h
    rw [ramIdx_of_mem h', ramIdx_of_mem h, Q.resMinpoly_algebraMap h, aeval_algebraMap_apply,
      Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul]
  · have h' : algebraMap K L t ∉ Q.1 := h
    rw [ramIdx_of_notMem h', ramIdx_of_notMem h, Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul]
    ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.one_lt_ramIdx_algebraMap
statement:
theorem one_lt_ramIdx_algebraMap {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) {Q : Place L}
    (hQ : 1 < Q.ramificationIdx K) : 1 < ramIdx (algebraMap K L t) Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramIdx_algebraMap]
  have := ramIdx_pos ht (Q.restrict K)
  nlinarith

name: Belyi.CurveField.finite_setOf_one_lt_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_one_lt_ramificationIdx :
    {Q : Place L | 1 < Q.ramificationIdx K}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  exact (finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx (transcendental_algebraMap (L := L) ht)).subset
    fun Q hQ ↦ one_lt_ramIdx_algebraMap ht hQ

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.finite_setOf_restrict_mem_support
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_restrict_mem_support (D : Divisor K) :
    {Q : Place L | Q.restrict K ∈ D.support}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (D.support.finite_toSet.preimage' fun P _ ↦ Place.finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P :)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.pullback_apply
statement:
theorem pullback_apply (D : Divisor K) (Q : Place L) :
    pullback L D Q = Q.ramificationIdx K * D (Q.restrict K)
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.pullback_add
statement: theorem pullback_add (D E : Divisor K) : pullback L (D + E) = pullback L D + pullback L E
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  simp only [pullback_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_pullback
statement: theorem deg_pullback (D : Divisor K) : (pullback L D).deg = finrank K L * D.deg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fib : Place K → Finset (Place L) := fun P ↦
    (Place.finite_setOf_restrict_eq (L := L) K P).toFinset
  have hfib : ∀ P Q, Q ∈ fib P ↔ Q.restrict K = P := fun P Q ↦ by
    simp only [fib, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hsupp : (pullback L D).support ⊆ D.support.biUnion fib := by
    intro Q hQ
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, pullback_apply] at hQ
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨Q.restrict K, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (right_ne_zero_of_mul hQ),
      (hfib _ _).mpr rfl⟩
  have hdisj : (D.support : Set (Place K)).PairwiseDisjoint fib := by
    intro P _ P' _ hPP'
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun Q hQ hQ' ↦ hPP' ?_
    rw [← (hfib _ _).mp hQ, (hfib _ _).mp hQ']
  rw [deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsupp, Finset.sum_biUnion hdisj,
    deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset D subset_rfl, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P _ ↦ ?_
  have hsum := Place.sum_ramificationIdx_mul_deg (L := L) P
  have hsum' : ∑ Q ∈ fib P, ((Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) * Q.deg) = finrank K L * P.deg := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  calc ∑ Q ∈ fib P, pullback L D Q * (Q.deg : ℤ)
      = ∑ Q ∈ fib P, D P * ((Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) * Q.deg) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Q hQ ↦ by
          rw [pullback_apply, (hfib _ _).mp hQ]
          ring
    _ = finrank K L * (D P * P.deg) := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum']
      ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.relRamDiv_apply
statement: theorem relRamDiv_apply (Q : Place L) : relRamDiv K L Q = (Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) - 1
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_relRamDiv
statement:
theorem deg_relRamDiv : (relRamDiv K L).deg =
    ∑ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_one_lt_ramificationIdx K L).toFinset,
      ((Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) - 1) * Q.deg
proof:
:= by
  refine deg_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun Q hQ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, relRamDiv_apply] at hQ
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have := Q.ramificationIdx_pos (K := K)
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.canonicalDiv_algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem canonicalDiv_algebraMap_apply {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) (Q : Place L) :
    canonicalDiv (algebraMap K L t) Q =
      Q.ramificationIdx K * canonicalDiv t (Q.restrict K) + ((Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := ramIdx_algebraMap (t := t) Q
  by_cases h : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1
  · have h' : algebraMap K L t ∈ Q.1 := h
    rw [canonicalDiv_apply_of_mem (transcendental_algebraMap ht) h',
      canonicalDiv_apply_of_mem ht h, hr]
    push_cast
    ring
  · have h' : algebraMap K L t ∉ Q.1 := h
    rw [canonicalDiv_apply_of_notMem h', canonicalDiv_apply_of_notMem h, hr]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.canonicalDiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem canonicalDiv_algebraMap {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    canonicalDiv (algebraMap K L t) = pullback L (canonicalDiv t) + relRamDiv K L
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  rw [Finsupp.add_apply, canonicalDiv_algebraMap_apply ht, pullback_apply, relRamDiv_apply]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_canonicalDiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem deg_canonicalDiv_algebraMap {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    (canonicalDiv (algebraMap K L t)).deg = finrank K L * (canonicalDiv t).deg +
      ∑ Q ∈ (finite_setOf_one_lt_ramificationIdx K L).toFinset,
        ((Q.ramificationIdx K : ℤ) - 1) * Q.deg
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalDiv_algebraMap ht, deg_add, deg_pullback, deg_relRamDiv]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf
statement:
theorem ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf {φ : K} {P : Place K} (h : ¬ P.IsCuspOf φ) :
    P.ord φ = 0 ∧ P.ord (1 - φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsCuspOf, not_or, not_not, not_lt] at h
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  rw [← neg_sub, ord_neg]
  rcases eq_or_ne (φ - 1) 0 with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0, ord_zero]
  · have hφ : φ ∈ P.1 := by
      rcases eq_or_ne φ 0 with rfl | hφ0
      · exact P.1.zero_mem
      · exact P.mem_of_ord_nonneg h.1.ge
    have := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (sub_mem hφ P.1.one_mem)
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mul_ord_eq_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem mul_ord_eq_of_pow_eq {w : L} {a : K} (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a) (Q : Place L) :
    N * Q.ord w = Q.ramificationIdx K * (Q.restrict K).ord a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul, ← hw, ord_pow]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_ord_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem mem_ord_eq_zero_aux {w : L} {a : K} (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a)
    (Q : Place L) (ha : (Q.restrict K).ord a = 0) : w ∈ Q.1 ∧ Q.ord w = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(mem_of_pow_eq hN hw Q ha).1, ?_⟩
  have hm := mul_ord_eq_of_pow_eq hw Q
  rw [ha, mul_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hm
  exact hm.resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast hN.ne')

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.le_ramificationIdx_mul_abs_ord
statement:
theorem le_ramificationIdx_mul_abs_ord (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ) (Q : Place L)
    (h : (Q.restrict K).ord φ ≠ 0) :
    (N : ℤ) ≤ Q.ramificationIdx K * |(Q.restrict K).ord φ|
proof:
:= by
  have hm := mul_ord_eq_of_pow_eq hu Q
  have he : (0 : ℤ) < Q.ramificationIdx K := by exact_mod_cast Q.ramificationIdx_pos
  have hu0 : Q.ord u ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at hm
    exact hm.elim he.ne' h
  have h1 : 1 ≤ |Q.ord u| := Int.one_le_abs hu0
  have h2 := congrArg abs hm
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg N), abs_of_pos he] at h2
  rw [← h2]
  nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg N]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.le_ramificationIdx_mul_ord_sub_one
statement:
theorem le_ramificationIdx_mul_ord_sub_one (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (Q : Place L)
    (h : 0 < (Q.restrict K).ord (φ - 1)) :
    (N : ℤ) ≤ Q.ramificationIdx K * (Q.restrict K).ord (φ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : v ^ N = algebraMap K L (1 - φ) := by rw [hv, map_sub, map_one]
  have hm := mul_ord_eq_of_pow_eq hv' Q
  rw [← neg_sub, ord_neg] at hm
  have he : (0 : ℤ) < Q.ramificationIdx K := by exact_mod_cast Q.ramificationIdx_pos
  have hpos : 0 < (N : ℤ) * Q.ord v := by rw [hm]; positivity
  have hv0 : 0 < Q.ord v := pos_of_mul_pos_right hpos (Int.natCast_nonneg N)
  rw [← hm]
  nlinarith

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.gen_pow_eq
statement:
theorem gen_pow_eq (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ) :
    (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K u) ^ N = algebraMap K K⟮u⟯ φ
proof:
:=
  (algebraMap K⟮u⟯ L).injective (by
    rw [map_pow, IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen, hu,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply])

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.adjoin_adjoinSimple_gen_eq_top
statement: theorem adjoin_adjoinSimple_gen_eq_top (u : L) : K⟮IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K u⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply IntermediateField.lift_injective
  rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple, IntermediateField.lift_top]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.pow_eq_algebraMap_sub
statement:
theorem pow_eq_algebraMap_sub (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) :
    v ^ N = algebraMap K⟮u⟯ L (1 - algebraMap K K⟮u⟯ φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hv, map_sub, map_one, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.adjoin_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_adjoin_eq_top (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {u, v} = ⊤) :
    (K⟮u⟯)⟮v⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IntermediateField.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff (K := K),
    IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_adjoin_simple]
  exact hgen

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_and_ord_eq_zero_u
statement:
theorem mem_and_ord_eq_zero_u (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ) (Q : Place L)
    (hQ : ¬ (Q.restrict K).IsCuspOf φ) : u ∈ Q.1 ∧ Q.ord u = 0
proof:
:=
  mem_ord_eq_zero_aux hN hu Q (ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf hQ).1

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_and_ord_eq_zero_v
statement:
theorem mem_and_ord_eq_zero_v (hN : 0 < N) (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (Q : Place L)
    (hQ : ¬ (Q.restrict K).IsCuspOf φ) : v ∈ Q.1 ∧ Q.ord v = 0
proof:
:=
  mem_ord_eq_zero_aux hN (by rw [hv, map_sub, map_one]) Q (ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf hQ).2

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_not_isCuspOf
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_not_isCuspOf (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ)
    (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {u, v} = ⊤)
    (Q : Place L) (hQ : ¬ (Q.restrict K).IsCuspOf φ) : Q.ramificationIdx K = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf hQ
  rw [ramificationIdx_tower (M := K⟮u⟯)]
  have e1 : (Q.restrict K⟮u⟯).ramificationIdx K = 1 :=
    ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_pow_eq hN (gen_pow_eq hu) (adjoin_adjoinSimple_gen_eq_top u) _
      (by rw [restrict_restrict]; exact h1)
  have e2 : Q.ramificationIdx K⟮u⟯ = 1 := by
    refine ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_pow_eq hN (pow_eq_algebraMap_sub hv)
      (adjoin_adjoin_eq_top hgen) Q ?_
    rw [← map_one (algebraMap K K⟮u⟯), ← map_sub, ord_algebraMap_eq_mul, restrict_restrict, h2,
      mul_zero]
  rw [e1, e2]

name: Belyi.CurveField.restrictScalars_adjoin_adjoin_eq
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_adjoin_adjoin_eq {F E : Type*} [Field F]
    [Field E] [Algebra F E] {F₀ F₁ : IntermediateField F E} {a b : E}
    (h : F₁ = (IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a}).restrictScalars F) :
    (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}).restrictScalars F =
      (IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a, b}).restrictScalars F
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ z, z ∈ F₁ ↔ z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a} := fun z ↦ by
    rw [h, IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars]
  have h01 : F₀ ≤ F₁ := fun z hz ↦ (hmem z).mpr
    (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem (IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a}) ⟨z, hz⟩)
  have ha : a ∈ F₁ := (hmem a).mpr (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self F₀ a)
  have h1 : F₁ ≤ (IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a, b}).restrictScalars F := fun z hz ↦
    (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars F).mpr (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono _ _ _
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert a {b})) ((hmem z).mp hz))
  have h2 : F₀ ≤ (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}).restrictScalars F := fun z hz ↦
    (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars F).mpr
      (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}) ⟨z, h01 hz⟩)
  refine le_antisymm (fun z hz ↦ ?_) (fun z hz ↦ ?_)
  · have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b} ≤ IntermediateField.extendScalars h1 := by
      rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      change b ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a, b}).restrictScalars F
      exact (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars F).mpr
        (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin F₀ _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem a (Set.mem_singleton b)))
    exact hle hz
  · have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ {a, b} ≤ IntermediateField.extendScalars h2 := by
      rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff, Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      constructor
      · change a ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}).restrictScalars F
        exact (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars F).mpr
          (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}) ⟨a, ha⟩)
      · change b ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin F₁ {b}).restrictScalars F
        exact (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars F).mpr
          (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self F₁ b)
    exact hle hz

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.mem_u
statement:
theorem mem_u (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ) (y : QbarPoint L)
    (hy : ¬ (y.restrict K).P.IsCuspOf φ) : u ∈ y.P.1
proof:
:=
  (Place.mem_and_ord_eq_zero_u hN hu y.P hy).1

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.mem_v
statement:
theorem mem_v (hN : 0 < N) (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (y : QbarPoint L)
    (hy : ¬ (y.restrict K).P.IsCuspOf φ) : v ∈ y.P.1
proof:
:=
  (Place.mem_and_ord_eq_zero_v hN hv y.P hy).1

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.mem_φ
statement: theorem mem_φ (y : QbarPoint K) (hy : ¬ y.P.IsCuspOf φ) : φ ∈ y.P.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne φ 0 with rfl | h0
  · exact y.P.1.zero_mem
  · exact y.P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (Place.ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf hy).1.ge

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_u_pow
statement:
theorem eval_u_pow (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ) (y : QbarPoint L)
    (hy : ¬ (y.restrict K).P.IsCuspOf φ) :
    y.eval u (mem_u hN hu y hy) ^ N = (y.restrict K).eval φ (mem_φ _ hy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← y.eval_pow, y.eval_congr hu, eval_restrict]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_v_pow
statement:
theorem eval_v_pow (hN : 0 < N) (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (y : QbarPoint L)
    (hy : ¬ (y.restrict K).P.IsCuspOf φ) :
    y.eval v (mem_v hN hv y hy) ^ N = 1 - (y.restrict K).eval φ (mem_φ _ hy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← y.eval_pow, y.eval_congr hv, y.eval_sub y.P.1.one_mem (mem_φ (y.restrict K) hy), eval_one,
    eval_restrict]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.fieldOf_eq_adjoin_kummer
statement:
theorem fieldOf_eq_adjoin_kummer (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ)
    (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {u, v} = ⊤)
    (y : QbarPoint L) (hy : ¬ (y.restrict K).P.IsCuspOf φ) :
    y.fieldOf = (IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
      {y.eval u (mem_u hN hu y hy), y.eval v (mem_v hN hv y hy)}).restrictScalars ℚ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Place.ord_eq_zero_of_not_isCuspOf hy
  have H2 := fieldOf_eq_adjoin_of_pow_eq hN (Place.pow_eq_algebraMap_sub (u := u) hv)
    (Place.adjoin_adjoin_eq_top hgen) y (by
      rw [← map_one (algebraMap K K⟮u⟯), ← map_sub, Place.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul,
        Place.restrict_restrict]
      exact mul_eq_zero_of_right _ h2)
  have H1 := fieldOf_eq_adjoin_of_pow_eq hN (Place.gen_pow_eq hu)
    (Place.adjoin_adjoinSimple_gen_eq_top u) (y.restrict K⟮u⟯)
    (by rw [restrict_P, Place.restrict_restrict]; exact h1)
  have hF0 : ((y.restrict K⟮u⟯).restrict K).fieldOf = (y.restrict K).fieldOf := by
    rw [restrict_restrict]
  have hev : (y.restrict K⟮u⟯).eval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K u)
      (Place.mem_of_pow_eq hN (Place.gen_pow_eq hu) (y.restrict K⟮u⟯).P (by
        rw [restrict_P, Place.restrict_restrict]; exact h1)).1 = y.eval u (mem_u hN hu y hy) := by
    rw [eval_restrict]; rfl
  rw [hev, hF0] at H1
  rw [H2]
  exact restrictScalars_adjoin_adjoin_eq H1

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.exists_restrict_eq_kummer
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq_kummer (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ)
    (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : ¬ x.P.IsCuspOf φ) :
    ∃ (y : QbarPoint L) (hy : y.restrict K = x), y.deg ≤ finrank K L * x.deg ∧
      y.eval u (mem_u hN hu y (hy ▸ hx)) ^ N = x.eval φ (mem_φ x hx) ∧
      y.eval v (mem_v hN hv y (hy ▸ hx)) ^ N = 1 - x.eval φ (mem_φ x hx)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl, hdeg⟩ := exists_restrict_eq (L := L) x
  exact ⟨y, rfl, hdeg, eval_u_pow hN hu y hx, eval_v_pow hN hv y hx⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.adjoin_residue_kummer_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_residue_kummer_eq_top (hN : 0 < N) (hu : u ^ N = algebraMap K L φ)
    (hv : v ^ N = 1 - algebraMap K L φ) (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {u, v} = ⊤)
    (Q : Place L) (hQ : ¬ (Q.restrict K).IsCuspOf φ) :
    letI
proof:
:= Q.residueAlgebra K
    IntermediateField.adjoin (Q.restrict K).ResidueField
      {Q.residue ⟨u, (mem_and_ord_eq_zero_u hN hu Q hQ).1⟩,
        Q.residue ⟨v, (mem_and_ord_eq_zero_v hN hv Q hQ).1⟩} = ⊤ := by
  letI := Q.residueAlgebra K
  set E := IntermediateField.adjoin (Q.restrict K).ResidueField
    {Q.residue ⟨u, (mem_and_ord_eq_zero_u hN hu Q hQ).1⟩,
      Q.residue ⟨v, (mem_and_ord_eq_zero_v hN hv Q hQ).1⟩}
  let σ : Q.ResidueField →+* AlgebraicClosure ℚ :=
    (IsAlgClosed.lift (R := ℚ) (S := Q.ResidueField) (M := AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).toRingHom
  let y : QbarPoint L := ⟨Q, σ⟩
  have H := QbarPoint.fieldOf_eq_adjoin_kummer hN hu hv hgen y hQ
  let T : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) :=
    (E.toSubfield.map σ).toIntermediateField fun q ↦ by
      rw [eq_ratCast]; exact SubfieldClass.ratCast_mem _ q
  have hF0 : (y.restrict K).fieldOf ≤ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨algebraMap (Q.restrict K).ResidueField Q.ResidueField a, E.algebraMap_mem a, rfl⟩
  have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
      {y.eval u (QbarPoint.mem_u hN hu y hQ), y.eval v (QbarPoint.mem_v hN hv y hQ)} ≤
        IntermediateField.extendScalars hF0 := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff, Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨_, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _), rfl⟩,
      ⟨_, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl), rfl⟩⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro z _
  have hz : σ z ∈ y.fieldOf := ⟨z, rfl⟩
  rw [H] at hz
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hσ⟩ := hle hz
  rwa [σ.injective hσ] at hz'

name: Belyi.CurveField.isCurveField_of_finite
statement:
theorem isCurveField_of_finite (K F : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] [IsCurveField K]
    [Field F] [CharZero F] [Algebra K F] [FiniteDimensional K F] : IsCurveField F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  have hb := (isTranscendenceBasis ht).algebraMap_comp (A := F)
  set s := algebraMap K F t
  have hs : Transcendental ℚ s := by
    have := hb.1.transcendental ()
    simpa using this
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ⟮s⟯ F := by
    have := hb.isAlgebraic_field
    rwa [Function.comp_def, Set.range_const] at this
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨S0, hS0⟩ := exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top K
  obtain ⟨S1, hS1⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top (F := K) (E := F)
  classical
  let S : Finset F := S0.image (algebraMap K F) ∪ S1
  have hK : ∀ c : K, algebraMap K F c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S : Set F) := by
    intro c
    have hc : c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S0 : Set K) := hS0 ▸ trivial
    have := (IntermediateField.mem_map (S := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S0 : Set K))
      (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ K F)).mpr ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_map] at this
    refine IntermediateField.adjoin.mono ℚ _ _ ?_ this
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hy))
  have hS : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    let E : IntermediateField K F :=
      (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S : Set F)).toSubfield.toIntermediateField hK
    have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin K (S1 : Set F) ≤ E := by
      rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
      intro y hy
      exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ (by simp [S, hy])
    rw [hS1] at hle
    exact hle (IntermediateField.mem_top (x := x))
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ⟮s⟯ (S : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff (K := ℚ), eq_top_iff, ← hS,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _
  have := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin (K := ℚ⟮s⟯) (S := (S : Set F))
    (fun x _ ↦ (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x).isIntegral)
  rw [htop] at this
  exact IntermediateField.topEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.restrict_restrict
statement: theorem Place.restrict_restrict (Q : Place L) : (Q.restrict M).restrict K = Q.restrict K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_restrict_iff, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx_tower
statement:
theorem Place.ramificationIdx_tower (Q : Place L) :
    Q.ramificationIdx K = Q.ramificationIdx M * (Q.restrict M).ramificationIdx K
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := K) (Q.restrict K).uniformizer
  rw [ord_uniformizer, mul_one, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K M L,
    Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := M), (Q.restrict M).ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := K),
    restrict_restrict, ord_uniformizer, mul_one] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1.symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.restrict_restrict
statement:
theorem QbarPoint.restrict_restrict (y : QbarPoint L) :
    (y.restrict M).restrict K = y.restrict K
proof:
:= by
  refine QbarPoint.ext' (Place.restrict_restrict y.P) fun a ↦ ?_
  have h1 := (y.restrict M).eval_restrict (K := K) a.1 a.2
  have h2 := y.eval_restrict (K := K) a.1 (by
    change algebraMap K L a.1 ∈ y.P.1
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K M L]; exact a.2)
  change ((y.restrict M).restrict K).eval a.1 a.2 = (y.restrict K).eval a.1 _
  rw [h1, h2, (y.eval_restrict (K := M) _ _)]
  exact y.eval_congr (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K M L a.1).symm _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx (P : Place K)
    (htP : t ∈ P.1) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRingExt K L t))
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal] :
    Ideal.ramificationIdx' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal =
      (ofHeightOne L w).ramificationIdx K
proof:
:= by
  have hPv : ofChart t (P.toChart t htP) = P := ofChart_toChart t P htP
  have hQ' : (ofHeightOne L w).restrict K = P := (restrict_ofHeightOne t _ w).trans hPv
  have h1 := valuation_liesOver' L (P.toChart t htP) w P.uniformizer
  have h2 : (ofHeightOne L w).ord (algebraMap K L P.uniformizer) =
      Ideal.ramificationIdx' (P.toChart t htP).asIdeal w.asIdeal := by
    rw [ord_ofHeightOne, ← h1, WithZero.log_pow, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_neg, ← ord_ofChart, hPv,
      ord_uniformizer, mul_one]
  have h3 := (ofHeightOne L w).ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := K) P.uniformizer
  rw [hQ', ord_uniformizer, mul_one, h2] at h3
  exact_mod_cast h3

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.liesOver_heightOneBelow
statement:
theorem liesOver_heightOneBelow (Q : Place L) (htQ : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1) :
    (heightOneBelow (R := chartRingExt K L t) Q.1 Q.ne_top
      (algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q htQ)).asIdeal.LiesOver
      ((Q.restrict K).toChart t htQ).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  ext r
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_heightOneBelow_chartRingExt_iff t Q htQ, mem_toChart_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_aeval_derivative
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_aeval_derivative (x : chartRingExt K L t)
    (hx : Algebra.adjoin K {algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L x} = ⊤)
    (Q : Place L) (htQ : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1)
    (hunit : algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L
      (aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x))) ∉ Q.1.nonunits) :
    Q.ramificationIdx K = 1
proof:
:= by
  set w := heightOneBelow (R := chartRingExt K L t) Q.1 Q.ne_top
    (algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q htQ)
  set v := (Q.restrict K).toChart t htQ
  haveI := liesOver_heightOneBelow t Q htQ
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isMaximal
  have he := ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx t (Q.restrict K) htQ w
  rw [ofHeightOne_heightOneBelow] at he
  rw [← he]
  generalize hE : Ideal.ramificationIdx' v.asIdeal w.asIdeal = e at he
  have hpos : e ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he]; exact (Q.ramificationIdx_pos).ne'
  have hdvd : w.asIdeal ^ e ∣
      v.asIdeal.map (algebraMap (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t)) :=
    hE ▸ Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr Ideal.le_pow_ramificationIdx'
  have hdiff := pow_sub_one_dvd_differentIdeal_aux (chartRing t) K L w.asIdeal hpos v.ne_bot hdvd
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : w.asIdeal ∣ differentIdeal (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t) :=
    (dvd_pow_self _ (by omega)).trans hdiff
  have hmem := aeval_derivative_mem_differentIdeal (chartRing t) K L x hx
  exact hunit (mem_heightOneBelow.mp (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp h1 hmem))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_mem_conductor_notMem
statement:
theorem exists_mem_conductor_notMem (x : chartRingExt K L t)
    (hx : Algebra.adjoin K {algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L x} = ⊤)
    (Q : Place L) (htQ : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1)
    (hunit : algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L
      (aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x))) ∉ Q.1.nonunits) :
    ∃ c ∈ conductor (chartRing t) x, algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L c ∉ Q.1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  have hcd := conductor_mul_differentIdeal (chartRing t) K L x hx
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hle : conductor (chartRing t) x * differentIdeal (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t) ≤
      (heightOneBelow (R := chartRingExt K L t) Q.1 Q.ne_top
        (algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q htQ)).asIdeal :=
    Ideal.mul_le_right.trans fun c hc ↦ mem_heightOneBelow.mpr (h c hc)
  rw [hcd] at hle
  exact hunit (mem_heightOneBelow.mp (hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.fieldOf_le_adjoin_of_aeval_derivative
statement:
theorem fieldOf_le_adjoin_of_aeval_derivative (x : Place.chartRingExt K L t)
    (hx : Algebra.adjoin K {algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L x} = ⊤)
    (y : QbarPoint L) (htQ : t ∈ (y.P.restrict K).1)
    (hunit : algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L
      (aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x))) ∉ y.P.1.nonunits) :
    y.fieldOf ≤ (IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
      {y.eval (algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L x)
        (Place.algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t y.P htQ x)}).restrictScalars ℚ
proof:
:= by
  have hB := Place.algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t y.P htQ
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcw⟩ := Place.exists_mem_conductor_notMem t x hx y.P htQ hunit
  
  have hev : ∀ r ∈ Algebra.adjoin (chartRing t) {x},
      y.eval (algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L r) (hB r) ∈
        IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
          {y.eval (algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L x) (hB x)} := by
    intro r hr
    induction hr using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem r hr =>
      obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hr
      exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
    | algebraMap a =>
      have hmem : algebraMap (chartRing t) K a ∈ (y.restrict K).P.1 :=
        (y.P.restrict K).algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htQ a
      have h1 := y.eval_restrict (algebraMap (chartRing t) K a) hmem
      have h2 : algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L
          (algebraMap (chartRing t) (Place.chartRingExt K L t) a) =
          algebraMap K L (algebraMap (chartRing t) K a) := rfl
      rw [y.eval_congr h2, ← h1]
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _
        (⟨_, (y.restrict K).eval_mem_fieldOf hmem⟩ : (y.restrict K).fieldOf)
    | add r s _ _ hr hs =>
      rw [y.eval_congr (map_add _ r s), y.eval_add (hB r) (hB s)]
      exact add_mem hr hs
    | mul r s _ _ hr hs =>
      rw [y.eval_congr (map_mul _ r s), y.eval_mul (hB r) (hB s)]
      exact mul_mem hr hs
  rintro _ ⟨r0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ :=
    CurveField.residue_comp_surjective (R := Place.chartRingExt K L t) y.P.1 y.P.ne_top hB r0
  change y.eval (algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L b) (hB b) ∈ _
  have hc0 : y.eval (algebraMap (Place.chartRingExt K L t) L c) (hB c) ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun h ↦ hcw (ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mpr
      ((y.eval_eq_zero_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (hB c)).mp h))
  have hcb := hev _ ((mem_conductor_iff.mp hc) b)
  have hcc := hev _ (by simpa using (mem_conductor_iff.mp hc) 1)
  rw [y.eval_congr (map_mul _ c b), y.eval_mul (hB c) (hB b)] at hcb
  have := div_mem hcb hcc
  rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc0] at this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_chart_mem
statement:
theorem exists_chart_mem (P : Place K) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ t ∈ P.1 ∧ a ∈ chartRing t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hta : Transcendental ℚ a
  · exact ⟨a, hta, ha, self_mem_chartRing a⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, htP⟩ := P.exists_transcendental_mem
    refine ⟨t, ht, htP, ?_⟩
    have : IsIntegral ℚ a := (not_not.mp hta).isIntegral
    exact this.tower_top

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem mem_of_pow_eq (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a) (Q : Place L)
    (ha : (Q.restrict K).ord a = 0) : w ∈ Q.1 ∧ (w = 0 ∨ Q.ord w = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne w 0 with rfl | hw0
  · exact ⟨Q.1.zero_mem, Or.inl rfl⟩
  have h := Q.ord_algebraMap_eq_mul (K := K) a
  rw [← hw, ord_pow, ha, mul_zero] at h
  have h0 : Q.ord w = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · exact absurd h (by exact_mod_cast hN.ne')
    · exact h
  exact ⟨Q.mem_of_ord_nonneg h0.ge, Or.inr h0⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_chart_aeval_derivative
statement:
theorem exists_chart_aeval_derivative (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a)
    (Q : Place L) (ha : (Q.restrict K).ord a = 0) :
    ∃ (t : K) (_ : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)) (_ : t ∈ (Q.restrict K).1)
      (x : chartRingExt K L t), algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L x = w ∧
      algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L
        (aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x))) ∉ Q.1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  have haP : a ∈ (Q.restrict K).1 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha0
    · exact (Q.restrict K).1.zero_mem
    · exact (Q.restrict K).mem_of_ord_nonneg ha.ge
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htQ, hat⟩ := (Q.restrict K).exists_chart_mem haP
  haveI : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ a' : chartRing t, algebraMap (chartRing t) L a' = algebraMap K L a :=
    ⟨⟨a, hat⟩, rfl⟩
  have hp : aeval w (X ^ N - C a') = 0 := by
