    simp only [aeval_sub, aeval_X_pow, aeval_C]
    rw [ha', hw, sub_self]
  have hint : IsIntegral (chartRing t) w :=
    ⟨X ^ N - C a', monic_X_pow_sub_C a' hN.ne', hp⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxw⟩ : ∃ x : chartRingExt K L t, algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L x = w :=
    ⟨⟨w, hint⟩, rfl⟩
  have hinj := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (chartRingExt K L t) L
  have hinjA : Function.Injective (algebraMap (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t)) := by
    intro b c hbc
    have := congrArg (algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L) hbc
    exact Subtype.ext ((algebraMap K L).injective this)
  refine ⟨t, inferInstance, htQ, x, hxw, ?_⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne w 0 with hw0 | hw0'
  · 
    have hx0 : x = 0 := hinj (by rw [hxw, hw0, map_zero])
    have hm : minpoly (chartRing t) (0 : chartRingExt K L t) = X - C 0 := by
      have := minpoly.eq_X_sub_C_of_algebraMap_inj (A := chartRing t)
        (B := chartRingExt K L t) 0 hinjA
      rwa [map_zero] at this
    rw [hx0, hm, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero, map_one, map_one]
    rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff, map_one]
    exact lt_irrefl 1
  have hwu : Q.ord w = 0 := ((mem_of_pow_eq hN hw Q ha).2.resolve_left hw0')
  have hxint : IsIntegral (chartRing t) x := IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral (chartRing t) L x
  have hpx : aeval x (X ^ N - C a') = 0 := by
    apply hinj
    rw [← aeval_algebraMap_apply, hxw, hp, map_zero]
  haveI : IsIntegrallyClosed (chartRing t) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsDomain (chartRingExt K L t) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.IsTorsionFree (chartRing t) (chartRingExt K L t) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_dvd (R := chartRing t) (S := chartRingExt K L t)
    hxint hpx
  have h1 : aeval x (derivative (X ^ N - C a')) = (N : chartRingExt K L t) * x ^ (N - 1) := by
    rw [derivative_sub, derivative_C, sub_zero, derivative_X_pow, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X_pow,
      map_natCast]
  have h2 : aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x * h)) =
      aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x)) * aeval x h := by
    rw [derivative_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, minpoly.aeval (chartRing t) x, zero_mul,
      add_zero]
  rw [hh, h2] at h1
  have hL := congrArg (algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L) h1
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_natCast, map_pow, hxw] at hL
  have hH := algebraMap_chartRingExt_mem t Q htQ (aeval x h)
  set G := algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L (aeval x (derivative (minpoly (chartRing t) x)))
  set H := algebraMap (chartRingExt K L t) L (aeval x h)
  have hne : (N : L) * w ^ (N - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne') (pow_ne_zero _ hw0')
  have hord : Q.ord ((N : L) * w ^ (N - 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [Q.ord_mul (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne') (pow_ne_zero _ hw0'), ord_natCast, ord_pow, hwu]
    simp
  intro hG
  rw [← hL] at hne hord
  have hG0 : G ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
  have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  have hGpos : 0 < Q.ord G := (Q.ord_pos_iff).mpr ⟨hG0, hG⟩
  have hHnn : 0 ≤ Q.ord H := Q.ord_nonneg_of_mem hH
  rw [Q.ord_mul hG0 hH0] at hord
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebra_adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem algebra_adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top (hgen : K⟮w⟯ = ⊤) :
    Algebra.adjoin K {w} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := K) w)
  rw [hgen, IntermediateField.top_toSubalgebra] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_pow_eq (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a)
    (hgen : K⟮w⟯ = ⊤) (Q : Place L) (ha : (Q.restrict K).ord a = 0) :
    Q.ramificationIdx K = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, _, htQ, x, hxw, hunit⟩ := exists_chart_aeval_derivative hN hw Q ha
  refine ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_aeval_derivative t x ?_ Q htQ hunit
  rw [hxw]
  exact algebra_adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top hgen

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.fieldOf_eq_adjoin_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem fieldOf_eq_adjoin_of_pow_eq (hN : 0 < N) (hw : w ^ N = algebraMap K L a)
    (hgen : K⟮w⟯ = ⊤) (y : QbarPoint L) (ha : (y.P.restrict K).ord a = 0) :
    y.fieldOf = (IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
      {y.eval w (Place.mem_of_pow_eq hN hw y.P ha).1}).restrictScalars ℚ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨t, _, htQ, x, hxw, hunit⟩ := Place.exists_chart_aeval_derivative hN hw y.P ha
    have h := fieldOf_le_adjoin_of_aeval_derivative t x
      (by rw [hxw]; exact Place.algebra_adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top hgen) y htQ hunit
    rwa [y.eval_congr hxw] at h
  · intro z hz
    have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin (y.restrict K).fieldOf
        {y.eval w (Place.mem_of_pow_eq hN hw y.P ha).1} ≤
          IntermediateField.extendScalars y.fieldOf_restrict_le := by
      rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact y.eval_mem_fieldOf _
    exact hle hz

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.infinite_place
statement: theorem infinite_place : Infinite (Place K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  have hq : ∀ q : ℚ, Transcendental ℚ (t - algebraMap ℚ K q) := fun q ↦ by
    have := transcendental_aeval ht (p := X - C q) (by rw [natDegree_X_sub_C]; exact one_pos)
    simpa using this
  choose P hP using fun q ↦ Place.exists_ord_pos (hq q)
  refine Infinite.of_injective P fun q q' hqq' ↦ ?_
  by_contra hne
  have h1 := hP q
  have h2 := hP q'
  rw [← hqq'] at h2
  have hsum : (t - algebraMap ℚ K q) + -(t - algebraMap ℚ K q') = algebraMap ℚ K (q' - q) := by
    rw [map_sub]; ring
  have hsum0 : (t - algebraMap ℚ K q) + -(t - algebraMap ℚ K q') ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hsum, Ne, map_eq_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℚ K).injective, sub_eq_zero]
    exact Ne.symm hne
  have := (P q).min_le_ord_add hsum0
  rw [hsum, Place.ord_algebraMap_rat, Place.ord_neg] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_galPt
statement:
theorem val_galPt (σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar) (x : QbarPoint K) (φ : K) :
    val (galPt σ x) φ = (val x φ).map σ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : φ ∈ x.P.1
  · rw [val_of_mem (x := galPt σ x) h, val_of_mem h]
    rfl
  · rw [val_of_notMem (x := galPt σ x) h, val_of_notMem h]
    rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.exists_isBelyi_forall_notMem_cusps
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyi_forall_notMem_cusps (T : Finset (Place K)) :
    ∃ φ : K, IsBelyi φ ∧ ∀ P ∈ T, P ∉ cusps φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := infinite_place K
  
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Divisor.exists_polarDivisor_eq (K := K)
  obtain ⟨T', hTT', hcard⟩ :=
    Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq T (T.card + N₁.toNat + 1) (by omega)
  set A : Divisor K := ∑ P ∈ T', Finsupp.single P 1 with hA_def
  have hA : ∀ P, A P = if P ∈ T' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro P
    rw [hA_def, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := fun P ↦ by rw [hA P]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hdeg : N₁ ≤ A.deg := by
    have h1 : A.deg = ∑ P ∈ T', (P.deg : ℤ) := by
      rw [← Divisor.degHom_apply, hA_def, map_sum]
      simp
    have h2 : ∑ P ∈ T', (1 : ℤ) ≤ ∑ P ∈ T', (P.deg : ℤ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun P _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast P.deg_pos
    rw [Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h2
    push_cast at h2
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hN₁ A hA0 hdeg
  set ψ := f⁻¹ with hψ_def
  have hψT' : ∀ P ∈ T', P.ord ψ = 1 := by
    intro P hP
    have := congrArg (· P) hf
    simp only [Divisor.polarDivisor_apply, hA P, if_pos hP] at this
    rw [hψ_def, Place.ord_inv]
    omega
  have hψnT' : ∀ P ∉ T', P.ord ψ ≤ 0 := by
    intro P hP
    have := congrArg (· P) hf
    simp only [Divisor.polarDivisor_apply, hA P, if_neg hP] at this
    rw [hψ_def, Place.ord_inv]
    omega
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ : T'.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ :=
    transcendental_of_ord_ne_zero (P := P₀) (by rw [hψT' P₀ hP₀]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hψ0 : ψ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hψ
  
  have hR := finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx hψ
  have hX := QbarPoint.finite_setOf_mem hR
  set S : Finset Pt := insert none (hX.toFinset.image fun x ↦ val x ψ) with hS_def
  have hmemS : ∀ x : QbarPoint K, 1 < ramIdx x.P ψ → val x ψ ∈ S := fun x hx ↦
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hX.mem_toFinset.mpr hx, rfl⟩)
  have hSgal : ∀ σ : Qbar ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qbar, ∀ z ∈ S, z.map σ ∈ S := by
    intro σ z hz
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      rw [← val_galPt]
      exact hmemS (galPt σ x) (show 1 < ramIdx x.P ψ from hX.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
  have hval0 : ∀ x : QbarPoint K, x.P ∈ T' → val x ψ = NoncriticalP1.ratPt (some 0) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [NoncriticalP1.ratPt_some, NoncriticalP1.ofRat, Rat.cast_zero,
      val_eq_some_zero_iff hψ0, hψT' _ hx]
    exact one_pos
  have hτ : NoncriticalP1.ratPt (some 0) ∉ S := by
    intro h
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp h with h | h
    · exact absurd h (by simp [NoncriticalP1.ratPt])
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
      have hram : 1 < ramIdx x.P ψ := hX.mem_toFinset.mp hx
      rw [NoncriticalP1.ratPt_some, NoncriticalP1.ofRat, Rat.cast_zero,
        val_eq_some_zero_iff hψ0] at hxv
      have hxT : x.P ∈ T' := by
        by_contra hn; have := hψnT' _ hn; omega
      rw [ramIdx_of_ord_pos hxv, hψT' _ hxT] at hram
      exact lt_irrefl _ hram
  
  obtain ⟨hs, hhs⟩ := NoncriticalP1.exists_isNoncriticalBelyi S hSgal (some 0) hτ
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, -⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_P_eq P₀
  have hφ : Transcendental ℚ (compK hs ψ) := (compK_spec x₀ hs hψ).1
  refine ⟨compK hs ψ, ⟨hφ, fun P hP ↦ ?_⟩, fun P hPT ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_P_eq P
    obtain ⟨-, hv, he⟩ := compK_spec x hs hψ
    rw [mem_cusps_iff hφ x, hv]
    rw [he] at hP
    by_cases h1 : 1 < ramIdx x.P ψ
    · exact hhs.maps_to _ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hmemS x h1))
    · have hpos := ramIdx_pos hψ x.P
      have h1' : ramIdx x.P ψ = 1 := by omega
      rw [h1', one_mul] at hP
      exact hhs.unramified _ (by exact_mod_cast hP)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_P_eq P
    obtain ⟨-, hv, -⟩ := compK_spec x hs hψ
    rw [mem_cusps_iff hφ x, hv, hval0 x (hTT' hPT)]
    exact hhs.tau_notMem

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_of_residue_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ord_eq_zero_of_residue_ne_zero {y : K} (hy : y ∈ P.1)
    (h : P.residue ⟨y, hy⟩ ≠ 0) : P.ord y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact h (by rw [show (⟨0, hy⟩ : P.1) = 0 from rfl, map_zero])
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (P.ord_nonneg_of_mem hy)
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  exact h ((P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mpr ((P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨y, hy⟩) hy0).mp hlt))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero {y : K} (hy : y ∈ P.1) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (h : P.residue ⟨y, hy⟩ = 0) : 0 < P.ord y
proof:
:=
  (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨y, hy⟩) hy0).mpr ((P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mp h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_eq_zero_of_ord_pos
statement:
theorem residue_eq_zero_of_ord_pos {y : K} (hy : 0 < P.ord y) :
    P.residue ⟨y, P.mem_of_ord_nonneg hy.le⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hy
  exact (P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mpr ((P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨y, _⟩) hy0).mp hy)

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_aeval
statement:
theorem eval_aeval {f : K} (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) :
    x.eval (aeval f p) (x.P.aeval_mem hf p) = aeval (x.eval f hf) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval, Place.residue_aeval, eval]
  exact (aeval_algHom_apply x.σ.toRatAlgHom _ p).symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_of_mem
statement:
theorem ramIdx_of_mem {P : Place K} (h : φ ∈ P.1) :
    ramIdx P φ = P.ord (aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)))
proof: := dif_pos h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_of_notMem
statement: theorem ramIdx_of_notMem {P : Place K} (h : φ ∉ P.1) : ramIdx P φ = -P.ord φ
proof: := dif_neg h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_of_mem
statement: theorem val_of_mem {x : QbarPoint K} (h : φ ∈ x.P.1) : val x φ = some (x.eval φ h)
proof: := dif_pos h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_of_notMem
statement: theorem val_of_notMem {x : QbarPoint K} (h : φ ∉ x.P.1) : val x φ = none
proof: := dif_neg h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem val_eq_none_iff {x : QbarPoint K} : val x φ = none ↔ φ ∉ x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold val
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_pos
statement: theorem ramIdx_pos (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (P : Place K) : 0 < ramIdx P φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold ramIdx
  split_ifs with h
  · have hr := P.isIntegral_residue ⟨φ, h⟩
    have hm0 : aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h0 ↦ hφ ⟨_, minpoly.ne_zero hr, h0⟩
    refine P.ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero (P.aeval_mem h _) hm0 ?_
    rw [P.residue_aeval h]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ _
  · have := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_of_ord_pos
statement: theorem ramIdx_of_ord_pos {P : Place K} (h : 0 < P.ord φ) : ramIdx P φ = P.ord φ
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : φ ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg h.le
  rw [ramIdx_of_mem hmem, P.residue_eq_zero_of_ord_pos h, minpoly.zero, aeval_X]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_of_ord_neg
statement: theorem ramIdx_of_ord_neg {P : Place K} (h : P.ord φ < 0) : ramIdx P φ = -P.ord φ
proof:
:=
  ramIdx_of_notMem ((P.ord_neg_iff).mp h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ord_aeval_eq
statement:
theorem ord_aeval_eq (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : φ ∈ x.P.1) {g : ℚ[X]}
    (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    x.P.ord (aeval φ g) =
      ramIdx x.P φ * ((g.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).rootMultiplicity (x.eval φ hx) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction h : g.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing g with
  | _ n ih =>
  set r := x.P.residue ⟨φ, hx⟩ with hr_def
  have hr : IsIntegral ℚ r := x.P.isIntegral_residue _
  have heval : ∀ p : ℚ[X], aeval (x.eval φ hx) p = x.σ (aeval r p) := fun p ↦
    aeval_algHom_apply x.σ.toRatAlgHom r p
  have hnz : ∀ p : ℚ[X], p ≠ 0 → aeval φ p ≠ 0 := fun p hp h0 ↦ hφ ⟨p, hp, h0⟩
  by_cases hdvd : minpoly ℚ r ∣ g
  · obtain ⟨g', rfl⟩ := hdvd
    have hm0 := minpoly.ne_zero hr
    have hg' : g' ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hg
    have hdeg : g'.natDegree < n := by
      rw [← h, natDegree_mul hm0 hg']
      have := minpoly.natDegree_pos hr
      omega
    have hsep : ((minpoly ℚ r).map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).Separable :=
      (minpoly.irreducible hr).separable.map
    have hroot : ((minpoly ℚ r).map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).IsRoot (x.eval φ hx) := by
      rw [IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap, heval, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]
    have hmap0 : (minpoly ℚ r).map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar) ≠ 0 :=
      (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap ℚ Qbar).injective).mpr hm0
    have h1 : ((minpoly ℚ r).map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).rootMultiplicity (x.eval φ hx) = 1 :=
      le_antisymm (rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable hsep _)
        ((rootMultiplicity_pos hmap0).mpr hroot)
    have hprod : ((minpoly ℚ r * g').map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)) ≠ 0 :=
      (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap ℚ Qbar).injective).mpr hg
    rw [map_mul, x.P.ord_mul (hnz _ hm0) (hnz _ hg'), ih _ hdeg hg' rfl, Polynomial.map_mul,
      rootMultiplicity_mul (by rwa [Polynomial.map_mul] at hprod), h1, ramIdx_of_mem hx]
    push_cast
    ring
  · have hne : aeval r g ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hdvd (minpoly.dvd ℚ r h0)
    have hne' : ¬ (g.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)).IsRoot (x.eval φ hx) := by
      rw [IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap, heval]
      exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ x.σ.injective).mpr hne
    rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_zero hne', Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    refine x.P.ord_eq_zero_of_residue_ne_zero (x.P.aeval_mem hx g) ?_
    rwa [x.P.residue_aeval hx]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_eq_some_zero_iff
statement:
theorem val_eq_some_zero_iff {x : QbarPoint K} (hφ0 : φ ≠ 0) :
    val x φ = some 0 ↔ 0 < x.P.ord φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold val
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Option.some.injEq, x.eval_eq_zero_iff h hφ0]
  · simp only [false_iff, not_lt]
    exact (le_of_lt ((x.P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.val_eq_some_one_iff
statement:
theorem val_eq_some_one_iff {x : QbarPoint K} (hφ1 : φ - 1 ≠ 0) :
    val x φ = some 1 ↔ 0 < x.P.ord (φ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have h : φ ∈ x.P.1 := by
      by_contra h
      rw [val_of_notMem h] at hv
      exact absurd hv (by simp)
    rw [val_of_mem h, Option.some.injEq] at hv
    have h1 : φ - 1 ∈ x.P.1 := sub_mem h x.P.1.one_mem
    rw [← x.eval_eq_zero_iff h1 hφ1, x.eval_sub h x.P.1.one_mem, hv, x.eval_one, sub_self]
  · intro hpos
    have h1 : φ - 1 ∈ x.P.1 := x.P.mem_of_ord_nonneg hpos.le
    have h : φ ∈ x.P.1 := by simpa using add_mem h1 x.P.1.one_mem
    rw [val_of_mem h, Option.some.injEq]
    have := (x.eval_eq_zero_iff h1 hφ1).mpr hpos
    rw [x.eval_sub h x.P.1.one_mem, x.eval_one, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.mem_cusps_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cusps_iff (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) :
    x.P ∈ cusps φ ↔ val x φ ∈ zeroOneInf
proof:
:= by
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hφ
  have hφ1 : φ - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hφ
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_one
  rw [mem_zeroOneInf, val_eq_none_iff, val_eq_some_zero_iff hφ0, val_eq_some_one_iff hφ1,
    ← x.P.ord_neg_iff]
  simp only [cusps, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ramIdx_eq
statement:
theorem Noncritical.ramIdx_eq (P : Place K) (φ : K) :
    Noncritical.ramIdx P φ = (Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx φ P : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : φ ∈ P.1
  · rw [Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_of_mem h]
    unfold Noncritical.ramIdx
    rw [dif_pos h]
    rfl
  · rw [Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_of_notMem h]
    unfold Noncritical.ramIdx
    rw [dif_neg h]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.cusps_eq
statement:
theorem Noncritical.cusps_eq (φ : K) :
    Noncritical.cusps φ = Belyi.CurveField.belyiCusps φ
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.isBelyi_iff
statement:
theorem Noncritical.isBelyi_iff (φ : K) :
    Noncritical.IsBelyi φ ↔ Belyi.CurveField.IsBelyi φ
proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr Iff.rfl (forall_congr' fun P => ?_)
  rw [Noncritical.ramIdx_eq, Noncritical.cusps_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h h1
    exact h (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  · intro h h1
    exact h (by exact_mod_cast h1)

name: Belyi.CurveField.exists_isBelyi_notMem_belyiCusps
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyi_notMem_belyiCusps (T : Finset (Place K)) :
    ∃ φ : K, IsBelyi φ ∧ ∀ P ∈ T, P ∉ belyiCusps φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hT⟩ := Noncritical.exists_isBelyi_forall_notMem_cusps T
  exact ⟨φ, (Noncritical.isBelyi_iff φ).mp hφ, hT⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.rootMultiplicity_comp_of_separable
proof:
:= by
  set R := M /ₘ (X - C b)
  have hMR : (X - C b) * R = M := mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.mpr hb
  have hM0 := hM.ne_zero
  have hR0 : R ≠ 0 := by rintro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hMR; exact hM0 hMR.symm
  have hRb : ¬ R.IsRoot b := by
    intro hRb
    have h1 := rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable hM b
    rw [← hMR, rootMultiplicity_mul (by rw [hMR]; exact hM0), rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_self]
      at h1
    have := (rootMultiplicity_pos hR0).mpr hRb
    omega
  have hRQ : ¬ (R.comp Q).IsRoot a := by
    rwa [IsRoot, eval_comp, hQa]
  have hRQ0 : R.comp Q ≠ 0 := by rintro h; apply hRQ; rw [h]; exact eval_zero
  have hcomp : M.comp Q = (Q - C b) * R.comp Q := by
    rw [← hMR, mul_comp, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
  rw [hcomp, rootMultiplicity_mul (mul_ne_zero hQ hRQ0), rootMultiplicity_eq_zero hRQ, add_zero]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.transcendental_aeval
statement:
theorem transcendental_aeval (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) :
    Transcendental ℚ (aeval φ p)
proof:
:=
  hφ.aeval p hp.ne' (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
    (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hp)))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ord_aeval_of_notMem
statement:
theorem ord_aeval_of_notMem (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) {P : Place K} (h : φ ∉ P.1) {p : ℚ[X]}
    (hp : p ≠ 0) : P.ord (aeval φ p) = p.natDegree * P.ord φ
proof:
:= by
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hφ
  letI : Invertible φ := invertibleOfNonzero hφ0
  have key : aeval φ⁻¹ p.reverse * φ ^ p.natDegree = aeval φ p := by
    have := eval₂_reverse_mul_pow (algebraMap ℚ K) φ p
    rwa [invOf_eq_inv] at this
  have hneg := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
  have hpos : 0 < P.ord φ⁻¹ := by rw [P.ord_inv]; omega
  have hinv : φ⁻¹ ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg hpos.le
  have hres : P.residue ⟨aeval φ⁻¹ p.reverse, P.aeval_mem hinv _⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [P.residue_aeval hinv, P.residue_eq_zero_of_ord_pos hpos, ← coeff_zero_eq_aeval_zero',
      coeff_zero_reverse]
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℚ _).injective).mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp)
  have h0 : aeval φ⁻¹ p.reverse ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h0
    apply hres
    rw [show (⟨aeval φ⁻¹ p.reverse, P.aeval_mem hinv _⟩ : P.1) = 0 from Subtype.ext h0,
      map_zero]
  rw [← key, P.ord_mul h0 (pow_ne_zero _ hφ0), P.ord_eq_zero_of_residue_ne_zero _ hres,
    P.ord_pow, zero_add]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.poly_spec
statement:
theorem poly_spec (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) {p : ℚ[X]}
    (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) :
    val x (aeval φ p) = (ElemMap.poly p hp).apply (val x φ) ∧
      ramIdx x.P (aeval φ p) = ramIdx x.P φ * (ElemMap.poly p hp).ramIdx (val x φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hp
  by_cases h : φ ∈ x.P.1
  · have h' := x.P.aeval_mem h p
    have hev := x.eval_aeval h p
    rw [val_of_mem h, val_of_mem h', hev]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    set m := minpoly ℚ (x.P.residue ⟨aeval φ p, h'⟩)
    have hr := x.P.isIntegral_residue ⟨aeval φ p, h'⟩
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := minpoly.ne_zero hr
    have hcomp0 : m.comp p ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, comp_eq_zero_iff, not_or]
      refine ⟨hm0, fun ⟨_, h2⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
      have := congrArg natDegree h2
      rw [natDegree_C] at this
      omega
    rw [ramIdx_of_mem h', ← aeval_comp, ord_aeval_eq hφ x h hcomp0, Polynomial.map_comp]
    congr 2
    refine rootMultiplicity_comp_of_separable ((minpoly.irreducible hr).separable.map) ?_
      (by rw [eval_map_algebraMap]) ?_
    · rw [IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap, ← hev]
      exact (aeval_algHom_apply x.σ.toRatAlgHom _ m).trans (by
        simp [m, minpoly.aeval])
    · intro h0
      have := congrArg natDegree h0
      rw [natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_map, natDegree_zero] at this
      omega
  · have hord := ord_aeval_of_notMem hφ h hp0
    have hneg := (x.P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
    have h' : aeval φ p ∉ x.P.1 := by
      rw [← x.P.ord_neg_iff, hord]
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hp) hneg
    rw [val_of_notMem h, val_of_notMem h', ramIdx_of_notMem h', ramIdx_of_notMem h, hord]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    change _ = _ * (p.natDegree : ℤ)
    ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ElemMap.ramIdx_poly_of_natDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem ElemMap.ramIdx_poly_of_natDegree_eq_one {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : 0 < p.natDegree)
    (h1 : p.natDegree = 1) (z : Pt) : (ElemMap.poly p hp).ramIdx z = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | none => exact h1
  | some z =>
    have hq : (p.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)) - C (aeval z p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg natDegree h0
      rw [natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_map, natDegree_zero] at this
      omega
    refine le_antisymm (not_lt.mp fun hlt ↦ ?_) ?_
    · have := (ElemMap.one_lt_ramIdx_poly_some_iff hp z).mp hlt
      rw [eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one h1.le] at this
      simp only [derivative_add, derivative_C_mul_X, derivative_C, add_zero, aeval_C] at this
      have hc : p.coeff 1 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← h1]; exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hp)
      exact hc ((map_eq_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℚ Qbar).injective).mp this)
    · change 0 < ((p.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)) - C (aeval z p)).rootMultiplicity z
      rw [rootMultiplicity_pos hq]
      simp [IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.exists_ramIdx_eq_mul_inv
statement:
theorem exists_ramIdx_eq_mul_inv (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K)
    (h0 : x.P.ord φ = 0) : ∃ k : ℕ, ramIdx x.P φ = ramIdx x.P φ⁻¹ * k
proof:
:= by
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hφ
  obtain ⟨h, hinv⟩ := (x.P.ord_eq_zero_iff hφ0).mp h0
  set m := minpoly ℚ (x.P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := minpoly.ne_zero (x.P.isIntegral_residue _)
  letI : Invertible φ := invertibleOfNonzero hφ0
  have key : aeval φ⁻¹ m.reverse * φ ^ m.natDegree = aeval φ m := by
    have := eval₂_reverse_mul_pow (algebraMap ℚ K) φ m
    rwa [invOf_eq_inv] at this
  have hr0 : m.reverse ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, reverse_eq_zero]
  have hne : aeval φ⁻¹ m.reverse ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    transcendental_inv hφ ⟨_, hr0, h0⟩
  rw [ramIdx_of_mem h, ← key, x.P.ord_mul hne (pow_ne_zero _ hφ0), x.P.ord_pow, h0, mul_zero,
    add_zero, ord_aeval_eq (transcendental_inv hφ) x hinv hr0]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.inv_spec
statement:
theorem inv_spec (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) :
    val x φ⁻¹ = invPt (val x φ) ∧ ramIdx x.P φ⁻¹ = ramIdx x.P φ
proof:
:= by
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hφ
  have hφi0 : φ⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hφ0
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x.P.ord φ) 0 with hlt | h0 | hgt
  · have hi : 0 < x.P.ord φ⁻¹ := by rw [x.P.ord_inv]; omega
    rw [val_of_notMem ((x.P.ord_neg_iff).mp hlt), (val_eq_some_zero_iff hφi0).mpr hi,
      ramIdx_of_ord_pos hi, ramIdx_of_ord_neg hlt, x.P.ord_inv]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨h, hinv⟩ := (x.P.ord_eq_zero_iff hφ0).mp h0
    have ha : x.eval φ h ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, x.eval_eq_zero_iff h hφ0]; omega
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [val_of_mem h, val_of_mem hinv, x.eval_inv h hinv]
      simp [invPt, ha]
    · obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := exists_ramIdx_eq_mul_inv hφ x h0
      obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := exists_ramIdx_eq_mul_inv (transcendental_inv hφ) x
        (by rw [x.P.ord_inv, h0, neg_zero])
      rw [inv_inv] at hk₂
      have e₁ := ramIdx_pos hφ x.P
      have e₂ := ramIdx_pos (transcendental_inv hφ) x.P
      have hk₁' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ k₁ := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k₁ with h | h
        · rw [h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hk₁; omega
        · exact_mod_cast h
      have hk₂' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ k₂ := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k₂ with h | h
        · rw [h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hk₂; omega
        · exact_mod_cast h
      nlinarith
  · have hi : x.P.ord φ⁻¹ < 0 := by rw [x.P.ord_inv]; omega
    rw [(val_eq_some_zero_iff hφ0).mpr hgt, val_of_notMem ((x.P.ord_neg_iff).mp hi),
      ramIdx_of_ord_pos hgt, ramIdx_of_ord_neg hi, x.P.ord_inv, neg_neg]
    simp [invPt]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.mob_apply_eq_poly
statement:
theorem mob_apply_eq_poly {a b d : ℚ} (hdet : a * d - b * 0 ≠ 0)
    (hp : 0 < (C (a / d) * X + C (b / d)).natDegree) (z : Pt) :
    (ElemMap.mob a b 0 d hdet).apply z = (ElemMap.poly _ hp).apply z
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (d : Qbar) ≠ 0 := by
    have : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hdet
    exact_mod_cast this
  cases z with
  | none => simp [ElemMap.apply_mob_none]
  | some z =>
    rw [ElemMap.apply_mob_some_of_ne _ (by simpa using hd), ElemMap.apply_poly_some]
    simp only [Rat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X,
      eq_ratCast, Rat.cast_div, Option.some.injEq]
    field_simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.mob_apply_eq_comp
statement:
theorem mob_apply_eq_comp {a b c d : ℚ} (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hp₁ : 0 < (C c * X + C d).natDegree)
    (hp₂ : 0 < (C ((b * c - a * d) / c) * X + C (a / c)).natDegree) (z : Pt) :
    (ElemMap.mob a b c d hdet).apply z =
      (ElemMap.poly _ hp₂).apply (invPt ((ElemMap.poly _ hp₁).apply z))
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : (c : Qbar) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  cases z with
  | none =>
    simp [ElemMap.apply_mob_none, hc, invPt]
  | some z =>
    rw [ElemMap.apply_mob_some, ElemMap.apply_poly_some]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X, eq_ratCast]
    by_cases hz : (c : Qbar) * z + d = 0
    · simp [hz, invPt]
    · rw [if_neg hz]
      simp only [invPt, hz, if_false, ElemMap.apply_poly_some, map_add, map_mul, aeval_C,
        aeval_X, eq_ratCast, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_mul, Option.some.injEq]
      have hz' : z * (c : Qbar) + d ≠ 0 := by rwa [mul_comm]
      field_simp
      ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.mob_spec
statement:
theorem mob_spec (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) {a b c d : ℚ}
    (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0) :
    Transcendental ℚ (applyK (.mob a b c d hdet) φ) ∧
      val x (applyK (.mob a b c d hdet) φ) = (ElemMap.mob a b c d hdet).apply (val x φ) ∧
      ramIdx x.P (applyK (.mob a b c d hdet) φ) = ramIdx x.P φ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst hc
    have hd : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hdet
    have ha : a / d ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at hdet) hd
    have hp1 : (C (a / d) * X + C (b / d)).natDegree = 1 := natDegree_linear ha
    have hp : 0 < (C (a / d) * X + C (b / d)).natDegree := by omega
    have heq : applyK (.mob a b 0 d hdet) φ = aeval φ (C (a / d) * X + C (b / d)) := by
      have hd' : (d : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd
      simp only [applyK, map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X, eq_ratCast, Rat.cast_div,
        Rat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      field_simp
    obtain ⟨hv, he⟩ := poly_spec hφ x hp
    rw [heq, hv, he, ElemMap.ramIdx_poly_of_natDegree_eq_one hp hp1, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
      mob_apply_eq_poly hdet hp]
    exact ⟨transcendental_aeval hφ hp, rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hk : (b * c - a * d) / c ≠ 0 :=
      div_ne_zero (fun h ↦ hdet (by linear_combination -h)) hc
    have hp₁1 : (C c * X + C d).natDegree = 1 := natDegree_linear hc
    have hp₂1 : (C ((b * c - a * d) / c) * X + C (a / c)).natDegree = 1 := natDegree_linear hk
    have hp₁ : 0 < (C c * X + C d).natDegree := by omega
    have hp₂ : 0 < (C ((b * c - a * d) / c) * X + C (a / c)).natDegree := by omega
    have hφ₁ := transcendental_aeval hφ hp₁
    have hφ₂ := transcendental_inv hφ₁
    have hden : (c : K) * φ + d ≠ 0 := by
      have := ne_zero_of_transcendental hφ₁
      simpa using this
    have heq : applyK (.mob a b c d hdet) φ =
        aeval (aeval φ (C c * X + C d))⁻¹ (C ((b * c - a * d) / c) * X + C (a / c)) := by
      have hc' : (c : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
      simp only [applyK, map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X, eq_ratCast, Rat.cast_div,
        Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_mul]
      have hden' : φ * (c : K) + d ≠ 0 := by rwa [mul_comm]
      field_simp
      ring
    obtain ⟨hv₁, he₁⟩ := poly_spec hφ x hp₁
    obtain ⟨hv₂, he₂⟩ := inv_spec hφ₁ x
    obtain ⟨hv₃, he₃⟩ := poly_spec hφ₂ x hp₂
    rw [heq, hv₃, he₃, hv₂, he₂, hv₁, he₁, ElemMap.ramIdx_poly_of_natDegree_eq_one hp₁ hp₁1,
      ElemMap.ramIdx_poly_of_natDegree_eq_one hp₂ hp₂1, mob_apply_eq_comp hdet hc hp₁ hp₂]
    exact ⟨transcendental_aeval hφ₂ hp₂, rfl, by simp⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.applyK_spec
statement:
theorem applyK_spec (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) (x : QbarPoint K) (h : ElemMap) :
    Transcendental ℚ (applyK h φ) ∧ val x (applyK h φ) = h.apply (val x φ) ∧
      ramIdx x.P (applyK h φ) = ramIdx x.P φ * h.ramIdx (val x φ)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | mob a b c d hdet =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := mob_spec hφ x hdet
    exact ⟨h1, h2, by rw [h3, ElemMap.ramIdx_mob, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]⟩
  | poly p hp =>
    obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := poly_spec hφ x hp
    exact ⟨transcendental_aeval hφ hp, h2, h3⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.compK_spec
statement:
theorem compK_spec (x : QbarPoint K) (hs : List ElemMap) {φ : K} (hφ : Transcendental ℚ φ) :
    Transcendental ℚ (compK hs φ) ∧ val x (compK hs φ) = evalComp hs (val x φ) ∧
      ramIdx x.P (compK hs φ) = ramIdx x.P φ * ramIdxComp hs (val x φ)
proof:
:= by
  induction hs generalizing φ with
  | nil => exact ⟨hφ, rfl, by simp [compK]⟩
  | cons h hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := applyK_spec hφ x h
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩ := ih h1
    refine ⟨i1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change val x (compK hs (applyK h φ)) = _
      rw [i2, h2]
      rfl
    · change ramIdx x.P (compK hs (applyK h φ)) = _
      rw [i3, h3, h2, NoncriticalP1.ramIdxComp_cons]
      push_cast
      ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.transcendental_of_ord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transcendental_of_ord_ne_zero {P : Place K} {π : K} (h : P.ord π ≠ 0) :
    Transcendental ℚ π
proof:
:=
  fun ha ↦ h (P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic ha)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero (P : Place K) (y : P.1) (hy : (y : K) ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit y ↔ P.ord y = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    have h1 : ((u : P.1) : K) * ((u⁻¹ : P.1ˣ) : P.1) = 1 := by
      rw [← Subring.coe_mul, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one]; rfl
    have hu0 : (((u⁻¹ : P.1ˣ) : P.1) : K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have := congrArg P.ord h1
    rw [P.ord_mul hy hu0, P.ord_one] at this
    have h2 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (u : P.1).2
    have h3 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem ((u⁻¹ : P.1ˣ) : P.1).2
    omega
  · intro h0
    have hinv : (y : K)⁻¹ ∈ P.1 := ((P.ord_eq_zero_iff hy).mp h0).2
    exact isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨⟨_, hinv⟩, Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel₀ hy)⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.irreducible_of_ord_eq_one
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_ord_eq_one (P : Place K) {π : K} (hπ : P.ord π = 1) :
    Irreducible (⟨π, P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (by omega)⟩ : P.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hπ
  rw [irreducible_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero P _ hπ0] at h
    change P.ord π = 0 at h
    omega
  · have hab' : π = (a : K) * b := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    have ha0 : (a : K) ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at hab'; exact hπ0 hab'
    have hb0 : (b : K) ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hab'; exact hπ0 hab'
    rw [isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero P _ ha0, isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero P _ hb0]
    have := congrArg P.ord hab'
    rw [P.ord_mul ha0 hb0, hπ] at this
    have h2 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem a.2
    have h3 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem b.2
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one (P : Place K) :
    ∀ y ∈ P.1, ∃ p : ℚ[X], p ≠ 0 ∧ P.1.valuation (aeval y p) < 1
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine ⟨minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨y, hy⟩), minpoly.ne_zero (P.isIntegral_residue _), ?_⟩
  refine (P.1.valuation_lt_one_iff ⟨_, P.aeval_mem hy _⟩).mp ((P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mp ?_)
  rw [P.residue_aeval hy]
  exact minpoly.aeval ℚ _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.valuation_eq_one_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem valuation_eq_one_of_ord_eq_zero (P : Place K) {u : K} (hu0 : u ≠ 0)
    (hu : P.ord u = 0) : P.1.valuation u = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (P.ord_eq_zero_iff hu0).mp hu
  have := (P.1.valuation_eq_one_iff ⟨u, h1⟩).mp
    ((isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero P ⟨u, h1⟩ hu0).mpr hu)
  exact this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one
statement:
theorem ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one (P : Place K) {w : K} (hw : P.1.valuation w = 1) :
    P.ord w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hw
  exact (P.ord_eq_zero_iff hw0).mpr
    ⟨(P.1.valuation_le_one_iff w).mp hw.le, Belyi.CurveDeriv.inv_mem_of_valuation_eq_one hw⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.exists_derivAlong_notMem
statement:
theorem exists_derivAlong_notMem {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) {P : Place K}
    (htP : t ∈ P.1) (hram : 1 < ramIdx P t) : ∃ s ∈ P.1, derivAlong t s ∉ P.1
proof:
:= by
  set π := P.uniformizer
  have hπ : P.ord π = 1 := P.ord_uniformizer
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := P.uniformizer_ne_zero
  have hπt : Transcendental ℚ π := transcendental_of_ord_ne_zero (by omega : P.ord π ≠ 0)
  have hπO : π ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (by omega)
  have hirr := irreducible_of_ord_eq_one P hπ
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮π⟯ K := finiteDimensional_adjoin hπt
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ⟮π⟯ K := isAlgebraic_adjoin hπt
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ⟮t⟯ K := isAlgebraic_adjoin ht
  set m := minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨t, htP⟩)
  have hsep : m.Separable := (minpoly.irreducible (P.isIntegral_residue _)).separable
  have hm := ramIdx_of_mem htP
  have hmt0 : aeval t m ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ ht ⟨m, minpoly.ne_zero (P.isIntegral_residue _), h0⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℕ, ramIdx P t = e := ⟨(ramIdx P t).toNat, by omega⟩
  have he1 : 1 ≤ e := by omega
  set u := aeval t m / π ^ e
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hmt0 (pow_ne_zero _ hπ0)
  have hu : P.1.valuation u = 1 := by
    refine valuation_eq_one_of_ord_eq_zero P hu0 ?_
    rw [P.ord_div hmt0 (pow_ne_zero _ hπ0), P.ord_pow, hπ, ← hm, he]
    ring
  have hmt : aeval t m = u * π ^ e := by
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hπ0)]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hD⟩ := Belyi.CurveDeriv.derivAlong_eq_unit_mul_pow_of_aeval hπt P.algebraMap_mem
    (exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one P) hπO hirr htP hsep hu he1 hmt
  refine ⟨π, hπO, fun hDπ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := Belyi.CurveDeriv.derivAlong_mul_derivAlong hπt ht
  rw [hD] at h1
  have hD0 : derivAlong t π ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hw
  have := congrArg P.ord h1
  rw [P.ord_one, P.ord_mul hD0 (mul_ne_zero hw0 (pow_ne_zero _ hπ0)),
    P.ord_mul hw0 (pow_ne_zero _ hπ0), ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one P hw, P.ord_pow, hπ]
    at this
  have h2 := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem hDπ
  have h3 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ((e - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.finite_setOf_derivAlong_notMem
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_derivAlong_notMem {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    {P : Place K | t ∈ P.1 ∧ ∃ s ∈ P.1, derivAlong t s ∉ P.1}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (M := chartRing t)
  refine (G.finite_toSet.biUnion fun g _ ↦ Place.finite_setOf_notMem (derivAlong t g)).subset ?_
  rintro P ⟨htP, s, hs, hDs⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, exists_prop]
  by_contra hgood
  push Not at hgood
  apply hDs
  
  have hA : ∀ r : chartRing t, derivAlong t (r : K) ∈ P.1 := by
    intro r
    have hr : r ∈ Submodule.span (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (G : Set (chartRing t)) :=
      hG ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hr using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem g hg => exact hgood g hg
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx =>
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
      change derivAlong t ((a : K) * x) ∈ P.1
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact add_mem (mul_mem (Belyi.CurveDeriv.mem_of_mem_adjoin P.algebraMap_mem htP a.2) hx)
        (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP x)
          (Belyi.CurveDeriv.derivAlong_mem_of_mem_adjoin ht P.algebraMap_mem htP a.2))
  
  have hs' : s ∈ (Place.ofChart t (P.toChart t htP)).1 := by rwa [Place.ofChart_toChart]
  rw [Place.ofChart_val] at hs'
  obtain ⟨a, u, hu, hsu⟩ := hs'
  subst hsu
  have hun : ((u : chartRing t) : K) ∉ P.1.nonunits := by
    rw [← Place.mem_toChart_iff t P htP]; exact hu
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hun
  change derivAlong t ((a : K) * (u : K)⁻¹) ∈ P.1
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [Derivation.leibniz_div, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_mem (pow_mem hun.2 2) (sub_mem (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP u) (hA a))
    (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP a) (hA u)))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Noncritical.finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    {P : Place K | 1 < ramIdx P t}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Place.finite_setOf_notMem t).union (finite_setOf_derivAlong_notMem ht)).subset ?_
  intro P hP
  by_cases htP : t ∈ P.1
  · exact Or.inr ⟨htP, exists_derivAlong_notMem ht htP hP⟩
  · exact Or.inl htP

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_primeBelow
statement:
theorem mem_primeBelow {O : ValuationSubring K} {hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O} {r : R} :
    r ∈ primeBelow O hR ↔ algebraMap R K r ∈ O.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeBelow, Ideal.mem_comap, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.primeBelow_ne_bot
statement:
theorem primeBelow_ne_bot [IsFractionRing R K] {O : ValuationSubring K} (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : primeBelow O hR ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hO
  refine top_unique fun x _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) x
  have hb0 : algebraMap R K b ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb
  have hbn : algebraMap R K b ∉ O.nonunits := by
    rw [← mem_primeBelow (hR := hR), h, Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hb0 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hbn
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact O.mul_mem _ _ (hR a) hbn.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_heightOneBelow
proof:
:=
  mem_primeBelow

name: Belyi.CurveField.valuationSubringAtPrime_le
statement:
theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_le (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K (heightOneBelow O hO hR) ≤ O
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩
  have hsn : algebraMap R K s ∉ O.nonunits := by
    rw [← mem_primeBelow (hR := hR)]; exact hs
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hsn
  exact O.mul_mem _ _ (hR a) hsn.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow
statement:
theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K (heightOneBelow O hO hR) = O
proof:
:=
  ValuationSubring.eq_of_le_of_ne_top _ (valuationSubringAtPrime_le O hO hR) hO

name: Belyi.CurveField.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_le
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_of_le (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) : IsDiscreteValuationRing O
proof:
:= by
  rw [← valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow O hO hR]; infer_instance

name: Belyi.CurveField.valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top
statement:
theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring, ne_eq,
    Valuation.valuationSubring_eq_top_iff, not_not]
  infer_instance

name: Belyi.CurveField.algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) :
    algebraMap R K r ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
  exact HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_le_one _ _

name: Belyi.CurveField.heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime
statement:
theorem heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    heightOneBelow (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v)
      (valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top v) (algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v) = v
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  rw [mem_heightOneBelow, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff,
    ← HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem (K := K),
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring]
  exact (Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring _).symm.lt_one_iff_lt_one

name: Belyi.CurveField.residue_comp_surjective
statement:
theorem residue_comp_surjective (O : ValuationSubring K) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hR : ∀ r, algebraMap R K r ∈ O) :
    Function.Surjective ((residue O).comp ((algebraMap R K).codRestrict O hR))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hxO⟩, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective y
  have hx := hxO
  rw [← valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow O hO hR] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, s, hs, hxas⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, i, hi, hbi⟩ := (heightOneBelow O hO hR).isMaximal.exists_inv hs
  refine ⟨a * b, ?_⟩
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, residue_eq_zero_iff,
    ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hs0 : algebraMap R K s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hs
    rw [(IsFractionRing.injective R K) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  have hin : algebraMap R K i ∈ O.nonunits := mem_heightOneBelow.mp hi
  have key : x - algebraMap R K (a * b) = x * algebraMap R K i := by
    have hbi' : algebraMap R K b * algebraMap R K s + algebraMap R K i = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_add, hbi, map_one]
    rw [hxas, map_mul, show algebraMap R K i = 1 - algebraMap R K b * algebraMap R K s by
      rw [← hbi']; ring]
    field_simp
  change x - algebraMap R K (a * b) ∈ O.nonunits
  rw [key, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff, map_mul]
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff] at hin
  calc O.valuation x * O.valuation (algebraMap R K i) < 1 * 1 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos ((O.valuation_le_one_iff x).mpr hxO) hin
          zero_le zero_lt_one
    _ = 1 := one_mul 1

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {P Q : Place K} (h : P.1 = Q.1) : P = Q
proof: := Subtype.ext h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ne_top
statement: theorem ne_top (P : Place K) : P.1 ≠ ⊤

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ratCast_mem
statement: theorem ratCast_mem (P : Place K) (q : ℚ) : (q : K) ∈ P.1

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_or_inv_mem
statement: theorem mem_or_inv_mem (P : Place K) (x : K) : x ∈ P.1 ∨ x⁻¹ ∈ P.1
proof: := P.1.mem_or_inv_mem x

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_mem
statement: theorem algebraMap_mem (P : Place K) (q : ℚ) : algebraMap ℚ K q ∈ P.1
proof: := P.ratCast_mem q

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_of_isIntegral
statement: theorem mem_of_isIntegral (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsIntegral ℚ x) : x ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1.toSubring K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1 K)
  have hle : (integralClosure ℚ K).toSubring ≤ P.1.toSubring :=
    Subring.integralClosure_le_iff.mpr P.algebraMap_mem
  exact hle hx

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_of_isAlgebraic
statement: theorem mem_of_isAlgebraic (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic ℚ x) : x ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  P.mem_of_isIntegral hx.isIntegral

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.inv_mem_of_isAlgebraic
statement: theorem inv_mem_of_isAlgebraic (P : Place K) {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic ℚ x) : x⁻¹ ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  P.mem_of_isAlgebraic hx.inv

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_chartRing_mem
statement:
theorem algebraMap_chartRing_mem (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) (r : chartRing t) :
    algebraMap (chartRing t) K r ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  mem_of_mem_chartRing P.1 P.ratCast_mem ht r.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_toChart_iff
statement:
theorem mem_toChart_iff (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) {r : chartRing t} :
    r ∈ (P.toChart t ht).asIdeal ↔ (r : K) ∈ P.1.nonunits
proof:
:=
  mem_heightOneBelow

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ofChart_val
statement:
theorem ofChart_val (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    (ofChart t v).1 = HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.self_mem_ofChart
statement: theorem self_mem_ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) : t ∈ (ofChart t v).1
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v ⟨t, self_mem_chartRing t⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ofChart_toChart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofChart_toChart (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) : ofChart t (P.toChart t ht) = P
proof:
:=
  Place.ext (valuationSubringAtPrime_heightOneBelow _ _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.toChart_ofChart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toChart_ofChart (v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing t)) :
    (ofChart t v).toChart t (self_mem_ofChart t v) = v
proof:
:=
  heightOneBelow_valuationSubringAtPrime v

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_comp_surjective
statement:
theorem residue_comp_surjective (P : Place K) (ht : t ∈ P.1) :
    Function.Surjective ((residue P.1).comp
      ((algebraMap (chartRing t) K).codRestrict P.1 (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t ht)))
proof:
:=
  CurveField.residue_comp_surjective P.1 P.ne_top _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_transcendental_mem
statement: theorem exists_transcendental_mem (P : Place K) : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ t ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  rcases P.mem_or_inv_mem t with h | h
  · exact ⟨t, ht, h⟩
  · exact ⟨t⁻¹, transcendental_inv ht, h⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem valuation_eq_zero_iff : P.valuation f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof: := Valuation.zero_iff _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_ne_zero
statement: theorem valuation_ne_zero (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.valuation f ≠ 0
proof: := by simpa using hf

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_eq_exp
statement: theorem valuation_eq_exp (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.valuation f = WithZero.exp (-P.ord f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, neg_neg, WithZero.exp_log (P.valuation_ne_zero hf)]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_zero : P.ord 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [ord]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_one : P.ord 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [ord]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_mul
statement: theorem ord_mul (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : P.ord (f * g) = P.ord f + P.ord g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ord, map_mul, WithZero.log_mul (P.valuation_ne_zero hf) (P.valuation_ne_zero hg)]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_inv (f : K) : P.ord f⁻¹ = -P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  simp [ord, map_inv₀, WithZero.log_inv]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_pow (f : K) (n : ℕ) : P.ord (f ^ n) = n * P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  simp [ord, map_pow, WithZero.log_pow]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_zpow (f : K) (n : ℤ) : P.ord (f ^ n) = n * P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  simp [ord, map_zpow₀, WithZero.log_zpow]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_div
statement: theorem ord_div (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : P.ord (f / g) = P.ord f - P.ord g
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, P.ord_mul hf (inv_ne_zero hg), ord_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_neg (f : K) : P.ord (-f) = P.ord f
proof: := by simp [ord]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_iff_valuation_le_one
statement: theorem mem_iff_valuation_le_one : f ∈ P.1 ↔ P.valuation f ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have := IsDiscreteValuationRing.map_algebraMap_eq_valuationSubring (A := P.1) (K := K)
  change _ ↔ f ∈ (P.valuation.valuationSubring.toSubring)
  rw [valuation, ← this]
  simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_iff_ord_nonneg
statement: theorem mem_iff_ord_nonneg : f ∈ P.1 ↔ f = 0 ∨ 0 ≤ P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp [P.1.zero_mem]
  rw [mem_iff_valuation_le_one, P.valuation_eq_exp hf, ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_le_exp]
  simp [hf]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_nonneg_of_mem
statement: theorem ord_nonneg_of_mem (hf : f ∈ P.1) : 0 ≤ P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  rcases (P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg).mp hf with rfl | h
  · simp
  · exact h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_of_ord_nonneg
statement: theorem mem_of_ord_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ P.ord f) : f ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  (P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg).mpr (Or.inr hf)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_neg_iff
statement: theorem ord_neg_iff : P.ord f < 0 ↔ f ∉ P.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, not_or, not_le]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, h⟩
    subst h0
    simp at h
  · exact fun h ↦ h.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal {a : P.1} (ha : (a : K) ≠ 0) :
    0 < P.ord a ↔ a ∈ maximalIdeal P.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1) (K := K) a
  change P.valuation a < 1 ↔ a ∈ maximalIdeal P.1 at h
  rw [← h, P.valuation_eq_exp ha, ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_lt_exp, Left.neg_neg_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_pos_iff
statement: theorem ord_pos_iff : 0 < P.ord f ↔ f ≠ 0 ∧ f ∈ P.1.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp
  simp only [ne_eq, hf, not_false_eq_true, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : f ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg h.le
    have := (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨f, hm⟩) hf).mp h
    exact ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mpr this
  · intro h
    have hm : f ∈ P.1 := P.1.nonunits_subset h
    exact (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨f, hm⟩) hf).mpr
      (ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_iff (hf : f ≠ 0) : P.ord f = 0 ↔ f ∈ P.1 ∧ f⁻¹ ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg, ord_inv]
  simp only [hf, inv_eq_zero, false_or, Left.nonneg_neg_iff]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.min_le_ord_add
statement: theorem min_le_ord_add (hfg : f + g ≠ 0) : min (P.ord f) (P.ord g) ≤ P.ord (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne g 0 with rfl | hg
  · simp
  have h := P.valuation.map_add f g
  rw [P.valuation_eq_exp hf, P.valuation_eq_exp hg, P.valuation_eq_exp hfg] at h
  rcases le_total (P.ord f) (P.ord g) with hle | hle
  · rw [max_eq_left (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hle)), WithZero.exp_le_exp] at h
    rw [min_eq_left hle]; omega
  · rw [max_eq_right (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hle)), WithZero.exp_le_exp] at h
    rw [min_eq_right hle]; omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_add_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem ord_add_eq_of_lt (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) (h : P.ord f < P.ord g) :
    P.ord (f + g) = P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  have hv : P.valuation g < P.valuation f := by
    rw [P.valuation_eq_exp hf, P.valuation_eq_exp hg, WithZero.exp_lt_exp]; omega
  have := P.valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_left hv
  rw [ord, ord, this]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_ord_eq_one
statement: theorem exists_ord_eq_one : ∃ π : K, P.ord π = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_exists_uniformizer K
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1)
  refine ⟨π, ?_⟩
  change -WithZero.log (P.valuation π) = 1
  rw [show P.valuation π = WithZero.exp (-1) from hπ, WithZero.log_exp, neg_neg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic {c : K} (hc : IsAlgebraic ℚ c) : P.ord c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · simp
  exact (P.ord_eq_zero_iff hc0).mpr ⟨P.mem_of_isAlgebraic hc, P.inv_mem_of_isAlgebraic hc⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_ratCast (q : ℚ) : P.ord (q : K) = 0
proof:
:=
  P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic (isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := ℚ) q)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_algebraMap_rat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_algebraMap_rat (q : ℚ) : P.ord (algebraMap ℚ K q) = 0
proof: := P.ord_ratCast q

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_natCast (n : ℕ) : P.ord (n : K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using P.ord_ratCast n

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ F] (c : F) : P.ord (algebraMap F K c) = 0
proof:
:=
  P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic
    ((Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := ℚ) c).algHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ F K))

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.ext'
statement:
theorem ext' {x y : QbarPoint K} (hP : x.P = y.P)
    (hσ : ∀ a : x.P.1, x.σ (x.P.residue a) = y.σ (y.P.residue ⟨a.1, hP ▸ a.2⟩)) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, σ⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨Q, τ⟩ := y
  obtain rfl : P = Q := hP
  simp only [mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
  ext b
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := P.residue_surjective b
  exact hσ a

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_zero : x.eval 0 x.P.1.zero_mem = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval, show (⟨0, x.P.1.zero_mem⟩ : x.P.1) = 0 from rfl]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_one : x.eval 1 x.P.1.one_mem = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval, show (⟨1, x.P.1.one_mem⟩ : x.P.1) = 1 from rfl]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_add
statement:
theorem eval_add (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (hg : g ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval (f + g) (x.P.1.add_mem _ _ hf hg) = x.eval f hf + x.eval g hg
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, ← map_add]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_mul
statement:
theorem eval_mul (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (hg : g ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval (f * g) (x.P.1.mul_mem _ _ hf hg) = x.eval f hf * x.eval g hg
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, ← map_mul]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_neg
statement: theorem eval_neg (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : x.eval (-f) (x.P.1.neg_mem _ hf) = -x.eval f hf
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, ← map_neg]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_sub
statement:
theorem eval_sub (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (hg : g ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval (f - g) (sub_mem hf hg) = x.eval f hf - x.eval g hg
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, ← map_sub]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_pow
statement:
theorem eval_pow (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (n : ℕ) :
    x.eval (f ^ n) (pow_mem hf n) = x.eval f hf ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval, ← map_pow]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_congr
statement:
theorem eval_congr {f g : K} (h : f = g) (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval f hf = x.eval g (h ▸ hf)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_ratCast (q : ℚ) : x.eval (q : K) (x.P.ratCast_mem q) = (q : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval, Place.residue_mk_ratCast, map_ratCast]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_algebraMap (q : ℚ) :
    x.eval (algebraMap ℚ K q) (x.P.algebraMap_mem q) = algebraMap ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) q
proof:
:=
  x.eval_ratCast q

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_eq_zero_iff_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem eval_eq_zero_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval f hf = 0 ↔ (⟨f, hf⟩ : x.P.1) ∈ maximalIdeal x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval, map_eq_zero_iff _ x.σ.injective, Place.residue_eq_zero_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eval_eq_zero_iff (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    x.eval f hf = 0 ↔ 0 < x.P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_eq_zero_iff_mem_maximalIdeal, x.P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨f, hf⟩) hf0]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_eq_zero_iff'
statement: theorem eval_eq_zero_iff' (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : x.eval f hf = 0 ↔ f = 0 ∨ 0 < x.P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · simp
  · simp [x.eval_eq_zero_iff hf hf0, hf0]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_inv
statement:
theorem eval_inv (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (hfi : f⁻¹ ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.eval f⁻¹ hfi = (x.eval f hf)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · have h0 : ∀ h, x.eval 0 h = 0 := fun _ ↦ x.eval_zero
    simp only [inv_zero, h0]
  refine (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_)
  rw [← x.eval_mul hfi hf, x.eval_congr (inv_mul_cancel₀ hf0), eval_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_mem_fieldOf
statement: theorem eval_mem_fieldOf (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : x.eval f hf ∈ x.fieldOf
proof:
:=
  ⟨x.P.residue ⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.deg_eq
statement: theorem deg_eq : x.deg = x.P.deg
proof:
:=
  x.residueFieldEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.deg_pos
statement: theorem deg_pos : 0 < x.deg
proof: := x.deg_eq ▸ x.P.deg_pos

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.exists_P_eq
statement: theorem exists_P_eq (P : Place K) : ∃ x : QbarPoint K, x.P = P
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨P, (IsAlgClosed.lift (R := ℚ) (S := P.ResidueField) (M := AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).toRingHom⟩,
    rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.finite_setOf_mem
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_mem {S : Set (Place K)} (hS : S.Finite) :
    {x : QbarPoint K | x.P ∈ S}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite S := hS.to_subtype
  let g : (Σ P : S, P.1.ResidueField →+* AlgebraicClosure ℚ) → QbarPoint K :=
    fun p ↦ ⟨p.1.1, p.2⟩
  refine (Set.finite_range g).subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
  exact ⟨⟨⟨x.P, hx⟩, x.σ⟩, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem valuation_eq_one_iff {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) : P.1.valuation x = 1 ↔ P.ord x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.ord_eq_zero_iff hx, ← P.1.valuation_le_one_iff, ← P.1.valuation_le_one_iff, map_inv₀]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, inv_one]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h0 : P.1.valuation x ≠ 0 := by simpa using hx
    exact le_antisymm h1 ((inv_le_one₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr h0)).mp h2)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one'
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one' {x : K} (hx : P.1.valuation x = 1) : P.ord x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hx
    exact zero_ne_one hx
  exact (P.valuation_eq_one_iff hx0).mp hx

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero
statement: theorem isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero {a : P.1} (ha : (a : K) ≠ 0) : IsUnit a ↔ P.ord a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_eq_one_iff, P.valuation_eq_one_iff ha]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.aeval_mem
statement: theorem aeval_mem {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) : aeval x p ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  CurveDeriv.aeval_mem P.algebraMap_mem hx p

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_aeval
statement:
theorem residue_aeval {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) :
    P.residue ⟨aeval x p, P.aeval_mem hx p⟩ = aeval (P.residue ⟨x, hx⟩) p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (⟨aeval x p, P.aeval_mem hx p⟩ : P.1) = eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change aeval x p = P.1.subtype (eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p)
    rw [hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
    congr 1
  rw [h1, hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext_rat _ _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.aeval_mem_nonunits_iff
statement:
theorem aeval_mem_nonunits_iff {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) :
    aeval x p ∈ P.1.nonunits ↔ aeval (P.residue ⟨x, hx⟩) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← residue_aeval, residue_eq_zero_iff, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isIntegral_residue
statement: theorem isIntegral_residue (a : P.1) : IsIntegral ℚ (P.residue a)
proof:
:=
  Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.resMinpoly_ne_zero
statement: theorem resMinpoly_ne_zero {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) : P.resMinpoly hx ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  minpoly.ne_zero (P.isIntegral_residue _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.irreducible_resMinpoly
statement: theorem irreducible_resMinpoly {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) : Irreducible (P.resMinpoly hx)
proof:
:=
  minpoly.irreducible (P.isIntegral_residue _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.separable_resMinpoly
statement: theorem separable_resMinpoly {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) : (P.resMinpoly hx).Separable
proof:
:=
  (P.irreducible_resMinpoly hx).separable

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.aeval_resMinpoly_mem_nonunits
statement:
theorem aeval_resMinpoly_mem_nonunits {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) :
    aeval x (P.resMinpoly hx) ∈ P.1.nonunits
proof:
:=
  (P.aeval_mem_nonunits_iff hx _).mpr (minpoly.aeval _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ p : ℚ[X], p ≠ 0 ∧ P.1.valuation (aeval x p) < 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.resMinpoly hx, P.resMinpoly_ne_zero hx, ?_⟩
  have := P.aeval_resMinpoly_mem_nonunits hx
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff] at this
  exact this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.transcendental_uniformizer
statement: theorem transcendental_uniformizer : Transcendental ℚ P.uniformizer
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic h
  rw [ord_uniformizer] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.uniformizer_mem
statement: theorem uniformizer_mem : P.uniformizer ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (by rw [ord_uniformizer]; exact zero_le_one)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.irreducible_uniformizer
statement: theorem irreducible_uniformizer : Irreducible (⟨P.uniformizer, P.uniformizer_mem⟩ : P.1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := (P.isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero (a := ⟨P.uniformizer, P.uniformizer_mem⟩)
      P.uniformizer_ne_zero).mp h
    rw [ord_uniformizer] at this
    exact one_ne_zero this
  · have hab' : P.uniformizer = (a : K) * b := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    have ha0 : (a : K) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ P.uniformizer_ne_zero (by rw [hab', h, zero_mul])
    have hb0 : (b : K) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ P.uniformizer_ne_zero (by rw [hab', h, mul_zero])
    have hsum := P.ord_mul ha0 hb0
    rw [← hab', ord_uniformizer] at hsum
    have ha := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem a.2
    have hb := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem b.2
    rw [P.isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero ha0, P.isUnit_iff_ord_eq_zero hb0]
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.derivAlong_uniformizer_mem
statement:
theorem derivAlong_uniformizer_mem {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) :
    derivAlong P.uniformizer x ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  derivAlong_mem P.1 P.transcendental_uniformizer P.algebraMap_mem
    (fun _ hy ↦ P.exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one hy) P.uniformizer_mem P.irreducible_uniformizer hx

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.valuation_mul_uniformizer_zpow
statement:
theorem valuation_mul_uniformizer_zpow {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    P.1.valuation (x * P.uniformizer ^ (-P.ord x)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.valuation_eq_one_iff (mul_ne_zero hx (zpow_ne_zero _ P.uniformizer_ne_zero)),
    P.ord_mul hx (zpow_ne_zero _ P.uniformizer_ne_zero), ord_zpow, ord_uniformizer]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.eq_unit_mul_pow
statement:
theorem eq_unit_mul_pow {x : K} {e : ℕ} (he : P.ord x = e) :
    x = x * P.uniformizer ^ (-P.ord x) * P.uniformizer ^ e
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ P.uniformizer_ne_zero, he, neg_add_cancel,
    zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_of_mem
statement: theorem ramIdx_of_mem (h : t ∈ P.1) : (ramIdx t P : ℤ) = P.ord (aeval t (P.resMinpoly h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramIdx, dif_pos h, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (P.aeval_mem h _))]

name: Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_of_notMem
statement: theorem ramIdx_of_notMem (h : t ∉ P.1) : (ramIdx t P : ℤ) = -P.ord t
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramIdx, dif_neg h, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]
  have := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.aeval_resMinpoly_ne_zero
statement:
theorem aeval_resMinpoly_ne_zero (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) (h : t ∈ P.1) :
    aeval t (P.resMinpoly h) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h0 ↦ ht ⟨_, P.resMinpoly_ne_zero h, h0⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_pos
statement: theorem ramIdx_pos (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) (P : Place K) : 0 < ramIdx t P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : t ∈ P.1
  · have := (P.ord_pos_iff).mpr ⟨aeval_resMinpoly_ne_zero ht h,
      P.aeval_resMinpoly_mem_nonunits h⟩
    rw [← ramIdx_of_mem h] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  · have := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
    have h2 := ramIdx_of_notMem h
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.ramIdx_of_residue_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramIdx_of_mem h, Place.resMinpoly, hc, minpoly.eq_X_sub_C]
  simp

name: Belyi.CurveField.residue_eq_zero_iff_ord_pos
statement:
theorem residue_eq_zero_iff_ord_pos (h : t ∈ P.1) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    P.residue ⟨t, h⟩ = 0 ↔ 0 < P.ord t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Place.residue_eq_zero_iff, P.ord_pos_iff, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff]
  simp [ht]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_derivAlong_of_mem
statement:
theorem ord_derivAlong_of_mem (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) (h : t ∈ P.1) :
    P.ord (derivAlong P.uniformizer t) = ramIdx t P - 1
proof:
:= by
  set e := ramIdx t P with he
  have he1 : 1 ≤ e := ramIdx_pos ht P
  have hm0 := aeval_resMinpoly_ne_zero ht h
  have hord : P.ord (aeval t (P.resMinpoly h)) = e := (ramIdx_of_mem h).symm
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hD⟩ := derivAlong_eq_unit_mul_pow_of_aeval P.transcendental_uniformizer
    P.algebraMap_mem (fun _ hy ↦ P.exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one hy) P.uniformizer_mem
    P.irreducible_uniformizer h (P.separable_resMinpoly h)
    (P.valuation_mul_uniformizer_zpow hm0) he1 (P.eq_unit_mul_pow hord)
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hw
    exact zero_ne_one hw
  rw [hD, P.ord_mul hw0 (pow_ne_zero _ P.uniformizer_ne_zero), ord_pow, ord_uniformizer,
    P.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one' hw]
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub he1]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_derivAlong_of_notMem
statement:
theorem ord_derivAlong_of_notMem (h : t ∉ P.1) :
    P.ord (derivAlong P.uniformizer t) = -ramIdx t P - 1
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h (h0 ▸ P.1.zero_mem)
  set e := ramIdx t P with he
  have hneg := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
  have he' : (e : ℤ) = -P.ord t := ramIdx_of_notMem h
  have he1 : 1 ≤ e := by omega
  have hord : P.ord t⁻¹ = e := by rw [ord_inv, he']
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hD⟩ := derivAlong_eq_unit_mul_zpow_of_inv P.transcendental_uniformizer
    P.algebraMap_mem (fun _ hy ↦ P.exists_valuation_aeval_lt_one hy) P.uniformizer_mem
    P.irreducible_uniformizer (P.valuation_mul_uniformizer_zpow (inv_ne_zero ht0)) he1
    (P.eq_unit_mul_pow hord)
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hw
    exact zero_ne_one hw
  rw [hD, P.ord_mul hw0 (zpow_ne_zero _ P.uniformizer_ne_zero), ord_zpow, ord_uniformizer,
    P.ord_eq_zero_of_valuation_eq_one' hw]
  ring

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.derivAlong_uniformizer_ne_zero
statement:
theorem derivAlong_uniformizer_ne_zero (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    derivAlong P.uniformizer t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin ht
  intro h0
  have h1 := derivAlong_mul_derivAlong P.transcendental_uniformizer ht
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at h1
  exact zero_ne_one h1

name: Belyi.CurveField.derivAlong_uniformizer_notMem
statement:
theorem derivAlong_uniformizer_notMem (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) (h : t ∈ P.1)
    (h1 : 1 < ramIdx t P) : derivAlong t P.uniformizer ∉ P.1
proof:
:= by
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin ht
  intro hmem
  have hprod := derivAlong_mul_derivAlong P.transcendental_uniformizer ht
  have h0 : derivAlong t P.uniformizer ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hprod
    exact zero_ne_one hprod
  have hord := congrArg P.ord hprod
  rw [P.ord_mul h0 (P.derivAlong_uniformizer_ne_zero ht), Place.ord_one,
    P.ord_derivAlong_of_mem ht h] at hord
  have := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem hmem
  have h1' : (1 : ℤ) < ramIdx t P := by exact_mod_cast h1
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_one_lt_ramIdx (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    {P : Place K | 1 < ramIdx t P}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ t) := ⟨ht⟩
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin ht
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Algebra.FiniteType.out : (⊤ : Subalgebra ℚ (chartRing t)).FG)
  have hfin : ({P : Place K | t ∉ P.1} ∪
      ⋃ b ∈ s, {P : Place K | derivAlong t (b : K) ∉ P.1}).Finite :=
    (Place.finite_setOf_notMem t).union
      (s.finite_toSet.biUnion fun b _ ↦ Place.finite_setOf_notMem _)
  refine hfin.subset fun P hP ↦ ?_
  by_contra hPn
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, not_or, not_exists,
    not_not] at hPn
  obtain ⟨htP, hgen⟩ := hPn
  
  have hA : ∀ a : chartRing t, derivAlong t (a : K) ∈ P.1 := by
    intro a
    have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (s : Set (chartRing t)) := by rw [hs]; trivial
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact hgen x hx
    | algebraMap q =>
      have : ((algebraMap ℚ (chartRing t) q : chartRing t) : K) = algebraMap ℚ K q := rfl
      rw [this, derivAlong_algebraMap]
      exact P.1.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hx hy
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact add_mem (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP x) hy)
        (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP y) hx)
  
  have hO : ∀ x ∈ P.1, derivAlong t x ∈ P.1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (Place.ofChart t (P.toChart t htP)).1 := by
      rw [Place.ofChart_toChart]; exact hx
    rw [Place.ofChart_val] at hx'
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx'
    have hbu : (algebraMap (chartRing t) K b)⁻¹ ∈ P.1 := by
      have hbn : algebraMap (chartRing t) K b ∉ P.1.nonunits := by
        exact fun h ↦ hb ((Place.mem_toChart_iff t P htP).mpr h)
      rw [ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at hbn
      exact hbn.2
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine add_mem (mul_mem (P.algebraMap_chartRing_mem t htP a) ?_) (mul_mem hbu (hA a))
    rw [Derivation.leibniz_inv, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_mem (neg_mem (pow_mem hbu 2)) (hA b)
  exact derivAlong_uniformizer_notMem ht htP hP (hO _ P.uniformizer_mem)

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.mem_adjoin
statement: theorem mem_adjoin (f : K) : f ∈ ℚ⟮t⟯
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht.adjoin_eq_top]; trivial

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.algebraMap_bijective
statement: theorem algebraMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (algebraMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(algebraMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K).injective, fun f ↦ ⟨⟨f, ht.mem_adjoin f⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.finiteDimensional
statement: theorem finiteDimensional : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_surjective (Algebra.linearMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K) ht.algebraMap_bijective.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.finrank_eq_one
statement: theorem finrank_eq_one : Module.finrank ℚ⟮t⟯ K = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.linearMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K)
    ht.algebraMap_bijective).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.isCurveField
statement: theorem isCurveField : IsCurveField K
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨t, ht.transcendental, ht.finiteDimensional⟩⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.ne_zero
statement: theorem ne_zero : t ≠ 0
proof: := ne_zero_of_transcendental ht.transcendental

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.aeval_ne_zero
statement: theorem aeval_ne_zero {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : aeval t p ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ ht.transcendental ⟨p, hp, h⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.exists_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_coprime (f : K) :
    ∃ p q : ℚ[X], q ≠ 0 ∧ IsCoprime p q ∧ f = aeval t p / aeval t q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, s, rfl⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff (F := ℚ) f).mp (ht.mem_adjoin f)
  rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with rfl | hs
  · exact ⟨0, 1, one_ne_zero, isCoprime_zero_left.mpr isUnit_one, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, hr, hs', hu⟩ := extract_gcd r s
  have hg : gcd r s ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hs ((gcd_eq_zero_iff r s).mp h).2
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hs (by rw [hs', mul_zero])
  refine ⟨p, q, hq, (gcd_isUnit_iff_isRelPrime.mp hu).isCoprime, ?_⟩
  set g := gcd r s
  rw [hr, hs', map_mul, map_mul, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (ht.aeval_ne_zero hg)]

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.inv
statement: theorem inv : IsRationalGenerator t⁻¹
proof:
:=
  ⟨transcendental_inv ht.transcendental, by rw [adjoin_inv_eq, ht.adjoin_eq_top]⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.sub_ratCast
statement: theorem sub_ratCast (q : ℚ) : IsRationalGenerator (t - q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := ht.transcendental.aeval (X - C q) (by rw [natDegree_X_sub_C]; exact one_ne_zero)
      (by rw [leadingCoeff_X_sub_C]; exact one_mem _)
    simpa using this
  · rw [eq_top_iff, ← ht.adjoin_eq_top, IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    have h := sub_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ (t - q))
      (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem ℚ⟮t - q⟯ (-q))
    simpa using h

name: Belyi.CurveField.IsRationalGenerator.sub_one
statement: theorem sub_one : IsRationalGenerator (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ht.sub_ratCast 1

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero {f : K} (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) (h : x.eval f hf ≠ 0) :
    f⁻¹ ∈ x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, eval_eq_zero_iff_mem_maximalIdeal, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff,
    ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, not_or, not_not] at h
  exact h.2

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.div_mem
statement:
theorem div_mem {p q : ℚ[X]} (hq : aeval (x.eval t hx) q ≠ 0) :
    aeval t p / aeval t q ∈ x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← x.eval_aeval hx q] at hq
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_mem (x.P.aeval_mem hx p) (x.inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero _ hq)

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_div
statement:
theorem eval_div {p q : ℚ[X]} (hq : aeval (x.eval t hx) q ≠ 0) :
    x.eval (aeval t p / aeval t q) (x.div_mem hx hq) =
      aeval (x.eval t hx) p / aeval (x.eval t hx) q
proof:
:= by
  have hq' := hq
  rw [← x.eval_aeval hx q] at hq'
  have hi := x.inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero _ hq'
  rw [x.eval_congr (div_eq_mul_inv _ _), x.eval_mul (x.P.aeval_mem hx p) hi,
    x.eval_inv (x.P.aeval_mem hx q) hi, x.eval_aeval hx, x.eval_aeval hx, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.div_notMem
statement:
theorem div_notMem (htr : Transcendental ℚ t) {p q : ℚ[X]} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hpq : IsCoprime p q)
    (hq : aeval (x.eval t hx) q = 0) : aeval t p / aeval t q ∉ x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  set z := x.eval t hx
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hpq
  have hp : aeval z p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    have := congrArg (aeval z) hab
    rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hp, hq, map_one] at this
    simp at this
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hp (map_zero _)
  have htp : aeval t p ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htr ⟨p, hp0, h⟩
  have htq : aeval t q ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htr ⟨q, hq0, h⟩
  intro hf
  have hg := x.div_mem hx (p := q) hp
  have h1 : aeval t p / aeval t q * (aeval t q / aeval t p) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  have := x.eval_mul hf hg
  rw [x.eval_congr h1, eval_one, x.eval_div hx hp, hq, zero_div, mul_zero] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.div_mem_iff
statement:
theorem div_mem_iff (htr : Transcendental ℚ t) {p q : ℚ[X]} (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : IsCoprime p q) : aeval t p / aeval t q ∈ x.P.1 ↔ aeval (x.eval t hx) q ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h hq ↦ x.div_notMem hx htr hq0 hpq hq h, x.div_mem hx⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_inv_self
statement:
theorem eval_inv_self (hz : x.eval t hx ≠ 0) :
    x.eval t⁻¹ (x.inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero hx hz) = (x.eval t hx)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  x.eval_inv hx _

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.one_sub_mem
statement: theorem one_sub_mem (hz : x.eval t hx ≠ 1) : (1 - t)⁻¹ ∈ x.P.1
proof:
:= by
  refine x.inv_mem_of_eval_ne_zero (sub_mem x.P.1.one_mem hx) ?_
  rw [x.eval_sub x.P.1.one_mem hx, eval_one, sub_ne_zero]
  exact hz.symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem eval_one_sub_inv (hz : x.eval t hx ≠ 1) :
    x.eval (1 - t)⁻¹ (x.one_sub_mem hx hz) = (1 - x.eval t hx)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [x.eval_inv (sub_mem x.P.1.one_mem hx), x.eval_sub x.P.1.one_mem hx, eval_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.mem_iff_of_eval_eq
statement:
theorem mem_iff_of_eval_eq {x y : QbarPoint K} {hx : t ∈ x.P.1} {hy : t ∈ y.P.1}
    (h : x.eval t hx = y.eval t hy) (f : K) : f ∈ x.P.1 ↔ f ∈ y.P.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq0, hpq, rfl⟩ := ht.exists_coprime f
  rw [x.div_mem_iff hx ht.transcendental hq0 hpq, y.div_mem_iff hy ht.transcendental hq0 hpq, h]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eq_of_eval_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_eval_eq {x y : QbarPoint K} {hx : t ∈ x.P.1} {hy : t ∈ y.P.1}
    (h : x.eval t hx = y.eval t hy) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hP : x.P = y.P := Place.ext (ValuationSubring.ext _ _ (mem_iff_of_eval_eq ht h))
  refine QbarPoint.ext' hP fun a ↦ ?_
  change x.eval a.1 a.2 = y.eval a.1 _
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq0, hpq, hf⟩ := ht.exists_coprime a.1
  have hqx : aeval (x.eval t hx) q ≠ 0 :=
    (x.div_mem_iff hx ht.transcendental hq0 hpq).mp (hf ▸ a.2)
  have hqy : aeval (y.eval t hy) q ≠ 0 := h ▸ hqx
  rw [x.eval_congr hf, x.eval_div hx hqx, y.eval_congr hf, y.eval_div hy hqy, h]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.exists_eval_eq
statement:
theorem exists_eval_eq [IsCurveField K] (z : Qbar) :
    ∃ (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1), x.eval t hx = z
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsIntegral ℚ z := (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic z).isIntegral
  set m := minpoly ℚ z
  have hmd : m.natDegree ≠ 0 := (minpoly.natDegree_pos hz).ne'
