  have hmm : m.Monic := minpoly.monic hz
  have hf : Transcendental ℚ (aeval t m) :=
    ht.transcendental.aeval m hmd (by rw [hmm.leadingCoeff]; exact one_mem _)
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Place.exists_ord_pos hf
  have hfP : aeval t m ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg hP.le
  
  have htP : t ∈ P.1 := by
    have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1 K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn P.1 K)
    have hint : IsIntegral P.1 t := by
      refine IsIntegral.of_aeval_monic_of_isIntegral_coeff (p := m.map (algebraMap ℚ K))
        (hmm.map _) (by rwa [natDegree_map]) ?_ fun i ↦ ?_
      · rw [eval_map_algebraMap]
        exact isIntegral_algebraMap (x := (⟨_, hfP⟩ : P.1))
      · rw [coeff_map]
        exact isIntegral_algebraMap (x := (⟨_, P.algebraMap_mem _⟩ : P.1))
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosedIn.isIntegral_iff.mp hint
    rw [← hy]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_P_eq P
  have hw : aeval (x₀.eval t htP) m = 0 := by
    rw [← x₀.eval_aeval htP m]
    exact (x₀.eval_eq_zero_iff _ (ne_zero_of_transcendental hf)).mpr hP
  have hmin : minpoly ℚ z = minpoly ℚ (x₀.eval t htP) :=
    minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (minpoly.irreducible hz) hw hmm
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (Normal.minpoly_eq_iff_mem_orbit (F := ℚ) (E := Qbar)).mp hmin
  refine ⟨⟨x₀.P, (τ : Qbar →+* Qbar).comp x₀.σ⟩, htP, ?_⟩
  exact hτ

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.equivQbar_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivQbar_apply [IsCurveField K] (ht : IsRationalGenerator t)
    (x : {x : QbarPoint K // t ∈ x.P.1}) : equivQbar ht x = x.1.eval t x.2
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_equivQbar_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_equivQbar_symm [IsCurveField K] (ht : IsRationalGenerator t) (z : Qbar) :
    ((equivQbar ht).symm z).1.eval t ((equivQbar ht).symm z).2 = z
proof:
:=
  (equivQbar ht).apply_symm_apply z

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.fieldOf_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem fieldOf_eq_adjoin (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.fieldOf = ℚ⟮x.eval t hx⟯
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr (x.eval_mem_fieldOf hx))
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := x.P.residue_surjective b
  change x.eval a.1 a.2 ∈ _
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq0, hpq, hf⟩ := ht.exists_coprime a.1
  have hqx : aeval (x.eval t hx) q ≠ 0 :=
    (x.div_mem_iff hx ht.transcendental hq0 hpq).mp (hf ▸ a.2)
  rw [x.eval_congr hf, x.eval_div hx hqx]
  exact (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff (F := ℚ) _).mpr ⟨p, q, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.deg_eq_finrank_adjoin
statement:
theorem deg_eq_finrank_adjoin (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.deg = Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮x.eval t hx⟯
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg, fieldOf_eq_adjoin ht x hx]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.deg_eq_natDegree_minpoly
statement:
theorem deg_eq_natDegree_minpoly (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.deg = (minpoly ℚ (x.eval t hx)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg_eq_finrank_adjoin ht x hx,
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic _).isIntegral]

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem [IsCurveField K] {f : K} (hf : ∀ P : Place K, t ∈ P.1 → f ∈ P.1) :
    f ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq0, hpq, rfl⟩ := ht.exists_coprime f
  have hdeg : q.degree = 0 := by
    by_contra hd
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero (k := Qbar) q hd
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_eval_eq ht z
    exact x.div_notMem hx ht.transcendental hq0 hpq hz (hf x.P hx)
  rw [eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero hdeg, aeval_C, div_eq_mul_inv, ← map_inv₀]
  exact mul_mem (Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval ℚ t ▸ ⟨p, rfl⟩)
    (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.forall_mem_iff
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff [IsCurveField K] (f : K) :
    (∀ P : Place K, t ∈ P.1 → f ∈ P.1) ↔ f ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem ht, fun hf P hP ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at hf
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact P.aeval_mem hP p

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_chartRing_iff
statement: theorem mem_chartRing_iff (f : K) : f ∈ chartRing t ↔ f ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}
proof:
:= by
  have := ht.isCurveField
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem ht fun P hP ↦ ?_, mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin⟩
  exact mem_of_mem_chartRing P.1 P.ratCast_mem hP hf

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.one_le_term
statement: private theorem one_le_term {P : Place K} (hP : P.ord s < 0) : 1 ≤ (-P.ord s) * (P.deg : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (by omega) (by exact_mod_cast P.deg_pos)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.sum_poles_eq_one
statement:
private theorem sum_poles_eq_one :
    ∑ P ∈ (finite_setOf_ord_neg s).toFinset, (-P.ord s) * (P.deg : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_ord_mul_deg_poles s hs.transcendental, hs.finrank_eq_one, Nat.cast_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.mem_poles
statement:
private theorem mem_poles {P : Place K} :
    P ∈ (finite_setOf_ord_neg s).toFinset ↔ P.ord s < 0
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.term_nonneg
statement:
private theorem term_nonneg :
    ∀ P ∈ (finite_setOf_ord_neg s).toFinset, (0 : ℤ) ≤ (-P.ord s) * (P.deg : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hP ↦ zero_le_one.trans (one_le_term (mem_poles.mp hP))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.term_eq_one
statement:
private theorem term_eq_one {P : Place K} (hP : P.ord s < 0) :
    (-P.ord s) * (P.deg : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (one_le_term hP)
  rw [← sum_poles_eq_one hs]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum term_nonneg (mem_poles.mpr hP)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.ord_eq_neg_one_of_ord_neg
statement: theorem ord_eq_neg_one_of_ord_neg {P : Place K} (hP : P.ord s < 0) : P.ord s = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h := term_eq_one hs hP
  have := P.deg_pos
  have hd : (1 : ℤ) ≤ P.deg := by exact_mod_cast this
  nlinarith

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.deg_eq_one_of_ord_neg
statement: theorem deg_eq_one_of_ord_neg {P : Place K} (hP : P.ord s < 0) : P.deg = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := term_eq_one hs hP
  rw [ord_eq_neg_one_of_ord_neg hs hP, neg_neg, one_mul] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.eq_of_ord_neg
statement: theorem eq_of_ord_neg {P Q : Place K} (hP : P.ord s < 0) (hQ : Q.ord s < 0) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have hsub : {P, Q} ⊆ (finite_setOf_ord_neg s).toFinset := by
    intro R hR
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hR
    rw [mem_poles]
    rcases hR with rfl | rfl
    exacts [hP, hQ]
  have := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun R hR _ ↦ term_nonneg R hR)
  rw [Finset.sum_pair hne, sum_poles_eq_one hs, term_eq_one hs hP, term_eq_one hs hQ] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.existsUnique_ord_neg
statement: theorem existsUnique_ord_neg : ∃! P : Place K, P.ord s < 0
proof:
:=
  let ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_ord_neg hs.transcendental
  ⟨P, hP, fun _ hQ ↦ eq_of_ord_neg hs hQ hP⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.notMem_infPlace
statement: theorem notMem_infPlace : t ∉ (infPlace t).1
proof:
:=
  Classical.epsilon_spec (Place.exists_notMem ht.transcendental)

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_infPlace_neg
statement: theorem ord_infPlace_neg : (infPlace t).ord t < 0
proof:
:=
  (Place.ord_neg_iff _).mpr (notMem_infPlace ht)

name: Belyi.CurveField.eq_infPlace_iff
statement: theorem eq_infPlace_iff {P : Place K} : P = infPlace t ↔ t ∉ P.1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ notMem_infPlace ht, fun h ↦
    Place.eq_of_ord_neg ht ((Place.ord_neg_iff _).mpr h) (ord_infPlace_neg ht)⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg
statement: theorem eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg {P : Place K} : P = infPlace t ↔ P.ord t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_infPlace_iff ht, Place.ord_neg_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_of_ne_infPlace
statement: theorem mem_of_ne_infPlace {P : Place K} (hP : P ≠ infPlace t) : t ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  not_not.mp fun h ↦ hP ((eq_infPlace_iff ht).mpr h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_infPlace
statement: theorem ord_infPlace : (infPlace t).ord t = -1
proof:
:=
  Place.ord_eq_neg_one_of_ord_neg ht (ord_infPlace_neg ht)

name: Belyi.CurveField.deg_infPlace
statement: theorem deg_infPlace : (infPlace t).deg = 1
proof:
:=
  Place.deg_eq_one_of_ord_neg ht (ord_infPlace_neg ht)

name: Belyi.CurveField.inv_mem_infPlace
statement: theorem inv_mem_infPlace : t⁻¹ ∈ (infPlace t).1
proof:
:=
  ((infPlace t).mem_or_inv_mem t).resolve_left (notMem_infPlace ht)

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_inv_eq_zero_of_P_eq
statement:
theorem eval_inv_eq_zero_of_P_eq {x : QbarPoint K} (hx : x.P = infPlace t) :
    x.eval t⁻¹ (hx ▸ inv_mem_infPlace ht) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [x.eval_eq_zero_iff _ (inv_ne_zero ht.ne_zero), Place.ord_inv, hx, ord_infPlace ht]
  decide

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.existsUnique_P_eq_infPlace
statement: theorem existsUnique_P_eq_infPlace : ∃! x : QbarPoint K, x.P = infPlace t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_P_eq (infPlace t)
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun y hy ↦ eq_of_eval_eq (hx := hy ▸ inv_mem_infPlace ht)
    (hy := hx ▸ inv_mem_infPlace ht) ht.inv ?_⟩
  rw [eval_inv_eq_zero_of_P_eq ht hy, eval_inv_eq_zero_of_P_eq ht hx]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.minpolyAt_monic
statement: theorem minpolyAt_monic (P : Place K) (hP : t ∈ P.1) : (P.minpolyAt hP).Monic
proof:
:=
  minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.minpolyAt_irreducible
statement: theorem minpolyAt_irreducible (P : Place K) (hP : t ∈ P.1) : Irreducible (P.minpolyAt hP)
proof:
:=
  minpoly.irreducible (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.minpolyAt_P
statement:
theorem _root_.Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.minpolyAt_P (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.P.minpolyAt hx = minpoly ℚ (x.eval t hx)
proof:
:=
  (minpoly.algHom_eq x.σ.toRatAlgHom x.σ.injective _).symm

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_P_eq_eval_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := QbarPoint.exists_P_eq P
  have hmin : minpoly ℚ z = minpoly ℚ (x₀.eval t hP) := by
    rw [← x₀.minpolyAt_P hP]
    exact (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (x₀.P.minpolyAt_irreducible hP) hz
      (x₀.P.minpolyAt_monic hP)).symm
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (Normal.minpoly_eq_iff_mem_orbit (F := ℚ) (E := Qbar)).mp hmin
  exact ⟨⟨x₀.P, (τ : Qbar →+* Qbar).comp x₀.σ⟩, rfl, hτ⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.algebraMap_eq_residue
statement: theorem algebraMap_eq_residue : algebraMap P.1 P.ResidueField = P.residue
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_surjective
statement: theorem residue_surjective : Function.Surjective P.residue
proof: := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem residue_eq_zero_iff {a : P.1} : P.residue a = 0 ↔ a ∈ maximalIdeal P.1
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff a

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.coe_ratHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ratHom (q : ℚ) : (P.ratHom q : K) = q
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_ratHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem residue_ratHom (q : ℚ) : P.residue (P.ratHom q) = (q : P.ResidueField)
proof:
:=
  map_ratCast (P.residue.comp P.ratHom) q

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.residue_mk_ratCast
statement:
theorem residue_mk_ratCast (q : ℚ) :
    P.residue ⟨(q : K), P.ratCast_mem q⟩ = (q : P.ResidueField)
proof:
:=
  P.residue_ratHom q

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.deg_pos
statement: theorem deg_pos : 0 < P.deg
proof: := Module.finrank_pos

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.pow_mem_L
statement: theorem pow_mem_L (x : K) (k : ℕ) : x ^ k ∈ L (k • polarDivisor x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, polarDivisor_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, Place.ord_pow]
  have h1 := le_max_right 0 (-P.ord x)
  have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k := Int.natCast_nonneg k
  nlinarith

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.aeval_mem_L
statement: theorem aeval_mem_L (x : K) (p : ℚ[X]) : aeval x p ∈ L (p.natDegree • polarDivisor x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (L_mono ?_ (pow_mem_L x i))
  exact nsmul_le_nsmul_left (polarDivisor_nonneg x)
    (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_aeval_ord_pos
statement:
theorem exists_aeval_ord_pos {x : K} (hx : Transcendental ℚ x) (P : Place K) (hxP : x ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ p : ℚ[X], aeval x p ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < P.ord (aeval x p)
proof:
:= by
  set r := P.residue ⟨x, hxP⟩
  have hint : IsIntegral ℚ r := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral r
  set p := minpoly ℚ r
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := minpoly.ne_zero hint
  have hy0 : aeval x p ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hx ⟨p, hp0, h⟩
  refine ⟨p, hy0, ?_⟩
  set e : P.1 := p.eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hxP⟩
  have hcomp : P.1.subtype.comp P.ratHom = algebraMap ℚ K := by
    ext q; simp [ValuationSubring.subtype]
  have he : (e : K) = aeval x p := by
    rw [aeval_def, ← hcomp]
    exact Polynomial.hom_eval₂ p P.ratHom P.1.subtype ⟨x, hxP⟩
  have hcomp' : P.residue.comp P.ratHom = algebraMap ℚ P.ResidueField := by
    ext q; simp
  have hres : P.residue e = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂, hcomp', ← aeval_def]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ r
  rw [← he]
  refine (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := e) (by rw [he]; exact hy0)).mpr ?_
  exact P.residue_eq_zero_iff.mp hres

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.single_le_polarDivisor
statement:
theorem single_le_polarDivisor {P : Place K} (hP : P.ord x < 0) :
    Finsupp.single P 1 ≤ polarDivisor x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Q
  by_cases hQ : P = Q
  · subst hQ; simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same, polarDivisor_apply]; omega
  · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg hQ]; exact polarDivisor_nonneg x Q

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_add_single_add_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_add_single_add_div_le {A : Divisor K} (P : Place K)
    (h : ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, A + div z ≤ l • polarDivisor x) :
    ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, A + Finsupp.single P 1 + div z ≤ l • polarDivisor x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz, l, hl⟩ := h
  by_cases hP : P.ord x < 0
  · refine ⟨z, hz, l + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [succ_nsmul, show A + Finsupp.single P 1 + div z = (A + div z) + Finsupp.single P 1 by
      abel]
    exact add_le_add hl (single_le_polarDivisor hP)
  obtain ⟨p, hy0, hypos⟩ := exists_aeval_ord_pos hx P (P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (not_lt.mp hP))
  have hyL := (mem_L.mp (aeval_mem_L x p)).resolve_left hy0
  refine ⟨z / aeval x p, div_ne_zero hz hy0, l + p.natDegree, ?_⟩
  rw [div_div hz hy0, add_nsmul, show A + Finsupp.single P 1 + (div z - div (aeval x p)) =
    (A + div z) + (Finsupp.single P 1 - div (aeval x p)) by abel]
  refine add_le_add hl fun Q ↦ ?_
  have h1 := hyL Q
  have h2 := (nsmul_nonneg (polarDivisor_nonneg x) p.natDegree) Q
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, div_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero,
    Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 ⊢
  by_cases hQ : P = Q
  · subst hQ; rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same]; omega
  · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg hQ]; omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_add_single_nat_add_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_add_single_nat_add_div_le {A : Divisor K} (P : Place K) (m : ℕ)
    (h : ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, A + div z ≤ l • polarDivisor x) :
    ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ) + div z ≤ l • polarDivisor x
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ m ih =>
    have := exists_add_single_add_div_le hx P ih
    rwa [Nat.cast_succ, Finsupp.single_add, ← add_assoc]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_add_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_add_div_le (A : Divisor K) :
    ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, A + div z ≤ l • polarDivisor x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction A using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
  | single_add P b f _ _ ih =>
    rcases le_or_gt b 0 with hb | hb
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, l, hl⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨z, hz, l, le_trans ?_ hl⟩
      rw [add_assoc]
      refine add_le_of_nonpos_left fun Q ↦ ?_
      rw [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp [hb]
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hb.le
      rw [add_comm]
      exact exists_add_single_nat_add_div_le hx P m ih

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_deg_sub_ell_nsmul_le
statement:
theorem exists_deg_sub_ell_nsmul_le :
    ∃ γ : ℤ, ∀ l : ℕ, (l • polarDivisor x).deg - ell (l • polarDivisor x) ≤ γ
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_adjoin hx
  set n := Module.finrank ℚ⟮x⟯ K
  let u := Module.finBasis ℚ⟮x⟯ K
  set B := polarDivisor x
  set C : Divisor K := ∑ i, polarDivisor (u i : K)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := fun Q ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ polarDivisor_nonneg _ Q
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hx
  refine ⟨C.deg - n, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have hmem : ∀ p : Fin (l + 1) × Fin n, x ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * u p.2 ∈ L (l • B + C) := by
    rintro ⟨k, i⟩
    refine Or.inr fun Q ↦ ?_
    rw [Q.ord_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hx0) (u.ne_zero i), Place.ord_pow]
    have hk : ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp k.2
    have hk0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (k : ℕ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have h1 := le_max_right 0 (-Q.ord x)
    have h1' := le_max_left 0 (-Q.ord x)
    have h2 := le_max_right 0 (-Q.ord (u i))
    have h3 : max 0 (-Q.ord (u i)) ≤ C Q := by
      rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ polarDivisor (u j : K) Q)
        (fun j _ ↦ polarDivisor_nonneg _ Q) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp only [B, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, polarDivisor_apply,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith
  
  have hpow : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun k : ℕ ↦ x ^ k) := by
    have := (Polynomial.basisMonomials ℚ).linearIndependent.map' (aeval x).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (transcendental_iff_injective.mp hx))
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Polynomial.coe_basisMonomials] using this
  let b : Fin (l + 1) → ℚ⟮x⟯ := fun k ↦ (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ x) ^ (k : ℕ)
  have hb : LinearIndependent ℚ b := by
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ ℚ⟮x⟯ K).toLinearMap ?_
    convert hpow.comp (Fin.val) Fin.val_injective using 1
    ext k
    simp [b]
  have hli := linearIndependent_smul hb u.linearIndependent
  have hv : ∀ p : Fin (l + 1) × Fin n, b p.1 • (u p.2 : K) = x ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * u p.2 := by
    intro p
    simp [b, Algebra.smul_def]
  let w : Fin (l + 1) × Fin n → L (l • B + C) := fun p ↦ ⟨x ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * u p.2, hmem p⟩
  have hw : LinearIndependent ℚ w := by
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp (L (l • B + C)).subtype ?_
    convert hli using 1
    ext p
    exact (hv p).symm
  have hcard := hw.fintype_card_le_finrank
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  have hdegD : (l • B + C).deg = l * n + C.deg := by
    rw [deg_add, deg_nsmul, deg_polarDivisor hx]
  have hmono := deg_sub_ell_mono (le_add_of_nonneg_right hC : l • B ≤ l • B + C)
  have hcard' : ((l : ℤ) + 1) * n ≤ ell (l • B + C) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  have : ((l : ℤ) + 1) * n = l * n + n := by ring
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_deg_sub_ell_le
statement: theorem exists_deg_sub_ell_le : ∃ γ : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor K, A.deg - ell A ≤ γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_transcendental K
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_deg_sub_ell_nsmul_le hx
  refine ⟨γ, fun A ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, l, hl⟩ := exists_add_div_le hx A
  have h := deg_sub_ell_mono hl
  rw [deg_add, deg_div, add_zero, ell_add_div A hz] at h
  exact h.trans (hγ l)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.bddAbove_range_deg_sub_ell
statement:
theorem bddAbove_range_deg_sub_ell :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun A : Divisor K ↦ A.deg - (ell A : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_deg_sub_ell_le (K := K)
  exact ⟨γ, by rintro _ ⟨A, rfl⟩; exact hγ A⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_sub_ell_le_riemannConst
statement: theorem deg_sub_ell_le_riemannConst (A : Divisor K) : A.deg - ell A ≤ riemannConst K
proof:
:=
  le_csSup bddAbove_range_deg_sub_ell ⟨A, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.riemann_inequality
statement: theorem riemann_inequality (A : Divisor K) : A.deg - riemannConst K ≤ ell A
proof:
:= by
  have := deg_sub_ell_le_riemannConst A
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_deg_sub_ell_eq_riemannConst
statement:
theorem exists_deg_sub_ell_eq_riemannConst :
    ∃ A : Divisor K, A.deg - ell A = riemannConst K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := Int.csSup_mem (Set.range_nonempty _) (bddAbove_range_deg_sub_ell (K := K))
  exact ⟨A, hA⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.riemann_equality
statement:
theorem riemann_equality :
    ∃ N0 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor K, N0 ≤ A.deg → (ell A : ℤ) = A.deg - riemannConst K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ := exists_deg_sub_ell_eq_riemannConst (K := K)
  refine ⟨A0.deg + riemannConst K + 1, fun A hA ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := riemann_inequality (A - A0)
  rw [deg_sub] at h1
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hle⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_div (A := A - A0) (by omega)
  have hle' : A0 ≤ A + div z := by
    intro Q
    have := hle Q
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero,
      Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢
    omega
  have h2 := deg_sub_ell_mono hle'
  rw [deg_add, deg_div, add_zero, ell_add_div A hz] at h2
  have h3 := deg_sub_ell_le_riemannConst A
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_riemann
statement:
theorem exists_riemann :
    ∃ g0 N0 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor K, N0 ≤ A.deg → (ell A : ℤ) = A.deg - g0
proof:
:=
  ⟨riemannConst K, riemann_equality⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_polarDivisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_polarDivisor_eq :
    ∃ N1 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor K, 0 ≤ A → N1 ≤ A.deg → ∃ f : K, polarDivisor f = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N0, hN0⟩ := riemann_equality (K := K)
  set g0 := riemannConst K
  set M : ℤ := max 0 (N0 + ell (0 : Divisor K))
  refine ⟨max (max N0 1) (M + g0 + 1), fun A hA hdeg ↦ ?_⟩
  have hdN0 : N0 ≤ A.deg := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hdeg
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ A.deg := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hdeg
  have hdM : M + g0 + 1 ≤ A.deg := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hdeg
  have hellA := hN0 A hdN0
  
  have hlt : ∀ P : Place K, ell (A - Finsupp.single P 1) < ell A := by
    intro P
    have hP := P.deg_pos
    by_cases hP' : N0 ≤ (A - Finsupp.single P 1).deg
    · have := hN0 _ hP'
      rw [deg_sub, deg_single] at this
      have : (ell (A - Finsupp.single P 1) : ℤ) < ell A := by
        rw [this, hellA]; omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have h1 := ell_le_max (A - Finsupp.single P 1)
      have h2 : max 0 ((A - Finsupp.single P 1).deg + (ell (0 : Divisor K) : ℤ)) ≤ M :=
        max_le_max le_rfl (by omega)
      have : (ell (A - Finsupp.single P 1) : ℤ) < ell A := by
        rw [hellA]; omega
      exact_mod_cast this
  let p : A.support → Submodule ℚ (L A) := fun P ↦
    (L (A - Finsupp.single P.1 1)).comap (L A).subtype
  have hp : ∀ P, p P ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro P h
    have hle : L A ≤ L (A - Finsupp.single P.1 1) := fun f hf ↦ by
      have : (⟨f, hf⟩ : L A) ∈ p P := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      exact this
    exact absurd (Submodule.finrank_mono hle) (not_le.mpr (hlt P.1))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Submodule.exists_forall_notMem_of_forall_ne_top p hp
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hd1
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hA0
  have hv0 : (v : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv ⟨P0, hP0⟩
    change (v : K) ∈ L _
    rw [h]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have hvL := (mem_L.mp v.2).resolve_left hv0
  refine ⟨v, Finsupp.ext fun Q ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [polarDivisor_apply]
  by_cases hQ : Q ∈ A.support
  · have hnot : (v : K) ∉ L (A - Finsupp.single Q 1) := hv ⟨Q, hQ⟩
    rw [mem_L, not_or] at hnot
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot.2
    have hRQ : R = Q := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hR
      simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hne] using hvL R
    subst hRQ
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, not_le] at hR
    have := hvL R
    have := hA R
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    omega
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hQ]
    have := hvL Q
    rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hQ] at this
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.posPart_apply
statement: theorem posPart_apply (A : Divisor K) (P : Place K) : posPart A P = max (A P) 0
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapRange_apply ..

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.posPart_nonneg
statement: theorem posPart_nonneg (A : Divisor K) : 0 ≤ posPart A
proof:
:= fun P ↦ by
  simp [posPart_apply]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.posPart_sub_posPart_neg
statement: theorem posPart_sub_posPart_neg (A : Divisor K) : posPart A - posPart (-A) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, posPart_apply, Finsupp.coe_neg, Pi.neg_apply]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_eq_polarDivisor_sub_polarDivisor
statement:
theorem exists_eq_polarDivisor_sub_polarDivisor (D : Divisor K) :
    ∃ f g : K, D = polarDivisor f - polarDivisor g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := exists_polarDivisor_eq (K := K)
  obtain P0 : Place K := Classical.arbitrary _
  set E : Divisor K := Finsupp.single P0 (N1.toNat : ℤ)
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  have hdegE : N1 ≤ E.deg := by
    rw [deg_single]
    have := P0.deg_pos
    have h1 : N1 ≤ (N1.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat N1
    have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ N1.toNat := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have key : ∀ A : Divisor K, 0 ≤ A → ∃ f : K, polarDivisor f = A + E := fun A hA ↦
    hN1 _ (add_nonneg hA hE) (by rw [deg_add]; have := deg_nonneg hA; omega)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := key _ (posPart_nonneg D)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := key _ (posPart_nonneg (-D))
  refine ⟨f, g, ?_⟩
  rw [hf, hg, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, posPart_sub_posPart_neg]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_polarDivisor_eq_nsmul_add_div
statement:
theorem exists_polarDivisor_eq_nsmul_add_div {A : Divisor K} (hA : 0 < A.deg) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ f r : K, r ≠ 0 ∧ polarDivisor f = n • A + div r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := exists_polarDivisor_eq (K := K)
  set n : ℕ := (max N1 (riemannConst K + 1)).toNat + 1
  have hn : max N1 (riemannConst K + 1) < n := by
    have := Int.self_le_toNat (max N1 (riemannConst K + 1))
    simp only [n]; push_cast; omega
  have hdeg : (n : ℤ) ≤ (n • A).deg := by
    rw [deg_nsmul]
    nlinarith
  have hell := riemann_inequality (n • A)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hle⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_div (A := n • A) (by
    have := le_max_right N1 (riemannConst K + 1)
    omega)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hN1 _ hle (by
    rw [deg_add, deg_div, add_zero]
    have := le_max_left N1 (riemannConst K + 1)
    omega)
  exact ⟨n, Nat.succ_pos _, f, r, hr, hf⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mem_L
statement: theorem mem_L {A : Divisor K} {f : K} : f ∈ L A ↔ f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place K, -A P ≤ P.ord f
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mem_L_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_L_of_ne_zero {A : Divisor K} {f : K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ L A ↔ 0 ≤ A + div f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf]
  refine forall_congr' fun P ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, div_apply]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.L_mono
statement: theorem L_mono {A B : Divisor K} (h : A ≤ B) : L A ≤ L B
proof:
:= by
  rintro f (rfl | hf)
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  exact Or.inr fun P ↦ (neg_le_neg (h P)).trans (hf P)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.L_eq_bot_of_deg_neg
statement: theorem L_eq_bot_of_deg_neg {A : Divisor K} (hA : A.deg < 0) : L A = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro f hf
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
  by_contra hf0
  have h := deg_nonneg ((mem_L_of_ne_zero hf0).mp hf)
  rw [deg_add, deg_div] at h
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mul_mem_L
statement:
theorem mul_mem_L {A : Divisor K} {z f : K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hf : f ∈ L (A + div z)) :
    f * z ∈ L A
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, div_apply] at this
  rw [P.ord_mul hf0 hz]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mul_inv_mem_L
statement:
theorem mul_inv_mem_L {A : Divisor K} {z g : K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hg : g ∈ L A) :
    g * z⁻¹ ∈ L (A + div z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hg with rfl | hg
  · simp
  by_cases hg0 : g = 0
  · simp [hg0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hg P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, div_apply]
  rw [P.ord_mul hg0 (inv_ne_zero hz), P.ord_inv]
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_add_div
statement: theorem ell_add_div (A : Divisor K) {z : K} (hz : z ≠ 0) : ell (A + div z) = ell A
proof:
:=
  (mulEquiv A hz).finrank_eq

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one (hπ : P.ord π = 1) : π ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl; simp at hπ

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.zpow_mul_mem
statement:
theorem zpow_mul_mem (hπ : P.ord π = 1) {f : K} (hf : f ∈ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    π ^ (A P + 1) * f ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  apply P.mem_of_ord_nonneg
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ (ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one hπ)) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ]
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mem_ker_residueMap
statement:
theorem mem_ker_residueMap (hπ : P.ord π = 1) (f : L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    f ∈ LinearMap.ker (residueMap A P hπ) ↔ (f : K) ∈ L A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hπ0 := ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one hπ
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change P.residue _ = 0 ↔ _
  rw [P.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  by_cases hf0 : (f : K) = 0
  · simp only [hf0, mul_zero]
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ Or.inl rfl, fun _ ↦ by
      rw [show (⟨0, _⟩ : P.1) = 0 from rfl]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _⟩
  have hne : π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : K) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0
  rw [← P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨_, zpow_mul_mem hπ f.2⟩) hne]
  change 0 < P.ord (π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : K)) ↔ _
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ, mem_L, or_iff_right hf0]
  have hf := f.2
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf0] at hf
  constructor
  · intro h Q
    by_cases hQ : Q = P
    · subst hQ; omega
    · have := hf Q
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hQ),
        add_zero] at this
      exact this
  · intro h
    have := h P
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.step
statement:
theorem step (A : Divisor K) (P : Place K) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) ∧
      ell (A + Finsupp.single P 1) ≤ ell A + P.deg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := P.exists_ord_eq_one
  set φ := residueMap A P hπ
  have hle : L A ≤ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1) :=
    L_mono (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one))
  have hker : LinearMap.ker φ = (L A).comap (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)).subtype := by
    ext f
    exact mem_ker_residueMap hπ f
  let e : LinearMap.ker φ ≃ₗ[ℚ] L A :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hker).trans (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle)
  have hkerfin : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) := e.symm.finiteDimensional
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) := by
    refine ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker φ ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
    · rw [top_inf_eq]
      exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp hkerfin
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range φ) ≤ P.deg := Submodule.finrank_le _
  rw [e.finrank_eq] at h1
  unfold ell
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.step_nat
statement:
theorem step_nat (P : Place K) (m : ℕ) (A : Divisor K) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))) ∧
      (ell (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + m * P.deg
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := step (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) P
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, Finsupp.single_add, ← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    have : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * P.deg = m * P.deg + P.deg := by ring
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.aux
statement:
theorem aux (D : Divisor K) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (A : Divisor K) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + D)) ∧ (ell (A + D) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + D.deg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction D using Finsupp.induction generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    rw [add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | single_add P b f hPf _ ih =>
    have hfP : f P = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hPf
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := by
      have := hD P
      simpa [hfP] using this
    have hf : 0 ≤ f := by
      intro Q
      by_cases hQ : Q = P
      · subst hQ; simp [hfP]
      · have := hD Q
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hQ] using this
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := step_nat P m A
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ih hf (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))
    rw [← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    rw [deg_add, deg_single]
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_le_of_le
statement:
theorem ell_le_of_le {A B : Divisor K} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (ell B : ℤ) ≤ ell A + (B.deg - A.deg)
proof:
:= by
  have := (aux (B - A) (sub_nonneg.mpr h) A).2
  rwa [add_sub_cancel, deg_sub] at this

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.deg_sub_ell_mono
statement:
theorem deg_sub_ell_mono {A B : Divisor K} (h : A ≤ B) :
    A.deg - ell A ≤ B.deg - ell B
proof:
:= by
  have := ell_le_of_le h
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_mono
statement: theorem ell_mono {A B : Divisor K} (h : A ≤ B) : ell A ≤ ell B
proof:
:=
  Submodule.finrank_mono (L_mono h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_eq_zero_of_deg_neg
statement: theorem ell_eq_zero_of_deg_neg {A : Divisor K} (hA : A.deg < 0) : ell A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell, L_eq_bot_of_deg_neg hA, finrank_bot]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ell_eq_zero_iff {A : Divisor K} : ell A = 0 ↔ L A = ⊥
proof: := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_ne_zero_mem_L
statement: theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_L {A : Divisor K} (h : ell A ≠ 0) : ∃ f ∈ L A, f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp (mt ell_eq_zero_iff.mpr h)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.exists_nonneg_add_div
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_add_div {A : Divisor K} (h : ell A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : K, z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ A + div z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := exists_ne_zero_mem_L h
  exact ⟨z, hz0, (mem_L_of_ne_zero hz0).mp hz⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_le_max
statement: theorem ell_le_max (A : Divisor K) : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ max 0 (A.deg + ell (0 : Divisor K))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ell A = 0
  · rw [h]; exact le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hA⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_div h
  have := ell_le_of_le hA
  rw [ell_add_div A hz, deg_add, deg_div, deg_zero] at this
  exact (by omega : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ A.deg + ell (0 : Divisor K)).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.mem_L_zero
statement: theorem mem_L_zero {f : K} : f ∈ L (0 : Divisor K) ↔ IsAlgebraic ℚ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Place.isAlgebraic_iff_forall_mem, mem_L]
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, neg_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | h) P
    · exact P.1.zero_mem
    · exact P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (h P)
  · exact fun h ↦ Or.inr fun P ↦ P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (h P)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.L_zero
statement: theorem L_zero : L (0 : Divisor K) = Subalgebra.toSubmodule (integralClosure ℚ K)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_L_zero, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, mem_integralClosure_iff,
    isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral]

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_zero
statement: theorem ell_zero : ell (0 : Divisor K) = Module.finrank ℚ (integralClosure ℚ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell, L_zero]
  rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.Divisor.ell_zero_pos
statement: theorem ell_zero_pos : 0 < ell (0 : Divisor K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, ell_eq_zero_iff, ← Ne, Submodule.ne_bot_iff]
  exact ⟨1, mem_L_zero.mpr isAlgebraic_one, one_ne_zero⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_tripodPlaces
statement:
theorem mem_tripodPlaces {t : K} {P : Place K} :
    P ∈ tripodPlaces t ↔ P = zeroPlace t ∨ P = onePlace t ∨ P = infPlace t
proof:
:= by
  simp [tripodPlaces]

name: Belyi.CurveField.eq_zeroPlace_iff
statement: theorem eq_zeroPlace_iff {P : Place K} : P = zeroPlace t ↔ 0 < P.ord t
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroPlace, eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg ht.inv, Place.ord_inv, Left.neg_neg_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_zeroPlace
statement: theorem ord_zeroPlace : (zeroPlace t).ord t = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := ord_infPlace ht.inv
  rw [Place.ord_inv] at this
  change (infPlace t⁻¹).ord t = 1
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.deg_zeroPlace
statement: theorem deg_zeroPlace : (zeroPlace t).deg = 1
proof: := deg_infPlace ht.inv

name: Belyi.CurveField.eq_onePlace_iff
statement: theorem eq_onePlace_iff {P : Place K} : P = onePlace t ↔ 0 < P.ord (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [onePlace, eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg ht.sub_one.inv, Place.ord_inv, Left.neg_neg_iff]

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_onePlace
statement: theorem ord_onePlace : (onePlace t).ord (t - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := ord_infPlace ht.sub_one.inv
  rw [Place.ord_inv] at this
  change (infPlace (t - 1)⁻¹).ord (t - 1) = 1
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.deg_onePlace
statement: theorem deg_onePlace : (onePlace t).deg = 1
proof: := deg_infPlace ht.sub_one.inv

name: Belyi.CurveField.not_ord_pos_and_ord_sub_one_pos
statement:
theorem not_ord_pos_and_ord_sub_one_pos (P : Place K) :
    ¬ (0 < P.ord t ∧ 0 < P.ord (t - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have h : t + -(t - 1) = 1 := by ring
  have := P.min_le_ord_add (f := t) (g := -(t - 1)) (by rw [h]; exact one_ne_zero)
  rw [Place.ord_neg, h, Place.ord_one] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_onePlace_self
statement: theorem ord_onePlace_self : (onePlace t).ord t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ord_onePlace ht
  have hmem : t ∈ (onePlace t).1 := by
    have : t - 1 ∈ (onePlace t).1 := (onePlace t).mem_of_ord_nonneg (by omega)
    simpa using add_mem this (onePlace t).1.one_mem
  have h0 := (onePlace t).ord_nonneg_of_mem hmem
  have := not_ord_pos_and_ord_sub_one_pos (t := t) (onePlace t)
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_infPlace_sub_one
statement: theorem ord_infPlace_sub_one : (infPlace t).ord (t - 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h : infPlace t = infPlace (t - 1) := by
    rw [eq_infPlace_iff ht.sub_one]
    intro hm
    exact notMem_infPlace ht (by simpa using add_mem hm (infPlace t).1.one_mem)
  rw [h, ord_infPlace ht.sub_one]

name: Belyi.CurveField.zeroPlace_ne_onePlace
statement: theorem zeroPlace_ne_onePlace : zeroPlace t ≠ onePlace t
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := ord_zeroPlace ht
  rw [h, ord_onePlace_self ht] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: Belyi.CurveField.zeroPlace_ne_infPlace
statement: theorem zeroPlace_ne_infPlace : zeroPlace t ≠ infPlace t
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := ord_zeroPlace ht
  rw [h, ord_infPlace ht] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.onePlace_ne_infPlace
statement: theorem onePlace_ne_infPlace : onePlace t ≠ infPlace t
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := ord_onePlace_self ht
  rw [h, ord_infPlace ht] at this
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_self
statement:
theorem ord_self (P : Place K) :
    P.ord t = if P = zeroPlace t then 1 else if P = infPlace t then -1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h0 hinf
  · rw [h0, ord_zeroPlace ht]
  · rw [hinf, ord_infPlace ht]
  · rw [eq_zeroPlace_iff ht] at h0
    rw [eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg ht] at hinf
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.ord_sub_one
statement:
theorem ord_sub_one (P : Place K) :
    P.ord (t - 1) = if P = onePlace t then 1 else if P = infPlace t then -1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h1 hinf
  · rw [h1, ord_onePlace ht]
  · rw [hinf, ord_infPlace_sub_one ht]
  · rw [eq_onePlace_iff ht] at h1
    have ht1 : t - 1 ∈ P.1 := sub_mem (mem_of_ne_infPlace ht hinf) P.1.one_mem
    have := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem ht1
    omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.card_tripodPlaces
statement: theorem card_tripodPlaces : (tripodPlaces t).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := zeroPlace_ne_onePlace ht
  have h2 := zeroPlace_ne_infPlace ht
  have h3 := onePlace_ne_infPlace ht
  exact Finset.card_eq_three.mpr ⟨_, _, _, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_tripodPlaces_iff_ord
statement:
theorem mem_tripodPlaces_iff_ord {P : Place K} :
    P ∈ tripodPlaces t ↔ P.ord t ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < P.ord (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tripodPlaces]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · rw [ord_zeroPlace ht]; exact Or.inl one_ne_zero
    · rw [ord_onePlace ht]; exact Or.inr one_pos
    · rw [ord_infPlace ht]; exact Or.inl (by decide)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ((eq_infPlace_iff_ord_neg ht).mpr h))
      · exact Or.inl ((eq_zeroPlace_iff ht).mpr h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ((eq_onePlace_iff ht).mpr h))

name: Belyi.CurveField.notMem_tripodPlaces_iff
statement:
theorem notMem_tripodPlaces_iff {P : Place K} :
    P ∉ tripodPlaces t ↔ t ∈ P.1 ∧ t⁻¹ ∈ P.1 ∧ (1 - t)⁻¹ ∈ P.1
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : t ∈ P.1 ∧ t⁻¹ ∈ P.1 ↔ P.ord t = 0 := (P.ord_eq_zero_iff ht.ne_zero).symm
  have h1t : (1 - t)⁻¹ ∈ P.1 ↔ P.ord (t - 1) ≤ 0 := by
    have hne : (1 - t)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (by
      rw [show 1 - t = -(t - 1) by ring, neg_ne_zero]; exact ht.sub_one.ne_zero)
    rw [P.mem_iff_ord_nonneg]
    simp only [hne, false_or]
    rw [Place.ord_inv, show 1 - t = -(t - 1) by ring, Place.ord_neg]
    omega
  rw [mem_tripodPlaces_iff_ord ht, ← and_assoc, h01, h1t, not_or, not_not, not_lt]

name: Belyi.CurveField.deg_of_mem_tripodPlaces
statement: theorem deg_of_mem_tripodPlaces {P : Place K} (hP : P ∈ tripodPlaces t) : P.deg = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_tripodPlaces.mp hP with rfl | rfl | rfl
  exacts [deg_zeroPlace ht, deg_onePlace ht, deg_infPlace ht]

name: Belyi.CurveField.mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces
statement: theorem mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces {P : Place K} (hP : P ∉ tripodPlaces t) : t ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  ((notMem_tripodPlaces_iff ht).mp hP).1

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.P_mem_tripodPlaces_iff
statement:
theorem P_mem_tripodPlaces_iff (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : t ∈ x.P.1) :
    x.P ∈ tripodPlaces t ↔ x.eval t hx = 0 ∨ x.eval t hx = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : x.P ≠ infPlace t := fun h ↦ notMem_infPlace ht (h ▸ hx)
  have h1 : x.eval t hx = 1 ↔ 0 < x.P.ord (t - 1) := by
    rw [← x.eval_eq_zero_iff (sub_mem hx x.P.1.one_mem) ht.sub_one.ne_zero,
      x.eval_sub hx x.P.1.one_mem, eval_one, sub_eq_zero]
  rw [mem_tripodPlaces, eq_zeroPlace_iff ht, eq_onePlace_iff ht, x.eval_eq_zero_iff hx ht.ne_zero,
    h1]
  simp [hinf]

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_ne_zero_of_notMem
statement:
theorem eval_ne_zero_of_notMem (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : x.P ∉ tripodPlaces t) :
    x.eval t (mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces ht hx) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hx ((P_mem_tripodPlaces_iff ht x _).mpr (Or.inl h))

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.eval_ne_one_of_notMem
statement:
theorem eval_ne_one_of_notMem (x : QbarPoint K) (hx : x.P ∉ tripodPlaces t) :
    x.eval t (mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces ht hx) ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hx ((P_mem_tripodPlaces_iff ht x _).mpr (Or.inr h))

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.equivTripod_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivTripod_apply (ht : IsRationalGenerator t)
    (x : {x : QbarPoint K // x.P ∉ tripodPlaces t}) :
    (equivTripod ht x : Qbar) = x.1.eval t (mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces ht x.2)
proof: := rfl

name: Belyi.CurveField.QbarPoint.existsUnique_eval_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_eval_eq {z : Qbar} (hz0 : z ≠ 0) (hz1 : z ≠ 1) :
    ∃! x : {x : QbarPoint K // x.P ∉ tripodPlaces t},
      x.1.eval t (mem_of_notMem_tripodPlaces ht x.2) = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(equivTripod ht).symm ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩, ?_, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val ((equivTripod ht).apply_symm_apply ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩)
  · rw [Equiv.eq_symm_apply]
    exact Subtype.ext hy

name: Belyi.CurveField.div_mem_adjoin_tripod
proof:
:= by
  set A := Algebra.adjoin ℚ ({t, t⁻¹, (1 - t)⁻¹} : Set K)
  have hpol : ∀ p : ℚ[X], aeval t p ∈ A := fun p ↦ by
    have : aeval t p ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t} := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact Algebra.adjoin_mono (by simp) this
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro q hn hq0 hroots p
  by_cases hdeg : q.degree = 0
  · rw [eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero hdeg, aeval_C, div_eq_mul_inv, ← map_inv₀]
    exact mul_mem (hpol p) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero (k := Qbar) q hdeg
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hqa⟩ : ∃ a : ℚ, (a = 0 ∨ a = 1) ∧ q.IsRoot a := by
    have key : ∀ a : ℚ, algebraMap ℚ Qbar a = z → q.IsRoot a := fun a haz ↦ by
      rw [← haz, aeval_algebraMap_apply, map_eq_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℚ Qbar).injective,
        coe_aeval_eq_eval] at hz
      exact hz
    rcases hroots z hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, Or.inl rfl, key 0 (map_zero _)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Or.inr rfl, key 1 (map_one _)⟩
  set q' := q /ₘ (X - C a)
  have hq : (X - C a) * q' = q := mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.mpr hqa
  have hq'0 : q' ≠ 0 := by rintro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hq; exact hq0 hq.symm
  have hdeg' : q'.natDegree < n := by
    rw [← hn, ← hq, natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero a) hq'0, natDegree_X_sub_C]
    omega
  have hroots' : ∀ z : Qbar, aeval z q' = 0 → z = 0 ∨ z = 1 := fun z hz ↦
    hroots z (by rw [← hq, map_mul, hz, mul_zero])
  have hta : aeval t (X - C a) ≠ 0 := ht.aeval_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero a)
  have hinv : (aeval t (X - C a))⁻¹ ∈ A := by
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp : t⁻¹ ∈ ({t, t⁻¹, (1 - t)⁻¹} : Set K))
    · have h := neg_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin
        (by simp : (1 - t)⁻¹ ∈ ({t, t⁻¹, (1 - t)⁻¹} : Set K)) : (1 - t)⁻¹ ∈ A)
      rw [← inv_neg, neg_sub] at h
      simpa using h
  rw [← hq, map_mul, div_mul_eq_div_div_swap, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_mem (ih _ hdeg' q' rfl hq'0 hroots' p) hinv

name: Belyi.CurveField.forall_mem_iff_mem_adjoin_tripod
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    obtain ⟨p, q, hq0, hpq, rfl⟩ := ht.exists_coprime f
    refine div_mem_adjoin_tripod ht _ q rfl hq0 (fun z hz ↦ ?_) p
    by_contra hz01
    set x := (QbarPoint.equivQbar ht).symm z
    have hxz : x.1.eval t x.2 = z := QbarPoint.eval_equivQbar_symm ht z
    have hxP : x.1.P ∉ tripodPlaces t := by
      rw [QbarPoint.P_mem_tripodPlaces_iff ht x.1 x.2, hxz]
      exact hz01
    exact x.1.div_notMem x.2 ht.transcendental hq0 hpq (hxz ▸ hz) (hf _ hxP)
  · intro hf P hP
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := (notMem_tripodPlaces_iff ht).mp hP
    induction hf using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem g hg =>
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
      rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl
      exacts [h1, h2, h3]
    | algebraMap q => exact P.algebraMap_mem q
    | add g h _ _ hg hh => exact add_mem hg hh
    | mul g h _ _ hg hh => exact mul_mem hg hh

name: Belyi.CurveField.setOf_forall_mem_eq_adjoin_tripod
statement:
theorem setOf_forall_mem_eq_adjoin_tripod :
    {f : K | ∀ P : Place K, P ∉ tripodPlaces t → f ∈ P.1} =
      (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t, t⁻¹, (1 - t)⁻¹} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  Set.ext (forall_mem_iff_mem_adjoin_tripod ht)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_ord_pos
statement: theorem exists_ord_pos {f : K} (hf : Transcendental ℚ f) : ∃ P : Place K, 0 < P.ord f
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ f) := ⟨hf⟩
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hf
  let fB : chartRing f := ⟨f, self_mem_chartRing f⟩
  have hfB0 : fB ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit fB := by
    rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    apply inv_notMem_chartRing hf
    have h1 : f * ((u⁻¹ : (chartRing f)ˣ) : chartRing f) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val u.mul_inv
      rwa [hu] at this
    rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1]
    exact ((u⁻¹ : (chartRing f)ˣ) : chartRing f).2
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hfM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (Ideal.span {fB})
    (by rwa [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  have hMb : M ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hfB0
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← h]
    exact hfM (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self fB)
  let v : HeightOneSpectrum (chartRing f) := ⟨M, hM.isPrime, hMb⟩
  refine ⟨ofChart f v, (ord_pos_iff _).mpr ⟨hf0, ?_⟩⟩
  have hv : fB ∈ ((ofChart f v).toChart f (self_mem_ofChart f v)).asIdeal := by
    rw [toChart_ofChart]
    exact hfM (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self fB)
  exact (mem_toChart_iff f _ _).mp hv

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_ord_neg
statement: theorem exists_ord_neg {f : K} (hf : Transcendental ℚ f) : ∃ P : Place K, P.ord f < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_ord_pos (transcendental_inv hf)
  exact ⟨P, by rw [ord_inv] at hP; omega⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.exists_notMem
statement: theorem exists_notMem {f : K} (hf : Transcendental ℚ f) : ∃ P : Place K, f ∉ P.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_ord_neg hf
  exact ⟨P, (ord_neg_iff P).mp hP⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isAlgebraic_of_forall_mem
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_of_forall_mem {f : K} (h : ∀ P : Place K, f ∈ P.1) : IsAlgebraic ℚ f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hf
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_notMem hf
  exact hP (h P)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isAlgebraic_iff_forall_mem
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_iff_forall_mem {f : K} : IsAlgebraic ℚ f ↔ ∀ P : Place K, f ∈ P.1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hf P ↦ P.mem_of_isAlgebraic hf, isAlgebraic_of_forall_mem⟩

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.isAlgebraic_iff_forall_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_iff_forall_ord_eq_zero {f : K} :
    IsAlgebraic ℚ f ↔ ∀ P : Place K, P.ord f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf P ↦ P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic hf, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hf
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_ord_pos hf
  exact hP.ne' (h P)

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finite_setOf_ord_pos
statement: theorem finite_setOf_ord_pos (f : K) : {P : Place K | 0 < P.ord f}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : IsAlgebraic ℚ f
  · convert Set.finite_empty
    ext P
    simp [P.ord_eq_zero_of_isAlgebraic hf]
  have : Fact (Transcendental ℚ f) := ⟨hf⟩
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hf
  let fB : chartRing f := ⟨f, self_mem_chartRing f⟩
  have hfB0 : fB ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hfin := Ideal.finite_factors (I := Ideal.span {fB}) (by
    rw [Ne, Submodule.zero_eq_bot, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact hfB0)
  refine (hfin.image (ofChart f)).subset ?_
  intro P hP
  have hmem : f ∈ P.1 := P.mem_of_ord_nonneg (le_of_lt hP)
  refine ⟨P.toChart f hmem, ?_, ofChart_toChart f P hmem⟩
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton, mem_toChart_iff]
  exact ((P.ord_pos_iff).mp hP).2

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finite_setOf_ord_neg
statement: theorem finite_setOf_ord_neg (f : K) : {P : Place K | P.ord f < 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_setOf_ord_pos f⁻¹).subset fun P hP ↦ ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ord_inv] at hP ⊢
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finite_setOf_ord_ne_zero
statement: theorem finite_setOf_ord_ne_zero (f : K) : {P : Place K | P.ord f ≠ 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((finite_setOf_ord_pos f).union (finite_setOf_ord_neg f)).subset fun P hP ↦ ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union] at hP ⊢
  omega

name: Belyi.CurveField.Place.finite_setOf_notMem
statement: theorem finite_setOf_notMem (f : K) : {P : Place K | f ∉ P.1}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_setOf_ord_neg f).subset fun P hP ↦ (ord_neg_iff P).mpr hP

name: Belyi.specAlgebraMap_comp
statement:
lemma specAlgebraMap_comp (k₁ : Type u) [CommRing k₁] [Algebra k₀ k₁] [Algebra k₁ K]
    [IsScalarTower k₀ k₁ K] :
    specAlgebraMap k₁ K ≫ specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁ = specAlgebraMap k₀ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [specAlgebraMap, specAlgebraMap, specAlgebraMap, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 1
  exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k₀ k₁ K).symm

name: Belyi.DefinableOver.of_iso
statement:
lemma of_iso (φ : X ≅ Y) (hφ : φ.hom ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) =
    X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (h : DefinableOver k₀ K X) : DefinableOver k₀ K Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, f₀, e, he⟩ := h
  refine ⟨X₀, f₀, φ.symm ≪≫ e, ?_⟩
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, he, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_comp_eq, hφ]

name: Belyi.DefinableOver.trans
statement:
lemma trans (k₁ : Type u) [CommRing k₁] [Algebra k₀ k₁] [Algebra k₁ K]
    [IsScalarTower k₀ k₁ K] (h : DefinableOver k₀ K X) : DefinableOver k₁ K X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, f₀, e, he⟩ := h
  have h1 : (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K)).inv ≫
      pullback.snd (pullback.snd f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁)) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K) =
      pullback.snd f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₁ K ≫ specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd]
  refine ⟨pullback f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁), pullback.snd _ _,
    e ≪≫ pullback.congrHom rfl (specAlgebraMap_comp k₀ K k₁).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K)).symm, ?_⟩
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, h1, ← he]
  congr 1
  rw [pullback.congrHom_hom, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]

name: Belyi.baseChangeModelHom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma baseChangeModelHom_fst :
    baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ ≫
        pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) =
      pullback.fst p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) ≫ f₀
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: Belyi.baseChangeModelHom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma baseChangeModelHom_snd :
    baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ ≫
        pullback.snd (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) =
      pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

name: Belyi.DefinableOverPair.definableOver
statement:
lemma definableOver {f : X ⟶ P1 K} (h : DefinableOverPair k₀ K X f) :
    DefinableOver k₀ K X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, p₀, f₀, hf₀, e, hsnd, _⟩ := h
  exact ⟨X₀, p₀, e, hsnd⟩

name: Belyi.DefinableOverPair.comp_structMap
statement:
lemma comp_structMap {f : X ⟶ P1 K} (h : DefinableOverPair k₀ K X f) :
    f ≫ (P1 K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, p₀, f₀, hf₀, e, hsnd, hf⟩ := h
  have := hf =≫ pullback.snd (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
  rwa [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_snd, Category.assoc, baseChangeModelHom_snd, hsnd] at this

name: Belyi.DefinableOverPair.of_iso
statement:
lemma of_iso {f : X ⟶ P1 K} {g : Y ⟶ P1 K} (φ : X ≅ Y)
    (hφ : φ.hom ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (hfg : f = φ.hom ≫ g) (h : DefinableOverPair k₀ K X f) :
    DefinableOverPair k₀ K Y g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, p₀, f₀, hf₀, e, hsnd, hf⟩ := h
  refine ⟨X₀, p₀, f₀, hf₀, φ.symm ≪≫ e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, hsnd, ← hφ, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, ← hf, hfg, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: Belyi.locallyOfFinitePresentation_baseChangeModelHom
statement:
lemma locallyOfFinitePresentation_baseChangeModelHom {X₀ : Scheme.{u}}
    (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ P1 k₀)
    (hf₀ : f₀ ≫ (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) = p₀) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀] :
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)
proof:
:=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @LocallyOfFinitePresentation)
    (isPullback_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) inferInstance

name: Belyi.branch_definableOverPair_eq
statement:
theorem branch_definableOverPair_eq {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} {p₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)}
    {f₀ : X₀ ⟶ P1 k₀} (hf₀ : f₀ ≫ (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) = p₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] {f : X ⟶ P1 K}
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (e : X ≅ pullback p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
    (hfe : f ≫ P1.toPullback k₀ K = e.hom ≫ baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)
    (hram : Ram (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)
      = pullback.fst p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) ⁻¹' Ram f₀) :
    Branch f = P1.mapOfAlgebra k₀ K ⁻¹' Branch f₀
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbc : Branch (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)
      = pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) ⁻¹' Branch f₀ :=
    branch_preimage_eq (isPullback_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) hram
  
  
  
  have hbranch_f : ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) '' Branch f
      = Branch (e.hom ≫ baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) := by
    rw [← branch_comp_isIso f (P1.toPullback k₀ K)]
    congr 1
  have key : ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) '' Branch f
      = pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) ⁻¹' Branch f₀ := by
    rw [hbranch_f, branch_isIso_comp, hbc]
  have hinj : Function.Injective ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) :=
    (Scheme.homeoOfIso (asIso (P1.toPullback k₀ K))).injective
  have hcomp : ⇑(P1.mapOfAlgebra k₀ K)
      = ⇑(pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
          ∘ ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) := by
    rw [← P1.toPullback_fst k₀ K, Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp]
  calc Branch f
      = ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) ⁻¹' (⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) '' Branch f) :=
        (Set.preimage_image_eq _ hinj).symm
    _ = ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K) ⁻¹'
          (pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
            ⁻¹' Branch f₀) := by
        rw [key]
    _ = (⇑(pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
          ∘ ⇑(P1.toPullback k₀ K)) ⁻¹' Branch f₀ := (Set.preimage_comp).symm
    _ = P1.mapOfAlgebra k₀ K ⁻¹' Branch f₀ := by rw [hcomp]

name: Belyi.isPullback_baseChangeModelHom
statement:
lemma isPullback_baseChangeModelHom :
    IsPullback (pullback.fst p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
      (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) f₀
      (pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
proof:
:= by
  have t := IsPullback.of_hasPullback (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
  have s : IsPullback (pullback.fst p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
      (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ ≫
        pullback.snd (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K))
      (f₀ ≫ (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) := by
    rw [baseChangeModelHom_snd, hf₀]
    exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
  exact s.of_bot (baseChangeModelHom_fst k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀).symm t

name: Belyi.isFinite_baseChangeModelHom
statement:
lemma isFinite_baseChangeModelHom (hfin : IsFinite f₀) :
    IsFinite (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)
proof:
:=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsFinite)
    (isPullback_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) hfin

name: Belyi.isFinite_of_isFinite_model
proof:
:= by
  haveI hbc : IsFinite (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) :=
    isFinite_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ hfin
  have hfeq : f = (e.hom ≫ baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) ≫ inv (P1.toPullback k₀ K) := by
    rw [← hfe, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hfeq]
  infer_instance

name: Belyi.isFinite_of_isFinite_baseChangeModelHom
statement:
lemma isFinite_of_isFinite_baseChangeModelHom [IsProper f₀]
    (hbc : IsFinite (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀)) : IsFinite f₀
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hbc
  exact isFinite_of_isPullback_of_faithfullyFlat
    (isPullback_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀).flip

name: Belyi.isFinite_model_of_isFinite
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfin
  haveI hbc : IsFinite (baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀) := by
    have hbceq : baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ = inv e.hom ≫ f ≫ P1.toPullback k₀ K := by
      rw [hfe, ← Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
    rw [hbceq]; infer_instance
  exact isFinite_of_isFinite_baseChangeModelHom k₀ K p₀ f₀ hf₀ hbc

name: Belyi.P1.gradedMapOfAlgebra_comp
statement:
lemma gradedMapOfAlgebra_comp :
    gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ K = (gradedMapOfAlgebra k₁ K).comp (gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ k₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedRingHom.ext fun p => ?_
  simp only [GradedRingHom.comp_apply, gradedMapOfAlgebra_apply]
  rw [MvPolynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]

name: Belyi.P1.mapOfAlgebra_comp
statement:
lemma mapOfAlgebra_comp :
    mapOfAlgebra k₀ K = mapOfAlgebra k₁ K ≫ mapOfAlgebra k₀ k₁
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have h : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ K)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ K) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedMapOfAlgebra k₁ K)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfAlgebra k₁ K) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ k₁)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfAlgebra k₀ k₁) := by
    rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp]
    congr 1
    exact gradedMapOfAlgebra_comp k₀ k₁ K
  exact h

name: Belyi.DefinableOverPair.trans
statement:
lemma trans (k₁ : Type u) [CommRing k₁] [Algebra k₀ k₁] [Algebra k₁ K]
    [IsScalarTower k₀ k₁ K] {f : X ⟶ P1 K} (h : DefinableOverPair k₀ K X f) :
    DefinableOverPair k₁ K X f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, p₀, f₀, hf₀, e, hsnd, hf⟩ := h
  
  have hffst := hf =≫ pullback.fst (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
  rw [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_fst, Category.assoc, baseChangeModelHom_fst] at hffst
  
  have hcs : f ≫ (P1 K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := by
    have := hf =≫ pullback.snd (P1 k₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) (specAlgebraMap k₀ K)
    rwa [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_snd, Category.assoc, baseChangeModelHom_snd, hsnd] at this
  
  set f₁ : pullback p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) ⟶ P1 k₁ :=
    baseChangeModelHom k₀ k₁ p₀ f₀ hf₀ ≫ inv (P1.toPullback k₀ k₁) with hf₁def
  have hf₁ : f₁ ≫ (P1 k₁ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) =
      pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) := by
    rw [hf₁def, Category.assoc, ← P1.toPullback_snd k₀ k₁, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      baseChangeModelHom_snd]
  
  set e₁ : X ≅ pullback (pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁)) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K) :=
    e ≪≫ pullback.congrHom rfl (specAlgebraMap_comp k₀ K k₁).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K)).symm
    with he₁def
  
  have h1 : (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K)).inv ≫
      pullback.snd (pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁)) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K) =
      pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₁ K ≫ specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁) := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd]
  have hsnd₁ : e₁.hom ≫
      pullback.snd (pullback.snd p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁)) (specAlgebraMap k₁ K) =
      X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := by
    rw [he₁def, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, h1,
      ← hsnd]
    congr 1
    rw [pullback.congrHom_hom, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]
  refine ⟨pullback p₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ k₁), pullback.snd _ _, f₁, hf₁, e₁, hsnd₁, ?_⟩
  
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · 
    simp only [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_fst, baseChangeModelHom_fst]
    rw [← cancel_mono (P1.toPullback k₀ k₁), hf₁def]
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · 
      simp only [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_fst, baseChangeModelHom_fst]
      rw [← P1.mapOfAlgebra_comp, hffst, he₁def]
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
        pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_inv_fst_assoc, pullback.congrHom_hom, pullback.map,
        pullback.lift_fst_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    · 
      simp only [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_snd, baseChangeModelHom_snd]
      rw [P1.mapOfAlgebra_comp_structMap, ← Category.assoc f, hcs, pullback.condition,
        ← Category.assoc e₁.hom, hsnd₁]
  · 
    simp only [Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_snd, baseChangeModelHom_snd]
    rw [hcs, hsnd₁]

name: Belyi.eq_of_specializes_of_specializes
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne'
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk z) := by
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk]; exact hxy.trans hyz
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : y ∈ Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk z) := by
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk]; exact hyz
  have hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding (X.fromSpecStalk z).base :=
    (Scheme.Hom.isEmbedding _)
  have hzq : X.fromSpecStalk z (IsLocalRing.closedPoint _) = z :=
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint
  let p' : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z) := p
  let q' : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z) := q
  let c' : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z) := IsLocalRing.closedPoint _
  have hpq : p' < q' := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr ?_) fun h => hne ?_
    · exact hemb.toIsInducing.specializes_iff.mp (by rw [hp, hq]; exact hxy)
    · rw [← hp, ← hq]
      exact congrArg (X.fromSpecStalk z) h
  have hqc : q' < c' := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr ?_) fun h => hne' ?_
    · exact hemb.toIsInducing.specializes_iff.mp (by rw [hq, hzq]; exact hyz)
    · calc y = (X.fromSpecStalk z) q := hq.symm
        _ = (X.fromSpecStalk z) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint _) := congrArg _ h
        _ = z := hzq
  rcases Order.krullDim_le_one_iff.mp hdim.krullDim_le q' with h | h
  · exact h.not_lt hpq
  · exact h.not_lt hqc

name: Belyi.isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint
proof:
:= by
  have h : closure {x} = {x} := by
    refine subset_antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) subset_closure
    have hxz : x ⤳ z := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hz
    have hgx : genericPoint X ⤳ x := (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    exact (eq_of_specializes_of_specializes (hdim z) hgx hxz (Ne.symm hx)) ▸ rfl
  rw [← h]
  exact isClosed_closure

name: Belyi.finite_of_t1Space
statement:
lemma finite_of_t1Space {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [NoetherianSpace α]
    [QuasiSober α] [T1Space α] : Finite α
proof:
:= by
  have hsing : ∀ x : α, irreducibleComponent x = {x} := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := QuasiSober.sober (S := irreducibleComponent x)
      isIrreducible_irreducibleComponent isClosed_irreducibleComponent
    have h : irreducibleComponent x = {ξ} := by
      rw [← hξ.def, closure_singleton]
    have hx : x ∈ irreducibleComponent x := mem_irreducibleComponent
    rw [h] at hx ⊢
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
  have : Finite (irreducibleComponents α) :=
    NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents.to_subtype
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (fun x : α => (⟨irreducibleComponent x, irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x⟩ :
      irreducibleComponents α)) fun a b hab => ?_
  have h : irreducibleComponent a = irreducibleComponent b := congrArg Subtype.val hab
  rw [hsing a, hsing b] at h
  exact Set.singleton_eq_singleton_iff.mp h

name: Belyi.finite_of_isClosed_of_genericPoint_notMem
proof:
:= by
  have hQS : QuasiSober Z := hZ.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.quasiSober
  have hT1 : T1Space Z := by
    refine ⟨fun z => ?_⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed ({(z : X)} : Set X) :=
      isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint hdim fun h => hη (h ▸ z.2)
    have h : (Subtype.val ⁻¹' {(z : X)} : Set Z) = {z} := by
      ext w
      simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
    exact h ▸ hcl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff]
  exact finite_of_t1Space

name: Belyi.finite_preimage_singleton_of_isClosedMap
statement:
lemma finite_preimage_singleton_of_isClosedMap {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [NoetherianSpace X]
    (hdim : ∀ z : X, Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk z))
    (hf : IsClosedMap f.base) (hnc : ¬ IsClosed ({f (genericPoint X)} : Set Y)) (y : Y) :
    (f.base ⁻¹' {y}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : genericPoint X ∈ f.base ⁻¹' {y}
  · 
    have h : f.base ⁻¹' {y} = {genericPoint X} := by
      refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) (by simpa using hy)
      by_contra hne
      have h1 : IsClosed ({x} : Set X) :=
        isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint hdim (by simpa using hne)
      have h2 : IsClosed ({y} : Set Y) := by
        have := hf _ h1
        rwa [Set.image_singleton, show f.base x = y from hx] at this
      exact hnc (by rwa [show f (genericPoint X) = y from hy])
    rw [h]
    exact Set.finite_singleton _
  · rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (f.base ⁻¹' {y}) with h | ⟨x, hx⟩
    · simp [h]
    have hxne : x ≠ genericPoint X := fun h => hy (h ▸ hx)
    have h1 : IsClosed ({x} : Set X) := isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint hdim hxne
    have h2 : IsClosed ({y} : Set Y) := by
      have := hf _ h1
      rwa [Set.image_singleton, show f.base x = y from hx] at this
    exact finite_of_isClosed_of_genericPoint_notMem hdim
      (h2.preimage f.base.hom.continuous) hy

name: Belyi.comap_support_subset_support_baseChange
statement:
lemma comap_support_subset_support_baseChange
    {B B' : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing B'] [Algebra B B']
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Finite B M] :
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') ⁻¹' Module.support B M ⊆
      Module.support B' (B' ⊗[B] M)
proof:
:= by
  intro p' hp'
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, Module.mem_support_iff_nontrivial_residueField_tensorProduct] at hp'
  rw [Module.mem_support_iff_nontrivial_residueField_tensorProduct]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  letI g : (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') p').asIdeal.ResidueField →+*
      p'.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    Ideal.ResidueField.map _ p'.asIdeal (algebraMap B B') rfl
  letI : Algebra (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') p').asIdeal.ResidueField
      p'.asIdeal.ResidueField := g.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower B (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') p').asIdeal.ResidueField
      p'.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun b =>
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B B' p'.asIdeal.ResidueField b).trans
        (Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap _ p'.asIdeal (algebraMap B B') rfl b).symm
  
  haveI : Nontrivial ((PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') p').asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] M) := hp'
  
  
  have e1 := AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange B B' p'.asIdeal.ResidueField
      p'.asIdeal.ResidueField M
  have e2 := AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange B
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B') p').asIdeal.ResidueField
      p'.asIdeal.ResidueField p'.asIdeal.ResidueField M
  rw [e1.nontrivial_congr, ← e2.nontrivial_congr]
  infer_instance

name: Belyi.finite_h1Cotangent_of_noetherian
statement:
private lemma finite_h1Cotangent_of_noetherian
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B] :
    Module.Finite B (Algebra.H1Cotangent A B)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing B := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing A B
  let P := Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentation A B
  haveI : Module.Finite B P.toExtension.Cotangent := Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.finite P.fg_ker
  haveI : Module.Finite B P.toExtension.H1Cotangent :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective P.toExtension.h1Cotangentι P.toExtension.h1Cotangentι_injective
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective P.equivH1Cotangent.toLinearMap P.equivH1Cotangent.surjective

name: Belyi.etaleLocus_baseChange_subset
statement:
theorem etaleLocus_baseChange_subset
    {A A' B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A A'] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B] [Module.Flat A A'] :
    letI : Algebra B (A' ⊗[A] B)
proof:
:= Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    Algebra.etaleLocus A' (A' ⊗[A] B) ⊆
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (A' ⊗[A] B)) ⁻¹' Algebra.etaleLocus A B := by
  letI : Algebra B (A' ⊗[A] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsPushout A A' B (A' ⊗[A] B) := TensorProduct.isPushout
  haveI : Module.Finite B (Algebra.H1Cotangent A B) := finite_h1Cotangent_of_noetherian
  
  have hΩ : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (A' ⊗[A] B)) ⁻¹' Module.support B Ω[B⁄A]
      ⊆ Module.support (A' ⊗[A] B) Ω[(A' ⊗[A] B)⁄A'] := by
    refine (comap_support_subset_support_baseChange (B' := A' ⊗[A] B) Ω[B⁄A]).trans ?_
    exact Module.support_subset_of_injective
      (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv A A' B (A' ⊗[A] B)).toLinearMap
      (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv A A' B (A' ⊗[A] B)).injective
  
  
  
  let hmap := Algebra.H1Cotangent.map A A' B (A' ⊗[A] B)
  let L := hmap.liftBaseChange (A' ⊗[A] B)
  let cbc := Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange A A' B (A' ⊗[A] B) (Algebra.H1Cotangent A B)
  have key : (L.restrictScalars A') ∘ₗ cbc.symm.toLinearMap
      = (Algebra.tensorH1CotangentOfFlat A B A').toLinearMap := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
    induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a' x =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
        cbc, Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul, L, hmap,
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, Algebra.tensorH1CotangentOfFlat_tmul]
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
    | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  have hfun : ∀ z, L z = Algebra.tensorH1CotangentOfFlat A B A' (cbc z) := by
    intro z
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun key (cbc z)
    simpa using this
  have hbij : Function.Bijective L := by
    have hcomp : (L : _ → _) = (Algebra.tensorH1CotangentOfFlat A B A') ∘ (cbc : _ → _) :=
      funext hfun
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Algebra.tensorH1CotangentOfFlat A B A').bijective.comp cbc.bijective
  have hH1 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (A' ⊗[A] B)) ⁻¹'
        Module.support B (Algebra.H1Cotangent A B)
      ⊆ Module.support (A' ⊗[A] B) (Algebra.H1Cotangent A' (A' ⊗[A] B)) := by
    refine (comap_support_subset_support_baseChange (B' := A' ⊗[A] B)
      (Algebra.H1Cotangent A B)).trans ?_
    exact Module.support_subset_of_injective L hbij.injective
  rw [Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support, Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support,
    Set.preimage_inter, Set.preimage_compl, Set.preimage_compl]
  exact Set.inter_subset_inter (Set.compl_subset_compl.2 hΩ) (Set.compl_subset_compl.2 hH1)

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X] :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ P1 k, IsBelyiMap k f ∧ f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  haveI : IsIntegral X := IsCurveOver.isIntegral k X
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀fin, hf₀surj, hf₀over⟩ := exists_isFinite_surjective_hom_to_P1 k X
  haveI : f₀.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := hf₀over
  haveI : IsFinite f₀ := hf₀fin
  
  haveI : IsDominant f₀ := ⟨hf₀surj.denseRange⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherian (P1 k) := isNoetherian_of_over (P1 k) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀ := inferInstance
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_over X (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  have hdim : ∀ x : X, Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    fun x => krullDimLE_one_stalk_of_isCurveOver k X x
  
  set S : Finset k := P1.branchFinset k f₀ hdim with hS
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgne, hgS, hgcrit⟩ := exists_aeval_mem_and_critVal_mem_zeroOne (K := k) S
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap ℚ k) := (algebraMap ℚ k).injective
  have hd : 0 < (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)).natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgne
  
  haveI : (P1.polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd).IsOver
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨by rw [P1.structMap_eq]
        exact P1.polynomialSelfMap_structMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd⟩
  refine ⟨f₀ ≫ P1.polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd, ?_, inferInstance⟩
  
  refine P1.isBelyiMap_comp_polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd f₀ ?_ ?_
  · 
    refine P1.polynomialSelfMap_image_branch_subset_markedPoints k f₀ hdim
      (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd ?_
    intro s hs
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact hgS s (by rw [hS]; exact hs)
  · 
    exact branch_map_polynomialSelfMap_subset_markedPoints hgne hgcrit hd

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ P1 K), IsBelyiMap K f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, -⟩ := exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver k X₀
  exact ⟨_, _, isBelyiMap_baseChange k K hf₀⟩

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver_baseChangeModel
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver_baseChangeModel
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀]
    (e : X ≅ pullback (X₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (specAlgebraMap k K)) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hf₀over⟩ := exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver k X₀
  haveI : f₀.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := hf₀over
  
  have hg : IsBelyiMap K (pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)) := isBelyiMap_baseChange k K hf₀
  
  have hcomp : f₀ ≫ (P1 k ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) = X₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    comp_over f₀ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  
  let ι : pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) ≅
      pullback (X₀ ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (specAlgebraMap k K) :=
    pullbackMapOfAlgebraIso k K f₀ ≪≫ pullback.congrHom hcomp rfl
  let φ : X ≅ pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) := e ≪≫ ι.symm
  
  haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)) :=
    hg.locallyOfFinitePresentation
  haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation (φ.hom ≫ pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)) :=
    (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (P := @LocallyOfFinitePresentation)
      φ.hom (pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K))).mpr ‹_›
  exact ⟨φ.hom ≫ pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), hg.of_isIso_comp φ.hom⟩

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_of_definableOver
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_of_definableOver
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K]

proof:
:= by

  haveI : IsCurveOver k X₀ := IsCurveOver.of_baseChangeModel k K X₀ e he
  exact exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver_baseChangeModel k K X X₀ e

name: Belyi.definableOverPair_pullback_snd_mapOfAlgebra
statement:
lemma definableOverPair_pullback_snd_mapOfAlgebra
    [inst : (pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (hover : pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) =
        pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) ≫ (P1 K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    DefinableOverPair k K (pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K))
      (pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K))

    pullbackMapOfAlgebraIso k K f₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hover, pullbackMapOfAlgebraIso_hom_snd]
  · 
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · 
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, P1.toPullback_fst, baseChangeModelHom_fst,
        pullbackMapOfAlgebraIso_hom_fst_assoc]
