name: Belyi.exists_definableOverPair_isBelyiMap_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_definableOverPair_isBelyiMap_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (f : Y ⟶ P1 K),
      IsBelyiMap K f ∧ @DefinableOverPair k K _ _ _ Y hY f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, -⟩ := exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver k X₀
  letI hY : (pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) ≫ (P1 K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))⟩
  refine ⟨pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), hY,
    pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), isBelyiMap_baseChange k K hf₀, ?_⟩
  exact definableOverPair_pullback_snd_mapOfAlgebra k K f₀ rfl

name: Belyi.exists_definableOverPair_isBelyiMap_marked_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_definableOverPair_isBelyiMap_marked_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀]
    (S : Set X₀) (hSfin : S.Finite) (hScl : ∀ s ∈ S, IsClosed ({s} : Set X₀)) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (π : Y ⟶ X₀) (f : Y ⟶ P1 K),
      IsBelyiMap K f ∧ (∀ z : Y, π.base z ∈ S → f.base z ∈ markedPoints K) ∧
      @DefinableOverPair k K _ _ _ Y hY f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hmk⟩ := exists_isBelyiMap_marked_of_isCurveOver k X₀ S hSfin hScl
  letI hY : (pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K) ≫ (P1 K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))⟩
  refine ⟨pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), hY,
    pullback.fst f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K),
    isBelyiMap_baseChange k K hf₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro z hz
    have hsq := IsPullback.of_hasPullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)
    have hw : f₀.base ((pullback.fst f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) =
        (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K).base ((pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun m => m.base z) hsq.w
      rwa [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
    have hmark : (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K).base ((pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) ∈
        markedPoints k := hw ▸ hmk _ hz
    exact P1.mapsTo_markedPoints k K _ hmark
  · exact definableOverPair_pullback_snd_mapOfAlgebra k K f₀ rfl

name: Belyi.ofHom_algebraMap_functionField

name: Belyi.PreGaloisCategory.fiberEmb_coe_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberEmb_coe_apply (X : C) (hX : Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d) (x : F.obj X) :
    ((fiberEmb F d X hX x : Fin (d + 1)) : ℕ) = (Finite.equivFin (F.obj X) x : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiberEmb]

name: Belyi.PreGaloisCategory.continuous_fiberPermHom
statement:
lemma continuous_fiberPermHom (X : C) (hX : Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d) :
    Continuous ⇑(fiberPermHom F d X hX)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fiberPermHom, MonoidHom.coe_comp]
  exact continuous_of_discreteTopology.comp Belyi.continuous_toPermHom

name: Belyi.PreGaloisCategory.fiberPermHom_emb
statement:
lemma fiberPermHom_emb (X : C) (hX : Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d) (σ : Aut F) (x : F.obj X) :
    fiberPermHom F d X hX σ (fiberEmb F d X hX x) = fiberEmb F d X hX (σ • x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fiberPermHom, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    Equiv.Perm.viaEmbeddingHom_apply, Equiv.Perm.viaEmbedding_apply,
    MulAction.toPermHom_apply, MulAction.toPerm_apply]

name: Belyi.PreGaloisCategory.iso_of_invEl_eq
statement:
theorem iso_of_invEl_eq {X Y : C} (hX : Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d) (hY : Nat.card (F.obj Y) ≤ d)
    (h : invEl F d X hX = invEl F d Y hY) : Nonempty (X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfst, hsnd⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp h
  have hn : Nat.card (F.obj X) = Nat.card (F.obj Y) := by
    simpa [invEl] using congrArg Fin.val hfst
  have hρ : ∀ σ : Aut F, fiberPermHom F d X hX σ = fiberPermHom F d Y hY σ := by
    intro σ
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (φ : ContinuousMonoidHom _ _) => (φ : _ → _)) hsnd) σ
  
  let ψ : (F.obj X) ≃ (F.obj Y) :=
    (Finite.equivFin (F.obj X)).trans ((finCongr hn).trans (Finite.equivFin (F.obj Y)).symm)
  have hψ : ∀ x, ψ x =
      (Finite.equivFin (F.obj Y)).symm (finCongr hn (Finite.equivFin (F.obj X) x)) :=
    fun _ => rfl
  
  have keyEmb : ∀ x : F.obj X, fiberEmb F d X hX x = fiberEmb F d Y hY (ψ x) := by
    intro x
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [fiberEmb_coe_apply, fiberEmb_coe_apply, hψ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp
  
  have equiv : ∀ (σ : Aut F) (x : F.obj X), ψ (σ • x) = σ • ψ x := by
    intro σ x
    apply (fiberEmb F d Y hY).injective
    rw [← keyEmb, ← fiberPermHom_emb, hρ σ, keyEmb, fiberPermHom_emb]
  
  let actIso : (functorToAction F).obj X ≅ (functorToAction F).obj Y :=
    Action.mkIso (FintypeCat.equivEquivIso ψ) (fun σ => by
      ext x
      simp only [FintypeCat.comp_apply]
      exact equiv σ x)
  exact ⟨(functorToAction F).preimageIso actIso⟩

name: Belyi.PreGaloisCategory.finite_isoClasses_of_card_le
statement:
theorem finite_isoClasses_of_card_le
    (hFG : Belyi.TopologicallyFinitelyGenerated (Aut F)) (d : ℕ) :
    Finite (Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid
      (ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : C => Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d))))
proof:
:= by
  set P : ObjectProperty C := fun X => Nat.card (F.obj X) ≤ d with hP
  haveI : Finite (ContinuousMonoidHom (Aut F) (Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1)))) :=
    Belyi.finite_continuousMonoidHom_of_topFG hFG
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (fun q : Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid P.FullSubcategory) =>
      invEl F d q.out.obj q.out.property) ?_
  intro q₁ q₂ hq
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := iso_of_invEl_eq F d q₁.out.property q₂.out.property hq
  have hiso : (isIsomorphicSetoid P.FullSubcategory).r q₁.out q₂.out := ⟨P.ι.preimageIso e⟩
  calc q₁ = Quotient.mk _ q₁.out := (Quotient.out_eq q₁).symm
    _ = Quotient.mk _ q₂.out := Quotient.sound hiso
    _ = q₂ := Quotient.out_eq q₂

name: Belyi.eqOn_closure_of_eqOn_generators
statement:
theorem eqOn_closure_of_eqOn_generators {G N : Type*} [Group G] [Group N]
    {φ ψ : G →* N} {S : Set G} (h : Set.EqOn (φ : G → N) ψ S) :
    ∀ x ∈ Subgroup.closure S, φ x = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact h hy
  | one => simp
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb]
  | inv a _ ha => rw [map_inv, map_inv, ha]

name: Belyi.finite_continuousMonoidHom_of_topFG
statement:
theorem finite_continuousMonoidHom_of_topFG {G N : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group N] [TopologicalSpace N] [DiscreteTopology N] [Finite N]
    (hG : TopologicallyFinitelyGenerated G) :
    Finite (ContinuousMonoidHom G N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hG
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (fun (φ : ContinuousMonoidHom G N) => (fun (s : S) => φ (s : G))) ?_
  intro φ ψ h
  have hgen : Set.EqOn ((φ : G →* N) : G → N) (ψ : G →* N) (S : Set G) := by
    intro s hs
    exact congrFun h ⟨s, Finset.mem_coe.mp hs⟩
  have hcl : Set.EqOn ((φ : G →* N) : G → N) (ψ : G →* N)
      ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) : Subgroup G) : Set G) :=
    fun x hx => eqOn_closure_of_eqOn_generators hgen x hx
  have hfun : ((φ : G →* N) : G → N) = ((ψ : G →* N) : G → N) :=
    Continuous.ext_on hS φ.continuous ψ.continuous hcl
  ext x
  exact congrFun hfun x

name: Belyi.continuous_toPermHom
statement:
theorem continuous_toPermHom {G X : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MulAction G X]
    [TopologicalSpace X] [ContinuousSMul G X] [DiscreteTopology X] [Finite X] :
    Continuous (MulAction.toPermHom G X)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocallyConstant.continuous
  rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_isOpen_fiber]
  intro σ
  have hset : (MulAction.toPermHom G X) ⁻¹' {σ}
      = ⋂ x : X, (fun g : G => g • x) ⁻¹' {σ x} := by
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hg x
      have hx : (MulAction.toPermHom G X) g x = σ x := by rw [hg]
      rwa [MulAction.toPermHom_apply, MulAction.toPerm_apply] at hx
    · intro hg
      ext x
      rw [MulAction.toPermHom_apply, MulAction.toPerm_apply]
      exact hg x
  rw [hset]
  refine isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun x => ?_)
  exact (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).isOpen_preimage _ (isOpen_discrete _)

name: Belyi.continuous_permCongrHom_comp_toPermHom
statement:
theorem continuous_permCongrHom_comp_toPermHom {G X Y : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [MulAction G X] [TopologicalSpace X] [ContinuousSMul G X] [DiscreteTopology X] [Finite X]
    [Finite Y] (e : X ≃ Y) :
    Continuous ⇑((permCongrHom e).comp (MulAction.toPermHom G X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.coe_comp]
  exact continuous_of_discreteTopology.comp continuous_toPermHom

name: Belyi.openBoundedIndexInvariant_recover
statement:
theorem openBoundedIndexInvariant_recover (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] (d : ℕ)
    (H : {H : Subgroup G // IsOpen (H : Set G) ∧ H.index ≤ d ∧ H.index ≠ 0}) :
    stabOfHom (openBoundedIndexInvariant G d H).2.1.toMonoidHom
      (openBoundedIndexInvariant G d H).2.2 = H.1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ H.1) := Subgroup.index_ne_zero_iff_finite.mp H.2.2.2
  exact stabOfHom_permCongrHom H.1 (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq (α := G ⧸ H.1) (n := H.1.index) rfl)

name: Belyi.finite_openSubgroup_index_le
statement:
theorem finite_openSubgroup_index_le (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] (hG : TopologicallyFinitelyGenerated G) (d : ℕ) :
    {H : Subgroup G | IsOpen (H : Set G) ∧ H.index ≤ d ∧ H.index ≠ 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ n : Fin (d + 1), Finite (ContinuousMonoidHom G (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n : ℕ)))) :=
    fun _ => finite_continuousMonoidHom_of_topFG hG
  rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff]
  refine Finite.of_injective (openBoundedIndexInvariant G d) ?_
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← openBoundedIndexInvariant_recover G d a, ← openBoundedIndexInvariant_recover G d b, hab]

name: Belyi.valuationRing_of_standardSmooth_localization
statement:
theorem valuationRing_of_standardSmooth_localization
    [IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 k A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [FormallySmooth k (ResidueField B)] : ValuationRing B
proof:

  haveI := formallySmooth_localization k A M B

name: Belyi.belyi_forward

    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]

  (exists_isBelyiMap_of_isCurveOver k X).imp fun _ h => h.1

    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀] :

    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsCurveOver K X]
    (h : ∃ f : X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f) : DefinableOver k K X
proof:
:=
  definableOver_of_exists_isBelyiMap k K X h

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_congr
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_congr (K : Type u) [Field K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (φ : X ≅ Y) :
    (∃ f : X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f) ↔ (∃ g : Y ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    haveI := hf.locallyOfFinitePresentation
    exact ⟨φ.inv ≫ f, hf.of_isIso_comp φ.inv⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    haveI := hg.locallyOfFinitePresentation
    exact ⟨φ.hom ≫ g, hg.of_isIso_comp φ.hom⟩

name: Belyi.definableOver_congr
statement:
theorem definableOver_congr (k K : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (φ : X ≅ Y) (hφ : φ.hom ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    DefinableOver k K X ↔ DefinableOver k K Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact DefinableOver.of_iso φ hφ
  · refine DefinableOver.of_iso φ.symm ?_
    rw [Iso.symm_hom, ← hφ, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: Belyi.belyi_iff
statement:
theorem belyi_iff (k K : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsCurveOver K X] :
    DefinableOver k K X ↔ ∃ f : X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f

:=
  ⟨exists_isBelyiMap_of_definableOver k K X, belyi_converse k K X⟩

name: Belyi.specAlgebraMap_algEquiv_comp
statement:
lemma specAlgebraMap_algEquiv_comp (k₀ K : Type u) [CommRing k₀] [CommRing K] [Algebra k₀ K]
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k₀] K) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (σ : K →+* K)) ≫ specAlgebraMap k₀ K = specAlgebraMap k₀ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [specAlgebraMap, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  exact RingHom.ext fun x => σ.commutes x

name: Belyi.baseChangeConjIso_hom_snd
statement:
lemma baseChangeConjIso_hom_snd :
    (baseChangeConjIso k₀ K σ X f₀ e he).hom ≫ pullback.snd f₀ (specAlgebraMap k₀ K) =
      pullback.snd (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (σ : K →+* K)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseChangeConjIso, conjLegIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [pullback.congrHom_hom, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id,
    pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd]
  erw [pullback.lift_snd]
  rw [Category.comp_id]

name: Belyi.definableOver_baseChangeAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem definableOver_baseChangeAlgEquiv (k₀ K : Type u) [CommRing k₀] [CommRing K]
    [Algebra k₀ K] (σ : K ≃ₐ[k₀] K) (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (h : DefinableOver k₀ K X) : DefinableOver k₀ K (baseChangeAlgEquiv k₀ K σ X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, f₀, e, he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨X₀, f₀, baseChangeConjIso k₀ K σ X f₀ e he, baseChangeConjIso_hom_snd k₀ K σ X f₀ e he⟩

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_baseChangeAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_baseChangeAlgEquiv (k₀ K : Type u) [CommRing k₀] [Field K]
    [Algebra k₀ K] (σ : K ≃ₐ[k₀] K) (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] (h : DefinableOver k₀ K X) :
    (∃ f : baseChangeAlgEquiv k₀ K σ X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f) ↔
      (∃ f : X ⟶ P1 K, IsBelyiMap K f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X₀, f₀, e, he⟩ := h
  exact exists_isBelyiMap_congr K (baseChangeConjIso k₀ K σ X f₀ e he ≪≫ e.symm)

name: Belyi.P1.polynomialSelfMap_image_subset_markedPoints
statement:
theorem polynomialSelfMap_image_subset_markedPoints
    (g : k[X]) (hd : 0 < g.natDegree) (Z : Set (P1 k))
    (hgen : _root_.genericPoint (P1 k) ∉ Z)
    (hcoord : ∀ a : k,
      (point k a).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of k)) ∈ Z →
        Polynomial.aeval a g = 0 ∨ Polynomial.aeval a g = 1) :
    (polynomialSelfMap k g hd) '' Z ⊆ Belyi.markedPoints k
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hyne : y ≠ _root_.genericPoint (P1 k) := fun h => hgen (h ▸ hy)
  rcases exists_eq_point_or_eq_infty_of_ne_genericPoint k y hyne with ⟨a, hya⟩ | hyinf
  · have himg : (polynomialSelfMap k g hd).base y =
        (point k (Polynomial.aeval a g)).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
      rw [hya]
      exact polynomialSelfMap_point_closedPoint k g hd a
    rw [himg]
    rcases hcoord a (hya ▸ hy) with h0 | h1
    · rw [h0, point_base_eq_zero]; exact Belyi.zero_mem_markedPoints k
    · rw [h1, point_base_eq_one]; exact Belyi.one_mem_markedPoints k
  · have himg : (polynomialSelfMap k g hd).base y = infty k := by
      rw [hyinf]; exact polynomialSelfMap_infty k g hd
    rw [himg]; exact Belyi.infty_mem_markedPoints k

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_marked_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_marked_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X]
    (S : Set X) (hSfin : S.Finite) (hScl : ∀ s ∈ S, IsClosed ({s} : Set X)) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ P1 k, IsBelyiMap k f ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, f.base s ∈ Belyi.markedPoints k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  haveI : IsIntegral X := IsCurveOver.isIntegral k X
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀fin, hf₀surj, -⟩ := exists_isFinite_surjective_hom_to_P1 k X
  haveI : IsFinite f₀ := hf₀fin
  haveI : IsDominant f₀ := ⟨hf₀surj.denseRange⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherian (P1 k) := isNoetherian_of_over (P1 k) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  haveI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀ := inferInstance
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_over X (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  have hdim : ∀ x : X, Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    fun x => krullDimLE_one_stalk_of_isCurveOver k X x
  
  
  have hSgen : _root_.genericPoint (P1 k) ∉ f₀.base '' S := by
    rintro ⟨s, hs, hseq⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed (f₀.base '' ({s} : Set X)) := f₀.isClosedMap _ (hScl s hs)
    rw [Set.image_singleton, hseq] at hcl
    exact P1.not_isClosed_singleton_genericPoint k hcl
  
  have hmarkFin :
      {a : k | (P1.point k a).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of k)) ∈
        f₀.base '' S}.Finite :=
    (hSfin.image f₀.base).preimage (P1.point_base_injective k).injOn
  set S₀ : Finset k := P1.branchFinset k f₀ hdim ∪ hmarkFin.toFinset with hS₀
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgne, hgS, hgcrit⟩ := exists_aeval_mem_and_critVal_mem_zeroOne (K := k) S₀
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap ℚ k) := (algebraMap ℚ k).injective
  have hd : 0 < (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)).natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgne
  
  have hval : ∀ a ∈ S₀,
      Polynomial.aeval a (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) = 0 ∨
        Polynomial.aeval a (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) = 1 := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact hgS a ha
  refine ⟨f₀ ≫ P1.polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine P1.isBelyiMap_comp_polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd f₀ ?_ ?_
    · refine P1.polynomialSelfMap_image_branch_subset_markedPoints k f₀ hdim
        (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd ?_
      intro s hs
      exact hval s (Finset.mem_union_left _ hs)
    · exact branch_map_polynomialSelfMap_subset_markedPoints hgne hgcrit hd
  · 
    have himg : (P1.polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd) '' (f₀.base '' S) ⊆
        Belyi.markedPoints k := by
      refine P1.polynomialSelfMap_image_subset_markedPoints
        (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd _ hSgen ?_
      intro a ha
      exact hval a (Finset.mem_union_right _ (hmarkFin.mem_toFinset.mpr ha))
    intro s hs
    show (f₀ ≫ P1.polynomialSelfMap k (g.map (algebraMap ℚ k)) hd) s ∈ Belyi.markedPoints k
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact himg ⟨f₀.base s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Belyi.exists_isBelyiMap_marked_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
statement:
theorem exists_isBelyiMap_marked_baseChange_of_isCurveOver
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X₀ : Scheme.{u}) [X₀.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsCurveOver k X₀]
    (S : Set X₀) (hSfin : S.Finite) (hScl : ∀ s ∈ S, IsClosed ({s} : Set X₀)) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (π : Y ⟶ X₀) (f : Y ⟶ P1 K),
      IsBelyiMap K f ∧ ∀ z : Y, π.base z ∈ S → f.base z ∈ markedPoints K
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hmk⟩ := exists_isBelyiMap_marked_of_isCurveOver k X₀ S hSfin hScl
  refine ⟨pullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), pullback.fst f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K),
    pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K), isBelyiMap_baseChange k K hf₀, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  
  
  have hsq := IsPullback.of_hasPullback f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)
  have hw : f₀.base ((pullback.fst f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) =
      (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K).base ((pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun m => m.base z) hsq.w
    rwa [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
  
  have hmark : (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K).base ((pullback.snd f₀ (P1.mapOfAlgebra k K)).base z) ∈
      markedPoints k := hw ▸ hmk _ hz
  
  exact P1.mapsTo_markedPoints k K _ hmark

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.ι_ratCast
statement: @[simp] lemma ι_ratCast (q : ℚ) : ι (q : Qbar) = (q : ℂ)
proof: := map_ratCast ι q

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.norm_ι_ratCast
statement: @[simp] lemma norm_ι_ratCast (q : ℚ) : ‖ι (q : Qbar)‖ = |(q : ℝ)|

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.exists_mob_normalize
statement:
theorem exists_mob_normalize (T : Finset Qbar) {τ : ℚ} (hτ : (τ : Qbar) ∉ T) {C : ℚ}
    (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ u : ElemMap, (∀ z, u.ramIdx z = 1) ∧ u.apply (ofRat τ) = ofRat C ∧
      u.apply none = ofRat 0 ∧ ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ y, u.apply (some t) = some y ∧ ‖ι y‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδT⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t ∈ T, δ ≤ ‖ι t - (τ : ℂ)‖ := by
    rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hT | hT
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, by simp [hT]⟩
    · obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmin⟩ := T.exists_min_image (fun t => ‖ι t - (τ : ℂ)‖) hT
      refine ⟨_, ?_, hmin⟩
      rw [norm_pos_iff, sub_ne_zero, ← ι_ratCast]
      intro h
      exact hτ (ι_injective h ▸ ht₀)
  have hC' : (0 : ℝ) < C := by exact_mod_cast hC
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεδ⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (div_pos hδ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < C + 1))
  have hε0' : (0 : ℚ) < ε := by exact_mod_cast hε0
  have hεδ' : (C + 1) * (ε : ℝ) < δ := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at hεδ; linarith
  have hdet : (0 : ℚ) * -(τ - ε) - C * ε * 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : C * ε ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨ElemMap.mob 0 (C * ε) 1 (-(τ - ε)) hdet, fun z => rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ElemMap.apply_mob_ofRat _ (by simp [hε0'.ne'])]
    congr 1
    rw [show (0 : ℚ) * τ + C * ε = C * ε by ring, show (1 : ℚ) * τ + -(τ - ε) = ε by ring,
      mul_div_assoc, div_self hε0'.ne', mul_one]
  · simp [ElemMap.apply_mob_none, ofRat]
  · intro t ht
    have hdist : δ - ε ≤ ‖ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ)‖ := by
      have h1 := hδT t ht
      have h2 : ι t - (τ : ℂ) = (ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ)) - (ε : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have h3 := norm_sub_le (ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ)) (ε : ℂ)
      rw [← h2] at h3
      have h4 : ‖(ε : ℂ)‖ = ε := by
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_ratCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hε0')]
      linarith
    have hpos : 0 < ‖ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ)‖ := by nlinarith
    have hne : ((1 : ℚ) : Qbar) * t + ((-(τ - ε) : ℚ) : Qbar) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
        have := congrArg ι h0
        simp only [map_add, map_mul, ι_ratCast, map_zero] at this
        push_cast at this ⊢
        linear_combination this
      rw [this, norm_zero] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
    refine ⟨_, ElemMap.apply_mob_some_of_ne _ hne, ?_⟩
    have hval : ι ((((0 : ℚ) : Qbar) * t + ((C * ε : ℚ) : Qbar)) /
        (((1 : ℚ) : Qbar) * t + ((-(τ - ε) : ℚ) : Qbar))) =
        ((C * ε : ℚ) : ℂ) / (ι t - ((τ - ε : ℚ) : ℂ)) := by
      simp only [map_div₀, map_add, map_mul, ι_ratCast]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hval, norm_div, div_le_one hpos]
    have h5 : ‖((C * ε : ℚ) : ℂ)‖ = C * ε := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_ratCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast mul_pos hC hε0')]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [h5]
    nlinarith

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.norm_prod_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_prod_sub_le (s : Multiset ℂ) (hs : ∀ ρ ∈ s, ‖ρ‖ ≤ 1) {w : ℂ} (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(s.map fun ρ => w - ρ).prod‖ ≤ 2 ^ Multiset.card s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, norm_mul, Multiset.card_cons, pow_succ]
    have h1 : ‖w - a‖ ≤ 2 := by
      have := norm_sub_le w a
      have := hs a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
      linarith
    have h2 := ih (fun ρ hρ => hs ρ (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hρ))
    rw [mul_comm ‖w - a‖]
    exact mul_le_mul h2 h1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.pow_le_norm_prod_sub
statement:
lemma pow_le_norm_prod_sub (s : Multiset ℂ) (hs : ∀ ρ ∈ s, ‖ρ‖ ≤ 1) {w : ℂ} (hw : 1 ≤ ‖w‖) :
    (‖w‖ - 1) ^ Multiset.card s ≤ ‖(s.map fun ρ => w - ρ).prod‖
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, norm_mul, Multiset.card_cons, pow_succ]
    have h1 : ‖w‖ - 1 ≤ ‖w - a‖ := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le w a
      have := hs a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
      linarith
    have h2 := ih (fun ρ hρ => hs ρ (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hρ))
    rw [mul_comm ‖w - a‖]
    exact mul_le_mul h2 h1 (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)

    IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree).symm

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.ι_aeval_eq_prod
statement:
lemma ι_aeval_eq_prod {f : ℚ[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (z : Qbar) :
    ι (aeval z f) = (((qroots f).map ι).map fun ρ => ι z - ρ).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_map_algebraMap, map_eq_prod_qroots hf, eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map,
    map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro ρ _
  simp

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.map_complex_eq_prod
statement:
lemma map_complex_eq_prod {f : ℚ[X]} (hf : f.Monic) :
    f.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) = (((qroots f).map ι).map fun ρ => X - C ρ).prod
proof:
:= by
  have h : algebraMap ℚ ℂ = (ι : Qbar →+* ℂ).comp (algebraMap ℚ Qbar) := by
    ext q; simp
  rw [h, ← Polynomial.map_map, map_eq_prod_qroots hf, Polynomial.map_multiset_prod,
    Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro ρ _
  simp

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.norm_aeval_le
statement:
lemma norm_aeval_le (hf : f.Monic) (hroots : ∀ ρ ∈ qroots f, ‖ι ρ‖ ≤ 1) {z : Qbar}
    (hz : ‖ι z‖ ≤ 1) : ‖ι (aeval z f)‖ ≤ 2 ^ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_aeval_eq_prod hf, ← card_qroots, ← Multiset.card_map ι]
  refine norm_prod_sub_le _ ?_ hz
  intro ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ', rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hρ
  exact hroots ρ hρ'

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.pow_le_abs_eval_nine
statement:
lemma pow_le_abs_eval_nine (hf : f.Monic) (hroots : ∀ ρ ∈ qroots f, ‖ι ρ‖ ≤ 1) :
    (8 : ℝ) ^ f.natDegree ≤ |((f.eval 9 : ℚ) : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have h9 : ‖ι ((9 : ℚ) : Qbar)‖ = 9 := by rw [norm_ι_ratCast]; norm_num
  have hbd := pow_le_norm_prod_sub ((qroots f).map ι) ?_ (w := ι ((9 : ℚ) : Qbar))
    (by rw [h9]; norm_num)
  · rw [← ι_aeval_eq_prod hf, h9, Multiset.card_map, card_qroots] at hbd
    have he : aeval ((9 : ℚ) : Qbar) f = ((f.eval 9 : ℚ) : Qbar) := by
      have := aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval (A := Qbar) (p := f) (9 : ℚ)
      simpa only [eq_ratCast] using this
    rw [he, norm_ι_ratCast] at hbd
    norm_num at hbd
    exact hbd
  · intro ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ', rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hρ
    exact hroots ρ hρ'

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.norm_le_one_of_aeval_derivative
statement:
lemma norm_le_one_of_aeval_derivative (hf : f.Monic) (hdeg : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (hroots : ∀ ρ ∈ qroots f, ‖ι ρ‖ ≤ 1) {c : Qbar} (hc : aeval c (derivative f) = 0) :
    ‖ι c‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  set F : ℂ[X] := f.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) with hF
  have hFdeg : 0 < F.degree := by
    rw [hF, degree_map]; exact natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp hdeg
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := by rintro h; rw [h] at hFdeg; simp at hFdeg
  have hderiv : derivative F ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hF, derivative_map]
    refine Polynomial.map_ne_zero ?_
    intro h0
    have := derivative_eq_zero.mp h0
    omega
  have hmem : ι c ∈ (derivative F).rootSet ℂ := by
    rw [mem_rootSet]
    refine ⟨hderiv, ?_⟩
    rw [hF, derivative_map, aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algHom_apply, hc, map_zero]
  have hsub : F.rootSet ℂ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_rootSet] at hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    have h2 := hx.2
    rw [coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, map_complex_eq_prod hf, eval_multiset_prod,
      Multiset.map_map] at h2
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp (Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp h2)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hy0
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hy0]
    exact hroots ρ hρ
  have := convexHull_min hsub (convex_closedBall 0 1)
    (rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet hFdeg hmem)
  rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this

name: Belyi.NoncriticalP1.norm_aeval_crit_le
statement:
lemma norm_aeval_crit_le (hf : f.Monic) (hdeg : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (hroots : ∀ ρ ∈ qroots f, ‖ι ρ‖ ≤ 1) {c : Qbar} (hc : aeval c (derivative f) = 0) :
    ‖ι (aeval c f)‖ ≤ 2 ^ f.natDegree
proof:
:=
  norm_aeval_le hf hroots (norm_le_one_of_aeval_derivative hf hdeg hroots hc)
